那位法师向前迈了一步，说道 [party.som|你|你和你的同伴|你的团队] 这样你就能听得更清楚了。“是……”他停住了，把目光从你身上移开，紧张地双手部握着自己的法杖，“我的女主人……她出了点问题，我觉得她可能会伤害别人。”

嗯，这可真是个棘手部的情况。太模糊了……你也在疑惑，他的情妇到底是谁，她到底出了什么问题。”

“我不知道，”法师沮丧地咬着牙解释道，“其实什么都没有改变，但是……我就是觉得有些不对劲，有些之前没有注意到的地方。他叹了口气，继续解释道：“但我知道她在策划些什么，一些与她塔楼周围的村庄有关的计划，而我一点也不喜欢这个想法。”他抬头看着你，声音又变大了：“不过，我一个人是无法阻止她的。 我的力量还不够强大，因此需要你的帮助。”

一个强大的法师打算攻击附近的村庄？这听起来不太妙……会不会与那些幽灵有什么关系呢？不过，那个女召唤师的解释也有些让人怀疑的地方。 谁知道，这说不定是个陷阱呢。

那个半狼族就站在那里 [party.som|你|你和 [companion.name]|你的团队]正在等待回复。

你会帮助他吗？你需要记住，一旦你的旅程开始，你可能就无法再离开他的公司了。
rows.raw:
"
    Moving through the foothills, you're greeted with a familiar sight coming over the horizon: a relatively short figure clad in robes making its way toward you, its silhouette revealing a large, pointed hat atop its head.

    No doubt it's that half-lupine summoner again... has he been following you[party.solo||r party]?

    Either way, you ready [party.som|yourself|you and [companion.name]|your party] as the girly, grumpy mage approaches you once more. As he closes in, making his way down the hill, he doesn't seem ready to attack, though, nor does he seem as angry as he normally would. Instead, he seems slumped... a bit sad or anxious.

    He notices your defensive posturing and shouts to you from a distance. "I'm not here to fight you!" he yells over a gust of wind blowing across the hills.

    There's a long silence that hangs after that, [party.som|watching the mage's robes billow in the breeze for a moment|you and your companion standing at the ready regardless of his words for a moment|you and your party standing at the ready regardless of the mage's words] before you finally speak up and ask the half-breed what he wants, if not more %"practice"

    "I..." the girly magician yells again, stopping himself after that one word with his voice growing more quiet, "I... need your help." 

    Hearing that shift in his voice leads you to let your guard down[party.hasCompanions|, and your party to do the same]. He sounds more than sincere, his blue eyes full of desperation.

    You ask him what exactly he needs help with.

    The mage steps forward to [party.som|you|you and your companion|your party] so you can hear him better. "It's..." he stops and looks away from you, nervously wringing his hands around his staff, "My mistress... something's wrong with her, and I think she's going to hurt people."

    Well that's pretty... vague. You question as to who exactly his mistress is and what exactly seems wrong with her.

    "I don't know," the mage begins to explain, gritting his teeth with frustration, "Nothing's really changed, but... I just know something's wrong, something I haven't noticed before." 

    Sighing, he continues his explanation, "but I know she's planning something, something to do with the villages around her tower, and I don't like the thought of that at all." He looks up at you, his voice getting louder again, "I can't stop her by myself, though. I'm not strong enough. That's why I need your help."

    A powerful mage planning on attacking nearby villages? That doesn't sound good; could it have something to do with the Wraiths? Then again the girly summoner's explanation leaves something to be desired. This could be some sort of trap for all you know.

    The half-lupine stands in front of [party.som|you|you and [companion.name]|your party], waiting for a reply. 

    Will you help him? You should keep in mind you probably won't be able to leave his company once your journey begins.
    "

rows.original: Yes, you'll follow this girly mage and help him deal with his mistress.
rows.translation: 没错，你将跟随这位女法师，帮助他解决与情妇之间的事情。
rows.raw: "Yes, you'll follow this girly mage and help him deal with his mistress."

rows.original: You refuse to trust this half-breed magician.
rows.translation: 你拒绝信任这个混血魔法师。
rows.raw: "You refuse to trust this half-breed magician."

rows.original:
Looking down at the defeated mage, you remember him asking you for help before, and instead of doing as he says, you decide to ask the prone femboy if he still needs any assistance.

    His pale blue eyes widen at that, but a rather confused look crosses his face. "Uh, yeah," he says with a bewildered tone, reaching a paw up to you, "Help me up first?"

    You [pc.isDK|roll your eyes, but] comply and reach a hand to his, grabbing his furry fingers and pulling him back up to his feet.

    The girly summoner dusts himself off and thanks you. "Like I said last time," he begins, taking up his staff again, "My mistress is up to something, and I think she's planning on attacking some neighboring towns. I don't know how or why, but I can't think of any other explanations for what I've seen, and I know I need help to stop her."

    You remember him telling you something along those line last time.

    "So, are you planning on helping this time?" he asks plainly.

    Once again, you have to decide rather to trust this half-lupine summoner or not.
rows.translation:
低头看着那个被击败的法师，你想起之前他曾向你求助，但当时你并没有帮他，反而决定去问那个倒在地上的伪娘是否还需要帮助。

他的淡蓝色眼睛突然睁得更大，脸上却露出困惑的表情。“呃，是的，”他带着迷茫的语气说道，同时伸出一只爪子朝你伸来，“先帮帮我站起来好吗？”

你 [pc.isDK|你尽管翻白眼吧，但……] 她遵从命令，伸出手去抓住他那毛茸茸的手指，将他拉了起来。那位喜欢女装的召唤师拍掉身上的灰尘，向她道谢。“就像我上次说的，”他重新拿起法杖开始说道，“我的女主人肯定在密谋什么，我觉得她打算攻击一些邻近的城镇。 我不知道是怎么回事，也不知道为什么，但我实在想不出其他任何能够解释我所看到的一切的原因。我知道，我需要帮助才能阻止她。”

你记得上次他也是跟你说过类似的话吧。

“那么，这次你打算帮忙吗？他直截了当地问道：

“再一次，你必须做出决定——是选择信任这个有点傻乎乎的召唤师，还是不信任他。

rows.translation: 是的，你将帮助他处理他的情妇。在她被击败之前，你可能无法继续你的旅程了。
rows.raw: "Yes, you'll help him deal with his mistress. You may not be able to return to your journeys until she's defeated."

rows.original: No, you refuse to trust this bratty mage.
rows.translation: 不，你拒绝信任这个任性的法师。
rows.raw: "No, you refuse to trust this bratty mage."

rows.original:
Deciding to follow this lead, you grin and [pc.dcb|tell the mage you'll help compensate for his weaknesses in the fields of magic to stop his mistress|tell the femboy you'll help him and the people his mistress is planning on attacking|giggle and tell the cute summoner you'd be glad to help him].

    The mage breathes a sigh of relief at that and loosens his nervous death-grip on his staff. "Thank you," he says quietly before turning and pointing over a nearby hill, "My mistress' tower is that way, I can lead [party.som|you|both of you|all of you] there, and I'll try to tell you what I know along the way."

    With that, he urges you to follow and begins to walk off, using his staff like a walking stick. You don't immediately follow him though, and instead speak up and tell the summoner you'd like to know his name before going off on this adventure with him.

    He stops in his tracks, looking over his shoulder at you, "Berwyn, my name is Berwyn."

    After that, he continues on his way, and you [party.som|quickly begin moving to catch up|and your companion begin moving to follow him|gather your comrades to follow the girly mage], ready to take on his mistress.
rows.translation:
决定追随这个建议，你微笑着说道 [pc.dcb|告诉那位法师，你会帮助弥补他在魔法领域的不足，以此阻止他的情妇得逞。|告诉那个伪娘，你会帮助他，以及他的情妇打算攻击的那些人。|咯咯笑着告诉那位可爱的召唤师，你很乐意帮助他。]法师听到这个回答后松了一口气，紧张地握着法杖的手也终于放松了下来。他轻声说道：“谢谢。”然后转身指向不远处的那座小山：“我女主人的塔楼就在那边，我带路吧。 [party.som|你|你们两个|你们所有人] 好了，我会边走边把我知道的事情告诉你们。”

说完，他便示意你跟上，然后开始用那根手杖作为拐杖向前走去。但你并没有立刻跟在他后面，而是开口问那位召唤师，在与他一起开始这段冒险之前，你想知道他的名字。

他停下了脚步，回头看着你：“我叫贝尔温。”

说完，他又继续向前走去，而你 [party.som|迅速开始行动以赶上进度。|你的同伴也开始跟随他移动。|召集你的同伴们，跟随这位女法师吧。]准备去迎接他的情妇了。

rows.original:
Thinking that it would be against your best interests to trust this previous enemy, especially when the details he's given you are lacking substance, you tell the summoner you won't be helping him.

    At first he seems shocked, but that disbelief quickly turns to anger as his eyes narrow and his teeth grit. "Fine!" he yells, gripping his staff so hard you think it might break in half, "I don't need your help! I'll find someone else!" He goes to angrily stomp off on his fluffy paw-feet, but stops to look over his shoulder at you, "Maybe you aren't [party.hasCompanions|the people|who] I thought you were." 

    Then, just as soon as he arrived, the effeminate half-breed is making his way over the next foothill, leaving you to ponder the true nature of his request.
rows.translation:
你认为信任这个曾经的敌人并不符合你的利益，尤其是当他提供的信息如此缺乏实质内容时，于是你告诉召唤师你不会帮助他。

起初他似乎很震惊，但这种怀疑很快便转化为了愤怒——他的眼睛眯了起来，牙齿也咬得紧紧的。 好吧！”他大喊道，紧紧握住自己的法杖，用力程度之大仿佛那根法杖随时都会折断，“我不需要你的帮助！我会另找别人的！”他气冲冲地想要用自己那毛茸茸的爪子踩着地面离开，但突然停了下来，回头看了你一眼：“也许你并不是那个合适的人选 [party.hasCompanions|人们|谁] 我还以为你是呢。”

然而，他刚一到达，那个柔弱不堪的混血儿就已经翻过了下一座山丘，留下你独自思考他提出那个请求的真正意图。

rows.original:
Along the way to his mistress' tower, Berwyn tells you about your supposed target. "My mistress, Miss Matiha, taught me everything I know about magic," he explains as you walk, "She's the one that found me after I left my parents, took me in. I was surprised I'd never heard of her before I met her, considering how powerful she is. She has a whole tower, and I was her only apprentice." 

    Berwyn grimaces as he speaks, "At first she treated me nicer, but then things changed, and I don't know exactly what... I noticed some specific things becoming different... my body... my libido... but I never thought about it, or cared. She changed too, she started treating me harsher when I failed her lessons, and started spending a lot more time by herself, or away from the tower. Then I found this thing, this stone when I was cleaning her study one day. It had runes on it but I couldn't read them, and there were maps on her desk, and she had marked all the towns around her tower." He shivers at those memories for a moment then continues, "I touched the stone... and it was... well I didn't like it, let's say that. So I know something is wrong, and no one else knows, and that just leaves me to stop her."

    It's a long journey, and you actually stop to rest along the way for some time. Eventually though, sometime after Berwyn spins his tale about his mistress, the tower he spoke of appears over the horizon. The pointed roof of the tower rises over the foothills as you move forward, and soon enough what looks like a whole fortress appears beneath the tall stone tower. 

    It's still a while longer before [party.hasCompanions|you all|you and Berwyn] make it to the tower, and when you do there's a huge door standing between you and your goal.

    "Here," Berwyn says, stepping ahead of you, his staff extended, "This door doesn't open normally."

    With that, his staff begins to glow a bright red at its tip, and he proceeds to trace a rune along the heavy wooden posts of the door. It seems to do the trick, and soon you hear the sound of the gate unlatching and the two huge doors swing open.

    Berwyn takes a few steps forward and signals for [party.som|you|you and [companion.name]|your party] to follow him through the gateway. He leads you into the courtyard of the fortress; it's wide open with a lot of space between its outer walls and the tower. It's hard to tell what this place might have once been used for or who it belonged to, because now it's been turned into a large herb garden, filled with all the blossoming ingredients an experienced alchemist would need, planted expertly around the tower's moving shadow to optimize the amount of sunlight they get.

    Your guide leads you to the tower and opens another door before inviting you inside, and you follow him in.
rows.translation:
在前往情妇所在塔楼的路上，贝尔温向你介绍了你所谓的目标。“我的情妇玛蒂哈小姐教会了我所有关于魔法的知识，”你们边走边聊，他说道，“就是她在我离开父母后找到了我，并收留了我。说实话，在见到她之前，我竟然从未听说过她——毕竟她如此强大。她拥有整座塔楼，而我是她唯一的学徒。 

    贝尔温说话时面露苦色：“一开始，她对我的态度比较好，但后来情况发生了变化，我也不太清楚具体是为什么……我注意到一些具体的细节开始不一样了……我的身体……我的性欲……但我当时没有多想，也不在乎这些。 她也变了，每当我没有完成她布置的任务时，她就会对我更加严厉；同时，她也开始花更多的时间独自待着，或者离开那座塔。有一天，在清理她的书房时，我发现了这块石头。 上面刻着一些符文，但我看不懂它们；她的桌子上还有地图，她已经在地图上标出了她塔楼周围的所有城镇。”他回忆起这些场景，不禁打了个寒颤，然后继续说道：“我触碰了那块石头……结果确实如此。嗯，老实说，我并不喜欢那样。所以我意识到有些事情不对劲，而其他人却都没有察觉到，这就只能由我来阻止她了。

    这是一段漫长的旅程，途中你确实会停下来休息一段时间。然而，就在贝林开始讲述关于他情妇的故事之后不久，他所说的那座塔终于出现在地平线上。当你继续前行时，那座塔尖锐的屋顶逐渐耸立在山丘之上，不久之后，整座巨大的石塔下面竟然出现了一座仿佛真正的堡垒般的建筑。 

    距离那个时间还有些距离呢。 [party.hasCompanions|你们所有人|你和贝尔温] 当你终于来到那座塔前时，会发现有一扇巨大的门挡在你和你的目标之间。

“过来，”贝尔温走到你面前，伸出他的法杖说道，“这扇门平时是无法打开的。”

说着，他的法杖顶端开始发出亮红色的光芒，他沿着门上的厚木柱绘制出一个符文。似乎真的有效，不久之后，你就听到门锁解开的声响，那两扇巨大的门缓缓打开了。

贝尔温向前走了几步，然后示意你跟上来。 [party.som|你|你和…… [companion.name]|你的团队] 跟随他穿过那道大门，他引领你进入了堡垒的庭院。那里的围墙与高塔之间留有宽敞的空地，整个庭院敞开着。很难判断这个地方曾经被用来做什么，或者它属于谁，因为现在这里已经被改造成了一个巨大的药草园，里面种满了各种开花植物——这些正是经验丰富的炼金术士所需要的材料。这些植物被巧妙地种植在高塔移动的阴影范围内，这样它们就能接收到最多的阳光。

    你的向导带你来到那座塔前，打开了另一扇门，然后邀请你进去，你便跟着他走了进去。

rows.original: [flags.BYVERNIA_MET |Some may never learn, but you do; when things get quiet in the Foothills, it's obviously due to one thing. [pc.higherStat agility toughness |You dodge to the side just as Byvernia's hatchet swings through the air mere inches from your head |You raise your hand and catch Byvernia's hatchet, halting it before dismissively tossing it away ]. "Come out, Byvernia!" You aren't too happy about getting attacked, but the least she can do is face you. Thankfully the huntress isn't feeling like delaying things for long; she pulls the chain of her weapon so hard it clacks, reeling back through the air and arcing over to her hiding space. The taeleer slips out from her cover and rolls her shoulders, letting her ears dangle low and her eyes narrow. [var0 | You can't quite place it but her eyes aren't as venomous today as the first time you met her in battle. | She's pulling at her armor, almost as if it isn't quite fitting her thickening midsection. | At this point, her pregnancy is almost entirely making her armor stretch to its limit. | ] "You're learning my tells?" Although it's a question, it seems more like open contempt and an observation. The bunnywoman accents it with a finely-veiled snarl. "[silly |Clever [pc.mf |boy |girl ]. |Maybe you'd be worth something if you didn't keep interfering in my hunt. ]" Talking things out isn't possible with her; [party.som |you |the two of you |your companions and you ] can't even raise a finger without her getting on edge. For now, it's time to fight. |The Foothills are quiet... unusually so. There's no wind nor rambunctious orc raiding nor any sort of outright problematic noises in the slightest. Your journey has never been this quiet. That ends pretty quickly when a [party.som||pair of |pair of ]throwing axe[party.som||s|s] swirl[party.som|s] past you[party.som |r head | and [comp1.names] heads |r party's heads ]. [party.som |It |They |They ] crash[party.som |es | | ] into the craggy ground with enough force it cracks the surface, sending stone fragments sailing. rows.original: [var0 |You ignore the tantalizing show she's putting on and instead point at the axe-battered tree. "So, this is how you train?" Byvernia slips out of her position perhaps a tad disappointed, but certainly not displeased with your redirection. In fact, she quickly twirls the chains of her weapons and realigns them into her grip. "Yeah. Trees are tough to cut, so the best way to gauge your skill with an axe is to test your cutting ability." The pair of francisca may not look too imposing, but their edges are clearly well-sharpened and maintained despite this form of training. Most weapons of bronze couldn't endure this, but the thinnest vein of alloyed iron runs along the spine of bronze to give you a good guess why. "Those are composite weapons?" Byvernia smirks, resting one of her personal weapons along her shoulder. "No... but axes periodically get alloy reinforcing so that they endure longer. Some smiths say that there was something sharper and more durable than Tronarii bronze, but the only stuff like that are relics and crap that nobles flaunt all over the place." Byvernia snaps toward the tree and throws both of the blades; the chains lax no differently than when she fights, smashing into the tree and cleaving inches into the wood. All of the muscles in her arms flex and she effortlessly pulls them loose in a single motion, arcing them back and into her grasp with a grunt. The show is impressive but a clear sign of just how often she uses her axes to gain a mastery of just how and when to throw them for the most damage. "Not that it matters," she finally continues. "The truth is that the best method is to use iron in the alloy to help toughen it, but never try to make it the primary part of an alloy. All the men in my family passed that bit of knowledge down from when we were still slave-warriors, fighting against things like the wyverns and their ilk. No bronze or iron weapon could hurt the true challenge of a dragon, but this style of fighting was used in their petty games to stop plenty of monsters." The taeleer woman releases her paired weapons and instead sets her hands [byvernia.pregStage 0 1 |on her hips |on her swelling belly ], turning that confident smirk of hers toward you. "Of course, [byvernia.numKids 1 |you've already seen to it that I pass it on to our kids |the only way to learn that is to find out ]. It's a good thing you're strong. I wouldn't want you falling over dead too easily when my descendants come to test your mettle, too." All that %"nice energy" ends as fast as she mustered it, however, with Byvernia finally sighing and setting back off toward the forest's edge. "But that's enough talk. Come find me when you're ready to do more than chat. At least wyverns know not to bore me with words when they're weak." |You ignore the tantalizing show she's putting on and instead point at the strange-colored bark. "[flags.BYVERNIA_VALLEY 2 |So, more bark?" |What's up with that bark's color? And why are you gathering it?" The bundle of bark scraps she has may not be large, but the amount within it is certainly an alchemist's worth of the stuff. But, surprisingly, the wood's odd coloration does little to give away its purpose or uses. Even someone [pc.isCunning |as smart as you |well-versed in alchemy ] has trouble discerning the use of new ingredients at a mere glance. But to her credit, the taeleer woman is quick to shift her hands over the satchel defensively. ] Byvernia slips the bag behind her waist, removing a single piece. "[flags.BYVERNIA_VALLEY 2 |Yeah, I've got to be [byvernia.pregStage 1 |ready for when these tykes in me are ready to come out kicking and fighting |[byvernia.numKids 1 |prepared for any extra surprises you shove in my womb |prepared for having kids ] ], don't I ?" |This stuff here? Why, you thinking of [byvernia.pregStage 1 |trying to knock me up some more |trying to knock me up or something ]?" Wait, this stuff is related to pregnancy? Byvernia rolls her eyes at the notion you don't know, but seems to quickly catch on this isn't a prank. The huntress groans and carefully breaks the bark, revealing the oddly brighter shading within the blue pieces. "See this stuff? It's called Women's Bloom: basically stuff to help a girl dilate wider when she's giving birth. But it only works if you boil it in wyvern's saliva for at least a day to draw out the stuff inside the bark that makes it blue." ] Boiling it in wyvern's saliva is a pretty odd requirement. "So how exactly do you have access to so much wyvern saliva that you can boil it[flags.BYVERNIA_VALLEY 2 |, again ]?" If not for the fact she's not in the mood to fuck, you're pretty sure the woman would've punched you just now; Byvernia balls one of her hands into a tight fist before she puts away her natural loot and sweeps her hand back through her hair. "Fuck, you really gotta ask? I own wyverns. Lots of the horny little shits. You don't go around breaking up their nests getting eaten out and fucking the alphas into submission without tagging and bagging a few along the way. She doesn't need to go into detail when you can literally watch her later when you pay her a visit. |Maybe sometime she can let you watch some of that at her lodge; why doesn't she invite you? Byvernia scowls and averts her gaze. "Once you know where it is, you can just show up. You've beaten me once already, so you've earned the right to find it. Once I'm in a good enough mood to tell you, anyway." ] A distant crack of wood, however, draws her gaze away from you and off toward distant foothills. Byvernia settles her pouch into place and turns, starting off with a final sigh. "Of course, that'll have to wait. You missed out on the chance to fuck me, so you'll have to find me later. Preferably fight me first, though, so I can make sure you're not any weaker than last time.[flags.BYVERNIA_WON | Maybe you'll do better with the image of me being pampered by my wyvern whores stuck in your head. I won't hold my breath, though, weakling. ]" |You ignore the tantalizing show she's putting on and instead point at her. "Are you okay sleeping out here like this[byvernia.pregStage 1 | while pregnant ]?" The taeleer woman grumbles at your lack of interest in fucking and instead crosses her arms beneath her palm-flooding tits and flicks her tail dismissively. "Of course," she grumbles. "What would I be scared of? Orcs?" [party.has Arona | Arona smirks. "Knocking a bunny slut like you up would be fun if I wasn't already busy [arona.isDom |fucking this cocksleeve |helping [pc.name] ]." ] "Not scared but at least wary. What if they surrounded or captured you?" Byvernia's expression merely curls with the excessive energy she bears when fighting you, this time contained and focused on that idea. "It's easy. I'd win. They're used to fighting rabble... but the real warriors are far and few between. None of their regular lot could even reach me, much less sneak up on me. The only way any of them could get close is being stealthy[pc.isAgile | like you ] but the best of their warriors could care less. I've taken a few down and teased them into submission before and it'll be far from the last time if a few decide to fight me. A group of ten? Now they'd be a challenge... but one that wouldn't stand a chance if I really wanted to win." The huntress reaches to her belt, running her fingertips along the many vials on it. Greasy oils, magical restorative concoctions, and a fiery powder are all ample tools to let her unleash her full power. Asking what she would do if she had to fight is obvious since you've battled her, but in such a battle you can't imagine either side walking away unscathed. "Byvernia, if that happens... what if you get hurt? [byvernia.numKids 1 |What about our children together? |[byvernia.pregStage 1 |What about the babies you have inside you right now? |What if you can't get back on your own? ] ]" This time your words have a somewhat desired effect of making her pause, Byvernia carefully slipping her palms across her [byvernia.pregStage 1 |swollen belly |washboard abs ] and diverting her gaze. "... I won't. It's precisely because I have [var1 |them |a future ] worth fighting for. My legend, my harem, and my dreams... they won't end in these Foothills. This place is my hunting ground... and I'll be the apex, regardless of any mercenaries, harpies, orcs, or wyverns. Nothing will stop me from achieving my goals. Especially not a few greenskins who think a taeleer woman like me can be beaten without an army." You're not sure it'd take an army to beat Byvernia, but her tone and the dark glimmer in her eyes suggests she'd take some pretty powerful people to bring down. Just facing you she can get back up and it's merely sport; if it turned into a life-and-death bout, she'd hands-down be one of the more fierce fights you'd face. All the doom-and-gloom, however, has to end somewhere; her ears twitch and she finally grumbles and slips her axes into her hands. "Enough about these stupid ideas of me losing. [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED |You already bested them so as someone striving to best you I am not troubled by them or this region's strongest. |If no one deals with the orcs, I'll inevitably put them in their place. ] I don't care about all that racial bullshit: my family are born great warriors and my mother had a fancy for orc men in her youth. So why should I be afraid of them? Because a few of them have dicks and are pathetic virgins looking to be 'strong' but unable to duel me? They're not even a match for an alpha wyvern in a rut or a nest's queen together, much less alone. When the day comes that you face something like that, you'll get why I can sleep so calmly." She pushes past you, bumping shoulders and scoffing as she goes. "Maybe you'll want to fuck instead of talk when that time comes. But we'll see. Later, [pc.name]." ]
rows.translation: [var0 |你无视了她正在表演的那些吸引人的把戏，反而指向那棵被斧头砍得伤痕累累的树。 “原来你是这样训练的啊？” 拜弗尼亚或许有些失望地从原来的姿势中站了起来，但显然并不因为你转移了话题而感到不满。事实上，她迅速转动着手中的武器链条，将它们重新调整到适合握持的位置。 没错。树木很难砍伐，所以测试自己用斧头砍伐的能力，其实是检验自己技术的好方法。” 虽然这对弗朗西斯卡斧看起来并不显得特别威武，但它们的刀刃显然经过精心打磨和维护，才能在这种使用方式下依然保持锋利。大多数青铜制成的武器根本无法承受这样的使用方式，但在这把斧头的刀刃上，有一层极薄的合金铁，这大概就是原因吧。 那些是复合武器吗？” 拜弗尼亚得意地笑了笑，将她的一把私人武器搭在肩上。“不是……不过有些斧头会定期添加合金来增强其硬度，这样使用起来就能更持久。有些铁匠说，应该存在某种比特罗纳里青铜更加锋利、更加耐用的材料，但这种材料现在都成了遗迹，只有贵族们才会到处炫耀那些东西罢了。     The bull-man standing in the path raises a hand to you, less in greeting than to stop you. A glance shows that a broad, spade-pointed blade is slung at his hip and a circular shield is strapped to his other arm. His head is mostly hidden beneath a weather-worn, red-plumed helm. 

    "Ay-ah, traveler[party.solo||s]. The King's Gate is closed. Turn ye and be gone."
rows.translation:
在那高耸的黑门之下，有人在岩壁上搭建了一个小营地。四個高大魁梧的身影坐在篝火周围的石头上，而第五个人则站在你与那道大门之间的路上。 当你靠近时，你会发现这些生物根本不是兽人或女妖：它们个个都有近八英尺高，身上覆盖着浓密的粗毛，而在那些破旧的银色鳞甲下面，也能看到这些毛发。它们的脸庞被雕刻得像公牛一样，长着巨大的角，在其中一些个体的鼻子上，还戴着金色的大环。
    
    那个挡在道路上的壮汉向你抬起了手，他的动作更像是在阻止你前进，而非表示问候。一眼就能看出，他的腰间别着一把宽大的、刀刃呈铲状的武器，另一只手臂上则绑着一块圆形盾牌。他的头部几乎被一顶经过风霜侵蚀的、饰有红色羽毛的头盔遮住了。 

    哎呀，旅行者[party.solo||s]国王之门已经关闭，请转身离开吧。
rows.raw:
'
    Beneath the towering black gate, a small camp has been established against the rockface. Four tall, burly figures are sitting on the stones scattered around a campfire, while a fifth stands in the path between you and the gate. As you draw near, you can see these are hardly orcs or harpies: the figures are each nearly eight feet tall, and covered with thick pelts of shaggy fur beneath worn links of silvery scale armor. Their faces are sculpted like those of bulls, complete with mighty horns and in half of their cases, big golden rings through the nose.
    
    The bull-man standing in the path raises a hand to you, less in greeting than to stop you. A glance shows that a broad, spade-pointed blade is slung at his hip and a circular shield is strapped to his other arm. His head is mostly hidden beneath a weather-worn, red-plumed helm. 

    "Ay-ah, traveler[party.solo||s]. The King's Gate is closed. Turn ye and be gone."'

rows.original: [flags.GATEGUARD_ENCOUNTERED|Talk to the minotaurs guarding the gate.|What's with the gate guard? Go up and talk to these bull-folk.]
rows.translation: [flags.GATEGUARD_ENCOUNTERED|与守在门口的米诺陶洛斯们交谈吧。|那个大门守卫是怎么回事？上去跟那些蠢货谈谈吧。]
rows.raw: "[flags.GATEGUARD_ENCOUNTERED|Talk to the minotaurs guarding the gate.|What's with the gate guard? Go up and talk to these bull-folk.]"

rows.original:
[flags.UM_UNLOCKED
        |You step up to the towering bull-man and his entourage, receiving a few respectful nods from the men as you approach. 

        "Ay-ah, Champion," Captain Fenraus says. "The Kingdom of Khor'minos welcomes you back to its lands. Is there something we can do for you?"
        |[flags.GATEGUARD_ENCOUNTERED
            |You step up to the towering bull-man in the middle of the path and ask why the gate's still closed. Is whatever problem the minotaurs are facing really that bad?
            
            He lets out a deep, bellowing breath. "Aye, traveler. I cannot say for certain how bad things are, but the king would not order the gates sealed without cause. Hmm, perhaps if a hero rose on the surface, one worth the king's attention... but no. We have heard of none such."
            |You step up to the towering bull-man in the middle of the path and ask what he means. What's a King's Gate, and why is it closed?
            
            The minotaur snorts[pc.isHeight 94
                |
                | down
            ] at you, resting his meaty paw on the hilt of his blade. Behind him, the other men, soldiers you suppose, glance up from their repose and lock you[party.som
                |
                | and your companion
                | and your companions
            ] with their black eyes. 
            
            "King Kelsaz has ordered the gates closed," the plume-helmed leader says, his accent thick and guttural. "Things are not safe in the Deeplands. Monsters and folk go mad in the tunnels. Not safe anymore for outsiders."
        ]
        
        Glancing at the black gate behind them, solid and imposing, you can hardly imagine [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED
            |that the orcs are causing whoever lives behind that bulwark any trouble.
            |that any of the local factions could have mustered enough brute force to punch through that bulwark.
        ] Could this be Kasyrra's doing?
    ]
rows.translation:
[flags.UM_UNLOCKED
        |你走向那个高大的公牛人及其随从，当你靠近时，那些男人纷纷向你恭敬地点了点头。

“啊，冠军，”芬劳斯队长说道，“科尔米诺斯王国欢迎你回到我们的土地上。有什么我们可以为你做的吗？
        |[flags.GATEGUARD_ENCOUNTERED
            |你走到道路中央那座高大的公牛人面前，询问为什么大门仍然紧闭。那些弥诺陶洛斯面临的困难，真的有那么严重吗？

他深深地叹了口气，说道：“是啊，旅人。我也无法确定情况到底有多糟糕，但国王不会无缘无故地下令关闭大门。嗯，或许如果有一位值得国王关注的英雄出现在世上……但并没有这样的消息。
            |你走到道路中央那头高大的牛人面前，问他这是什么意思。什么是“国王之门”，为什么它被关闭了？

那头牛人哼了一声。[pc.isHeight 94
                |
                | 向下
            ] 他朝你走了过来，将那肉乎乎的爪子搭在刀柄上。在他身后，那些其他人——你应该认为是士兵们——也从休息中抬起头，注视着你。[party.som
                |
                | 以及你的同伴
                | 以及你的同伴们
            ] 他们那双黑色的眼睛……

“凯尔萨兹国王已经下令关闭城门了，”那位头戴羽冠的领袖说道，他的口音浓重而低沉，“在深地，已经不再安全了。隧道里到处都是怪物，那些当地人也都变得疯狂了。对外来者来说，这里已经不再安全了。
        ]
        
        瞥见他们身后的那道黑色大门——如此坚固而威严，实在让人难以想象 [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED
            |那些兽人肯定正在给躲在那些壁垒后面的人带来麻烦。
            |任何一个当地的派系都有可能集结足够的武力来突破那道防线。
        ] 这会不会是卡希拉干的呢？
    ]

rows.original: Try and persuade the minotaurs to allow you entrance. [pc.isDK|No mad monsters are going to stand in your way.|Maybe you could help?]
rows.translation: 试着说服那些弥诺陶洛斯，让他们允许你进入。 [pc.isDK|没有任何疯狂的怪物会挡在你的路上。|也许你可以帮忙？]
rows.raw: "Try and persuade the minotaurs to allow you entrance. [pc.isDK|No mad monsters are going to stand in your way.|Maybe you could help?]"

rows.original: [flags.UM_UNLOCKED|See if the minotaurs have some goods from home, to save you a trip down below.|Since you can't get into the Deeplands yourself, you don't suppose the guards would be willing to do some trading?]
rows.translation: [flags.UM_UNLOCKED|看看那些牛头人是否带了些什么东西从家里带来，这样你就不用再去下面一趟了。|既然你自己无法进入深地，那么你应该也明白，那些守卫们应该不会愿意进行任何交易吧？]
rows.raw: "[flags.UM_UNLOCKED|See if the minotaurs have some goods from home, to save you a trip down below.|Since you can't get into the Deeplands yourself, you don't suppose the guards would be willing to do some trading?]"

rows.original: See if the Guards can help you upgrade your wayfort.
rows.translation: 看看守卫们能否帮助你升级你的传送站。
rows.raw: "See if the Guards can help you upgrade your wayfort."

rows.original: You will not be denied by these oversized cows. Fight your way through them and make your way into the mountain.
rows.translation: 这些庞大的怪物不会阻挡你的去路。冲破它们的包围，继续向山里前进吧。
rows.raw: "You will not be denied by these oversized cows. Fight your way through them and make your way into the mountain."

rows.original: Surely the Chargers will set aside their royal duties in exchange for you slurping every ounce of stress out of their big, swaying balls.
rows.translation: 毫无疑问，充电器队一定会放下他们“王室成员”的架子，只要你愿意帮助他们把那些令人紧张的压力全部释放出来……
rows.raw: "Surely the Chargers will set aside their royal duties in exchange for you slurping every ounce of stress out of their big, swaying balls."

rows.original: You don't need to bribe the captain to get into the deeplands, but you can give him some personal attention anyway...
rows.translation: 你并不需要贿赂船长才能进入深地，不过给予他一些特别的关照也是可以的……
rows.raw: "You don't need to bribe the captain to get into the deeplands, but you can give him some personal attention anyway..."

rows.original:
"Good. Nah-sayya, surface walker[party.solo||s]," the lead minotaur says. "With fortune, the gates will open again some day."

    You turn and withdraw up the path, back into the foothills below.
rows.translation:
很好。娜-赛亚，地表行者。[party.solo||s]有幸的话，这些大门总有一天会再次打开的，”为首的弥诺陶洛斯说道。  

你转身沿着小路返回，重新回到了下方的山脚下。
rows.raw:
'
    "Good. Nah-sayya, surface walker[party.solo||s]," the lead minotaur says. "With fortune, the gates will open again some day."

    You turn and withdraw up the path, back into the foothills below.'

rows.original:
You ask the gate guards if they might be open to some personal trading. You came all this way after all...

    "Eh-saara?" the leader grunts, rolling his head to the side and staring at you quizzically. "Trade? Hmm... there is no harm, I think. We have some comforts from the homeland."

    [party.has brint|"Bloodwine?" Brint asks hopefully.

    The plumed 'taur nods. "Bloodwine among them. Take care for your friend, son. Surfacers are not used to such strength in their drink."]
rows.translation:
你询问守门人是否允许进行一些私人交易。毕竟，你大老远地跑来了……

“呃……萨拉？”首领哼了一声，把头偏向一边，疑惑地盯着你。“交易？嗯……我想应该没什么坏处。我们这里有一些从家乡带来的物品。

    [party.has brint|血酒？”布林特满怀希望地问道。

那只长着羽毛的“公牛”点了点头：“他们当中有血酒。照顾好你的朋友，孩子。地面生物并不习惯饮用如此浓烈的酒。]

    [party.has brint|"Bloodwine?" Brint asks hopefully.

    The plumed 'taur nods. "Bloodwine among them. Take care for your friend, son. Surfacers are not used to such strength in their drink."]'

rows.original:
[flags.WC_CLEAR
        |The plumed 'taur grunts, a deep sound from the gut like crunching rocks, but his eyes wander over you for a longer moment. Finally, his black lips scrunch up and he lets out a rough chuckle. "Ah, yes, I recognize you. News travels fast, when it concerns heroes and villains... Champion of Frost." The captain of the Chargers rests a hand idly on the sheathed hilt of his sword. "Your reputation has preceded you, even into the halls of the great King Kelsaz despite the quarantine. By ancient treaty we were forced to allow elven diplomats to pass, and they carried word of your deeds to the throne of deepest Khor'minos."

        [party.has etheryn|Ryn cuts her eyes over to you and shrugs. Maybe Elthara sent them?]
        
        The dark-furred officer grunts with annoyance, hard enough to make his sizable nose ring rock against his muzzle. "And so just today, orders have come from the throne itself that we are to let the Champion of Frost pass into the Undermountain. But take heed, surfacer: the under-roads are not as they once were. Demons and creatures of darkness stalk the once-lit tunnels between these gates and Khor'minos. Our soldiers are hard-pressed to maintain even a single path to the surface; you will likely have to put your slaying skills to the test if you wish to reach our great city. Its walls are strong and gates unbreached, though — of that, let there be no doubt. Khor'minos stands."
        
        "Khor Aterna!" his subordinantes bellow in unison. 
        
        After a moment, the minotaur steps aside, removing himself from your path. "Perhaps... perhaps one such as you could change things. If a demon queen cannot stand in your way, you may possess the strength to survive in our homeland. Perhaps even to aid it, for why else would our own beloved Champion have begged the king's leave for you to come below?"
        
        You thank the minotaur captain and step past. The other 'taurs rise to their feet and, at a booming word from their leader, go to the gates. Two stand on either side, planting their hands on the cold stone, and they begin to push. For a moment, nothing happens... and then with a mighty shudder, the gate rumbles and starts to open. The 'taurs grunt with effort, digging their hooves into the dirt and shoving the titanic stone slabs open.
        
        "Good luck, Champion," the minotaur captain says as his men step away, granting you passage into the dark embrace of the undermountain.
        |The plumed 'taur grunts, a deep sound from the gut like crunching rocks. "No, traveler. King Kelsaz himself has decreed the gates remain closed to your kind. We will not have your fate on our hands... nor do we wish you to see our homeland in chaos. Make ye gone, for your sake."
    ]
rows.translation:
[flags.WC_CLEAR
        |这只长着羽毛的“公牛”发出低沉的吼声，那种声音仿佛是从它的腹部传出来的，听起来就像石头相互碰撞发出的声响。然而，它的目光却在你身上停留了更长的时间。最终，它那黑色的嘴唇微微一动，发出了一声粗哑的笑声：“啊，对了，我认识你。当涉及到英雄和反派的时候，消息传播得确实很快。……寒霜勇士。”冲锋者队的队长闲散地将手放在剑鞘上。“你的名声早已传开了，甚至传到了伟大的凯尔萨兹国王的宫廷里，尽管有隔离措施的存在。根据古老的条约，我们不得不允许精灵外交官通过，而他们将你的事迹带到了最遥远的科尔米诺斯王座前。"

        [party.has etheryn|瑞恩将目光转向你，耸了耸肩。也许是艾尔塔拉派他们来的？]
        
        那位皮肤黝黑的军官恼怒地哼了一声，这一声哼得如此用力，以至于他那枚较大的鼻环都在他的鼻子上晃来晃去。“就在今天，王座那边下达了命令，要求我们允许霜之冠军进入地底城。 但是要注意，地表人：那些地下通道已经不再像从前那样了。恶魔和暗影生物正在这些通道中游荡，它们横亘在这些大门与科尔米诺斯之间。我们的士兵们正在竭力维护哪怕只有一条通往地表的道路；如果你想到达我们伟大的城市，恐怕就必须运用你的战斗技巧了。 它的城墙坚固，城门也无人能够攻破——这一点，毫无疑问。科尔米诺斯依然屹立不倒。
        
        科尔·阿特纳！”他的下属们齐声呼喊。

过了一会儿，那个弥诺陶洛斯退到了一边，让开了你的道路。“也许……也许像你这样的人能够改变一些事情。如果连一位恶魔女王都无法阻挡你，那么你或许拥有在我们故乡生存下去的力量。甚至，你或许还能帮助我们……否则，我们亲爱的冠军为什么要请求国王允许你来到这里呢？
        
        你向弥诺陶洛斯队长道了谢，然后走了过去。其他弥诺陶洛斯也站了起来，在他们首领的命令下，朝着大门走去。有两名弥诺陶洛斯站在大门的两侧，将双手部放在冰冷的石墙上，开始用力推挤。有那么一刻，什么动静都没有……突然，随着一声剧烈的震动，大门开始缓缓打开。那些弥诺陶洛斯们用力地喘着气，用它们的蹄子踩在泥土上，拼命地将那些巨大的石板推开。
        
        祝你好运，冠军，”弥诺陶洛斯队长说道，随后他的手部下们退开了，让你得以进入那幽暗的地下山洞。
        |这只长着羽毛的“牛”发出了低沉的吼声，那种声音仿佛是从它的腹部传出来的，听起来就像石头相互碰撞发出的声响。“不行，旅行者。凯尔萨兹国王亲自下令，必须关闭这些大门，不让你们这类人进入。我们可不想承担你们的命运……也不希望看到我们的家园陷入混乱。为了你们好，还是离开吧。
    ]

rows.translation:
[flags.UM_UNLOCKED
        |[flags.GATEGUARD_BRIBE
            |你向芬劳斯船长抛去一个挑逗的眼神，暗示如果他让你进城，你愿意为他服务。

“不过你本来就可以……哦哦哦哦哦……”这个肌肉发达的壮汉粗糙的面容上绽开了灿烂的笑容，他终于找回了自己的话：“依我看，对于你这样的麻烦制造者来说，这应该被视为一项必须支付的‘入场费’。拥有这么一张让人想‘服侍’的脸，简直应该被定为一种罪过。
            
            [party.has cait
                |想尝尝霍尔米诺人的牛肉吧，嗯 [pc.name]？”凯特在你身后轻声说道，然后便朝船长的下属们走去。“嗯，如果这些可怜的孩子们都坐在这里，却没有人给他们一些关爱和关怀，那么只照顾船长未免太不公平了……
            ]
            
            [party.has brint
                |哦，这个肯定很有趣，”布林特笑着说道，靠在附近的石头上。
            ]

She just smiles and flails her tiny wing-arms, never taking her eyes off your face. "Go on," the beaming mother coos, running a hand across your cheek. "Play with her a bit, before I have to take her home."'

rows.original: It's near sunrise when your lover finally manages to pry you away from her cute little hatchling. Your daughter might be shy, but she has a voracious appetite for play and for stories. Her mother hangs in the background for the most part, watching with a subdued smile as her lover and her child interact for the first time. When the sun crests the village's walls, though, the wingleader scoops her daughter up and holds her to her chest. "Gotta go, tiger. Don't want to get chased home by the town guard's arrows. See ya on the hills!" The harpy thief turns to leave, pauses, and then hops back to plant a fierce kiss on your lips before hurtling out the window and taking wing once again.
rows.translation: 当太阳即将升起的时候，你的爱人终于把你从你那可爱的小宝宝身边拉开。你的女儿可能有点害羞，但她对玩耍和故事充满了浓厚的兴趣。她的母亲大多时候都只是在一旁静静地看着，脸上带着淡淡的微笑，观察着你的女人和你的孩子第一次互动。 然而，当太阳终于升过了村庄的屋顶，那位族长便把女儿抱在怀里，紧紧地贴在自己的胸前。 得走了，老虎。可不想被镇卫队的箭追着回家啊。山丘上见！ 那个长着鹰爪的窃贼转身准备离开，却突然停了下来，然后跳回来，在你的嘴唇上留下一个热烈而深情的吻，随后便冲出窗外，再次展翅飞走了。

Ihzalti [rand|is cleaning the webbing-lined walls, looking over her shoulder at you with a brief glance before setting her rag down. Miraculously, the webbing looks clean but none of it comes off with her rag.|looks up, gently petting her rodent and having him outside of his cage for once. Miro wiggles around in her palms, giving a solitary peep whilst the oracle beams a warm smile your way. She sets him down in his cage, gently clicking the panel on its top shut.|jumps and shakes, catching herself with her normal hands. The spider girl is low to the ground... wait, was she dozing off? You raise a hand but she hastily blushes and smiles, righting herself and clearing her throat.] "O-One moment," Ihz chimes, brushing her exposed stomach and gently adjusting her tits-clinging cloak. "I am always eager to have company!" You make your way over and settle down into the seat, smiling at the drider and waiting for her to properly gather her cards and face you. Ihzalti's demeanor immediately shifts, maintaining that usual energetic vibe and radiating the usual warm grin. "So, [pc.name], what can I and little Miro do for you today?"[party.has arona| Your orcish friend chuckles, leaning back on one hand and gently elbowing you. "She actually calls that fat mouse little, can you believe it?"]

rows.original:
You cautiously make your way down the stairs and right alongside the moss, [party.som|setting your hand along the green-addled surface|waving [party.compNames] back whilst setting your hand into the fuzzy surface-plant|waving both of your friends a bit back and touching the plant curiously]. But when your palm suddenly halts as if snared, you raise a brow and pull. The moss lets you pull all of an inch away before snapping you back. Panicking and grabbing a rock on the wall nearby, you push yourself harder and finally, come loose.
    
    But at the same time, the rock you'd grabbed for a handhold sinks deep into the chasm wall. The mossy surface flings out and nearly slams into you, raising up and skyward like a hatch door. All the rock beneath it comes with it, snaring itself with silky webbing and pulling taut along the ceiling to keep it from falling back down. The wall's open cavern invites you inside, leading deep into an ancient-looking chamber. White webbing in various thickness and amount lines the floor and walls with perfect scrutiny. The darkness within that you expect, however, is absent; red crystals warmly flood the tunnel with lighting, yet lack the intensity to light up more than ten feet ahead of you.

    Readying your [pc.weapon][party.som|| and curling a finger for [comp1.name] to follow you| and waving to your party to follow], you venture into the cave slow and methodical. The silk beneath you seems no different than that lining the back of the door, yet you don't stick. It muffles your footfalls like a fine fur rug without hindering your steps.
    
    "No further," a soft voice calls from the darkness beyond the short illumination. "I-I do not wish to hurt you!"

    You aren't sure what to make of the threat... but you do know that the voice sounds far too gentle to be telling the truth. "Come out of the dark, then! [pc.isDK|I have no time for games.|It's only fair if we can see each other, right?]" The silence that follows is unsettling, yet you hold your ground. You're not lowering your weapon until you can assure your own safety. "Last chance, then. [pc.isDK|I'll come in and|I'll be leaving if you insist on hidin]-"
    
    All the crystals erupt with brilliant light, flooding your gaze and forcing your eyes shut. Whether this is an attack or not, you're left powerlessly blind and exposed. Yet nothing comes after your vision's disruption. Receding luminosity finally lets you open your eyes; rather than seeing darkness, the cave opens up when your arm falls. You can see [a] [flags.DRIDER_MET|drider|large spider-like] woman resting beside a low-sitting table in a newly illuminated chamber. The darkness is completely gone, letting you see a large bed of web and straw with many blankets. Atop the center of the table is a small cage with a small mouse, its belly nice and fat; it's obviously heavily spoiled and well-cared for.
    
    However, the woman beckons your attention; she's only about six feet tall despite her impressively-sized spider half. Beautiful white fur adorns most of her legs save for the length nearest her body, mottling black and gold before transitioning into her figure. Her spider body and abdomen's fur, in contrast, is a beautiful pattern of the two colors, helping mask her black chitin and running all the way to her wide human hips in a thick, warm coat. Fair-skinned with a thicker ring of fur hiding her groin, her perky nipples are all but visible beneath her fur-lined cloak. She wears it untied with nothing underneath, tastefully following her curves so that it hides only her D-cup tits' teats. The mysterious spider's shoulder-length black hair is a mix of straight and braids, every few inches of the beautiful locks sporting a new twisting braid bound within engraved bronze bands. All four of her black eyes watch you, petting the top of a small iron cage whilst waving to the opposite end of the table.
    
    "Come closer," she whispers. "Allow me to apologize. I rarely get company these days. My name... is Ihzalti; you may call me Oracle Ihz or Oracle, if you so desire. Miro and I had foreseen [party.som|a guest|guests|guests] but one does not merely know the precise nature of the future. Tell me; what is your name?"
    
    "[pc.name]." You answer and approach, keeping your weapon in hand for now. "[flags.DRIDER_MET|You're a drider, aren't you?|What are you?]"
    
    [flags.DRIDER_MET|She nods, smiling and bringing her free hand up to her braids. Ihzalti's finger touches along the bands, tapping each one. "These are the only things I retained from my nest. My mother — a queen — allowed me to leave due to overpopulation in our nest. Such things happen... yet it's unusual for a stranger to recognize my kind. Have you met others?"|Ihzalti sets her hand on her bosom, nearly exposing one of her nipples entirely from brushing her coat open. "I am known as a drider. More specifically, I am of the winter driders. My people are quite rare, so I understand you not knowing what I am... but I am certain the two of us can be friends. I'm far from hostile, don't you agree?"]
    
    You nod, putting away your [pc.weapon] for now. Unlike [flags.DRIDER_MET|the other driders|most of the Foothills' inhabitants] you've met, she seems completely docile; not to mention if she had really wanted to, she could have likely thrown you out the door and down the chasm. Settling down[party.som|| with [comp1.name]| with [party.compNames]] at her table, you can't fathom where to begin immediately. But the warm, glowing smile of your hostess awaits your next move patiently: she clearly is happy to have the company.
rows.translation:
你小心翼翼地沿着楼梯往下走，足部步紧贴着长满苔藓的墙壁。 [party.som|将手放在那片被绿色物质覆盖的表面上|挥手 [party.compNames] 在将手伸入那些柔软的植物表面时，你向后退了一步。|你向两位朋友挥了挥手，然后好奇地摸了摸那株植物。]但是，当你的手掌突然被什么东西抓住，无法继续移动时，你挑了挑眉毛，用力一拉。苔藓允许你拉出一英寸的距离，然后又立刻将你拉了回去。你慌忙抓起旁边墙上的石头，再次用力一拉，终于摆脱了束缚。
    
    但与此同时，你用来抓住的岩石却深深地嵌入了峡谷的墙壁之中。那长满苔藓的表面突然向外弹出，几乎撞到了你的身上，然后像一扇舱门一样向上翘起。岩石下方所有的部分都随之被拉了起来，那些柔软的“网状物”将它们紧紧固定住，使它们无法重新掉落下去。 墙壁上那道敞开的洞口邀请你走进去，它通向一个看起来极为古老的房间。各种厚度和数量的白色丝状物整齐地覆盖在地板和墙壁上。然而，你原本期待的暗影并不存在——红色的水晶散发着温暖的轻型芒，照亮了隧道，但其亮度仅足以照亮你前方十英尺以内的范围而已。

    准备中 [pc.weapon][party.som|| 然后伸出手指示意 [comp1.name] 跟随你| 同时向你的队友们挥手，示意他们跟上。]你小心翼翼地走进洞穴。足部下的丝质触感与门后衬里的材质并无不同，但你的足部步却丝毫没有受阻，这种柔软的触感就像一块精致的毛皮地毯，既不会妨碍你的行动，也不会发出任何声音。

“不要再往前走了，”一个柔和的声音从暗影中传来，“我……我真的不想伤害你！”

你不确定该如何理解这个威胁……但你知道，这个声音听起来实在太过温柔，不像是在说真话。“那就出来吧，从暗影中出来！ [pc.isDK|我根本没有时间玩游戏。|如果我们能够见面，那就公平了吧？]随之而来的寂静令人不安，但你依然坚守着自己的立场。在确保自身安全之前，你绝不会放下手中的武器。那么，现在就是最后的机会了。 [pc.isDK|我这就进去。|如果你们坚持要隐瞒的话，我就走了。]所有的水晶都迸发出耀眼的轻型芒，刺得你睁不开眼睛，迫使你闭上眼帘。无论这是否是一种攻击，你都陷入了无助的暗影之中，毫无防备。然而，在你的视线被干扰之后，并没有发生什么进一步的动作。当轻型芒逐渐减弱时，你终于可以睁开眼睛了——映入眼帘的并不是暗影，而是当你的手臂落下时，洞穴重新敞开了，你能够看到了。 [a] [flags.DRIDER_MET|骑手|像大型蜘蛛一样的] 一位女子坐在一间刚刚被照亮的小房间里，身旁放着一张低矮的桌子。暗影已经完全消失，你可以看到一张铺着厚厚蛛网和稻草的床，上面还盖着许多毯子。桌子的中央放着一个小笼子，里面有一只小老鼠，它的肚子圆滚滚的，显然被宠得非常娇惯，也得到了很好的照顾。
    
    然而，这个女人吸引了你的注意；尽管她的下半身像蜘蛛一样，但她的身高也只有大约六英尺。她的大部分腿部都覆盖着美丽的白色毛发，只有靠近身体的那部分毛发呈现出黑色和金色的斑纹，然后逐渐过渡到她的身躯上。 相比之下，她那蜘蛛般的身体以及腹部的毛发呈现出两种颜色构成的美丽图案，这种图案有助于掩盖她身上的黑色几丁质外衣，这些毛发一直延伸到她那宽大的臀部，形成一层厚厚而温暖的覆盖层。她拥有白皙的皮肤，腹股沟处有一圈较厚的毛发，这使得她的乳头几乎完全隐藏在毛发形成的遮蔽之下。 她将这条腰带系得松松的，里面什么也没穿，这种搭配巧妙地突出了她的身材曲线，只让她的D罩杯大小的胸部微微被遮住。那头及肩长的黑色头发既有直发也有编发，每隔几英寸，这些美丽的秀发上就会有一道用青铜饰带编织而成的新辫子。 她那四只黑色的眼睛全都盯着你，一边轻轻抚摸着一个小铁笼的顶部，一边朝桌子的另一端挥着手。
    
    靠近一些，”她轻声说道，“让我向您道歉。这些天我很少有人陪伴。我的名字是伊扎尔蒂；如果您愿意，可以叫我伊扎尔提神谕或简称神谕。米罗和我之前就预见到了 [party.som|一位客人|客人|客人] 但人们并不能真正了解未来的确切走向。告诉我，你叫什么名字？[pc.name]你回答他的问题，然后靠近他，不过现在还是要握紧你的武器。[flags.DRIDER_MET|你是个骑手，对吧？|你到底是什么东西？]"
    
    [flags.DRIDER_MET|她微笑着点了点头，然后用空着的那只手抚了抚自己的辫子。伊扎尔蒂的手指沿着那些辫带轻轻滑动，逐一触摸着每一根辫子。“这些是我从自己的巢穴里带出来的唯一东西。我的母亲——一位女王——因为我们的巢穴里人口过多，才允许我离开的。这种事情确实会发生……不过，一个陌生人能够认出我的种族，实在是很不寻常。你以前遇到过其他人吗？|伊扎尔蒂将手放在胸前，由于外套被掀开，她的其中一个乳头几乎完全暴露了出来。“人们都叫我‘飞龙骑士’。更准确地说，我是属于冬季飞龙骑士一族的。我们这类人非常稀少，所以我能理解你不知道我是什么……但我相信我们完全可以成为朋友。我绝对没有敌意，对吧？]
    
    你点了点头，然后把东西收了起来。 [pc.weapon] 至少目前来说，情况并非如此。与……不同。 [flags.DRIDER_MET|其他那些飞行生物|大多数福希尔斯地区的居民] 你们应该已经见过面了，她看起来似乎非常温顺；更不用说，如果她真的想的话，完全可以把你扔出门外，扔进深渊里去。总之，她现在已经安定下来了。[party.som|| 与……一起 [comp1.name]| 与……一起 [party.compNames]] 坐在她的桌旁，你一时竟不知该从哪里开始交谈。但女主人的温暖笑容耐心地等待着你的下一步行动——显然，她非常高兴有你的陪伴。

rows.original: Treading carefully through the Foothills [party.som||with your companion |with your companions ]while on the lookout for more pesky mercenaries, it wasn't hard figuring out that your luck wasn't going to hold out. But unlike the whistling of an arrow or the unsheathing of blades, a commanding and strong effeminate voice booms across the spacious foothills; putting it lightly, it might be one of the loudest voices you've ever heard. "Halt! Go no further!" A powerful whinny follows the words seconds later, the heavy thudding of hooves clapping through the air. Its owner — a horse — bursts into view, its silver-dapple hide and cavalry harness ferrying its master and marking it as a purebred steed of very selective breeding and care. It's master's stature places her just a bit taller than five feet tall, bearing a familiar emblem on her shoulder akin to the mark all the mercenaries you keep running into have born in their pauldrons. Her well-kept and shined bronze breastplate conceals any sort of chest she could tout, fitted to her form and built without the traditionally appealing curves of less practical armor. Rugged gauntlets and greaves add to her armaments and further prevent any eye candy from slipping into view. To put it lightly, she's equipped with and for a single purpose: battle. Circling [party.som|you|the two of you|all of you] once and reaching her right hand for a spear strung along the side of her stallion, the most glaring difference from all the mercenaries you've met so far is that this well-geared woman is unusually choosing to not wear a helmet; instead, it dangles from a chain on the side of her saddle likely so she can wear it only as needed. In a simple and wavy cut, her black hair runs down to her shoulders with licks of green dye acting as highlights. You notice a black eyepatch clad over her left eye while the other eye as deep a green as her hair hints; lacks any sort of fine detailing compared to her extravagant battle gear. Even her face is unsullied by the makeup a woman might wear; light freckling dots her pale complexion and she easily maintains the beautiful and youthful splendor of a woman in her twenties without the aid of such things. But your chance for observation is cut short as the woman draws and aims the spear's tip your face, halting her mount in front of you. "Make no moves miscreant! I am looking for those who have been harassing Leofric's mighty legion known as the Marked Merk Mercenaries! All the clues and their paths have lead me here, to you! What say you; are you one of the hooligans resisting their efforts to suppress this region's pests?" You stand your ground but you know you're in that number. Of course, you're pretty certain that it's you who has been harassed from how often the bandit-like soldiers have tried mugging you. "If you are truly of their number then you should know I am the second-in-command of the mercenaries! My name is Jennavieve Galanis, the lieutenant of the Marked Mercs and their acting, temporary-commander! My foes know me as the One-Eyed Lancer, pride of its cavalry regiment! I shall not repeat myself so speak quickly and tell me who you are before I run you through!" [silly|Wait a second, one-eyed lancers exist? But her depth perception must be horrible! The fact she's riding a horse you can believe but accurately stabbing with her lance? Come on now, what is this fantasy-level bullshit?|Well at least you know who she is, even if she hasn't let you get a word in.] With a mouthful of a name and a reputation like hers, you almost feel bad giving her your answer of %"[pc.name], [pc.title]." "[pc.name]?" Her eye looks you up and down, [party.som|studying your equipment|studying your equipment and then your ally's|studying yours and your companion's equipment] before she continues. "Very well, you may call me by my name or rank. [pc.isHeight 70|You are certainly imposing enough in looks but are you really the one who has been hindering my mercenaries and our search?|But certainly you cannot be the one who-... well... are you the one who has been hindering our search for Leofric?]"
rows.translation: 小心翼翼地穿越山麓 [party.som||和你的同伴一起 |和你的朋友们一起 ]在四处搜寻那些讨厌的雇佣兵时，不难就意识到，你的运气已经到了尽头。 然而，与箭矢呼啸的声音或刀刃出鞘的声响不同，一个充满威严且富有磁性的柔弱声音在广阔的山坡间回荡开来；坦白说，这可能是你听过的最响亮的声音之一了。站住！ 不要再往前走了！” 几秒钟后，一声响亮的马嘶声响起，重型的马蹄声在空气中回荡。它的主人——一匹马——立刻出现在视野中。它那银斑相间的皮毛以及骑兵用的马具，既体现了主人的身份，也说明这匹马是经过精心挑选和培育而成的纯种良马。 她的身材使她的高度略超过五英尺，肩上佩戴着一个熟悉的徽章，就像那些你经常遇到的雇佣兵们胸前佩戴的标记一样。她那保养得当、闪闪发亮的青铜胸甲完美地贴合她的身体曲线，虽然缺乏那些传统上被认为更具吸引力的装饰性线条，但却更加贴合实际需求。 她佩戴着结实的护手和护腿，这些装备进一步增强了她的防护能力，同时也有效地遮挡了任何可能吸引他人注意的美丽部位。坦白说，她的装备完全是为一个目的而设计的：战斗。 她正在盘旋着 [party.som|你|你们两个|你们所有人] 她立刻伸手去拿放在自己坐骑旁边的长矛。与迄今为止你遇到的所有雇佣兵相比，这个装备精良的女子最显眼的不同之处在于，她竟然选择不戴头盔——而是将头盔挂在马鞍旁的链子上，这样只有在需要的时候才会戴上它。 她的一头黑色头发剪成简洁的波浪形，垂至肩部，其中还点缀着一些绿色染发，形成了醒目的点缀。你可以看到她的左眼上戴着黑色眼罩，而另一只眼睛则呈现出与她的头发相同的深绿色。与她那些华丽的战斗装备相比，她的装扮显得相当简单，几乎没有任何复杂的装饰细节。 就连她的面容也完全没有女性通常会涂抹的化妆品的痕迹；淡黄色的雀斑点缀在她白皙的肌肤上，而她完全不需要借助这些化妆品，就能始终保持二十多岁女性应有的美丽与年轻活力。 但是，你的观察机会被突然中断了——那个女人拔出长矛，将矛尖对准你的脸，让她的坐骑停在了你面前。 “别动！我要找的就是那些一直在骚扰利奥弗里克麾下那支被称为‘标记者佣兵’的强大军团的人！所有的线索和踪迹都把我引到了这里，找到了你！你说呢，你是不是那些阻碍他们消灭这个地区害虫的混混之一？ 你坚守着自己的立场，但你也明白自己属于那群人之中。当然，你也很确定 你 那些像强盗一样的士兵频频试图抢劫你，因此你肯定受到了骚扰。 “如果你真的是他们的一员，那么你应该知道我是这些雇佣军的副指挥官！我的名字是詹娜薇芙·加拉尼斯，是‘标记雇佣军’的副官，同时也是他们的临时指挥官！我的敌人都认识我，他们称我为‘独眼长矛手’，那是他们骑兵军团的骄傲！我不会再重复了，快告诉我你是谁，否则我就立刻杀了你！ [silly|等一下，竟然有独眼长矛手这种存在？那她的深度感知能力肯定糟透了！她能骑马，这还能让人相信，但能用长矛精准地刺中目标？拜托，这简直就是幻想小说里的荒谬情节吧？|至少你知道她是谁了，尽管她根本没给你机会说话。] 考虑到她的名字以及她的名声，当你告诉她你的答案是“%”时，你甚至会感到有些内疚。[pc.name], [pc.title]." "[pc.name]？”她的目轻型上下打量着你， [party.som|检查你的装备|先检查自己的装备，然后再观察盟友的情况。|正在研究你和你的同伴所使用的装备。] 在她继续说道之前：“好吧，你们可以叫我名字，也可以称呼我的职位。 [pc.isHeight 70|你的外貌确实十分出众，但真的是你一直在阻碍我的雇佣兵们以及我们的搜寻工作吗？|不过，当然可以。 你 不可能是你吧……嗯……难道就是你在阻碍我们寻找利奥弗里克吗？]"
rows.raw: " Treading carefully through the Foothills [party.som||with your companion |with your companions ]while on the lookout for more pesky mercenaries, it wasn't hard figuring out that your luck wasn't going to hold out. But unlike the whistling of an arrow or the unsheathing of blades, a commanding and strong effeminate voice booms across the spacious foothills; putting it lightly, it might be one of the loudest voices you've ever heard. "Halt! Go no further!" A powerful whinny follows the words seconds later, the heavy thudding of hooves clapping through the air. Its owner — a horse — bursts into view, its silver-dapple hide and cavalry harness ferrying its master and marking it as a purebred steed of very selective breeding and care. It's master's stature places her just a bit taller than five feet tall, bearing a familiar emblem on her shoulder akin to the mark all the mercenaries you keep running into have born in their pauldrons. Her well-kept and shined bronze breastplate conceals any sort of chest she could tout, fitted to her form and built without the traditionally appealing curves of less practical armor. Rugged gauntlets and greaves add to her armaments and further prevent any eye candy from slipping into view. To put it lightly, she's equipped with and for a single purpose: battle. Circling [party.som|you|the two of you|all of you] once and reaching her right hand for a spear strung along the side of her stallion, the most glaring difference from all the mercenaries you've met so far is that this well-geared woman is unusually choosing to not wear a helmet; instead, it dangles from a chain on the side of her saddle likely so she can wear it only as needed. In a simple and wavy cut, her black hair runs down to her shoulders with licks of green dye acting as highlights. You notice a black eyepatch clad over her left eye while the other eye as deep a green as her hair hints; lacks any sort of fine detailing compared to her extravagant battle gear. Even her face is unsullied by the makeup a woman might wear; light freckling dots her pale complexion and she easily maintains the beautiful and youthful splendor of a woman in her twenties without the aid of such things. But your chance for observation is cut short as the woman draws and aims the spear's tip your face, halting her mount in front of you. "Make no moves miscreant! I am looking for those who have been harassing Leofric's mighty legion known as the Marked Merk Mercenaries! All the clues and their paths have lead me here, to you! What say you; are you one of the hooligans resisting their efforts to suppress this region's pests?" You stand your ground but you know you're in that number. Of course, you're pretty certain that it's you who has been harassed from how often the bandit-like soldiers have tried mugging you. "If you are truly of their number then you should know I am the second-in-command of the mercenaries! My name is Jennavieve Galanis, the lieutenant of the Marked Mercs and their acting, temporary-commander! My foes know me as the One-Eyed Lancer, pride of its cavalry regiment! I shall not repeat myself so speak quickly and tell me who you are before I run you through!" [silly|Wait a second, one-eyed lancers exist? But her depth perception must be horrible! The fact she's riding a horse you can believe but accurately stabbing with her lance? Come on now, what is this fantasy-level bullshit?|Well at least you know who she is, even if she hasn't let you get a word in.] With a mouthful of a name and a reputation like hers, you almost feel bad giving her your answer of %"[pc.name], [pc.title]." "[pc.name]?" Her eye looks you up and down, [party.som|studying your equipment|studying your equipment and then your ally's|studying yours and your companion's equipment] before she continues. "Very well, you may call me by my name or rank. [pc.isHeight 70|You are certainly imposing enough in looks but are you really the one who has been hindering my mercenaries and our search?|But certainly you cannot be the one who-... well... are you the one who has been hindering our search for Leofric?]""

rows.original:
You admit that you've been getting attacked but you knew nothing about a search. The mercenary company's members have been exclusively trying to rob or rape you every time you've met. You might have maybe picked a fight or two more than you needed to but they definitely started it.

        Your admission catches the woman off-guard; her eye looks over her shoulder toward the hill she arrived from in a bit of disgust. Tugging her steed's reins in one hand, she solemnly guides her horse to face away from you before turning her gaze to you with a disheartened sigh.
        
        "I had suspicions that I wasn't getting the full story... it's good that I found out the truth, even if from a stranger."
        
        Wait... she actually believes you?
        
        "Of course I do." She turns her head enough so that all you can see is her eyepatch, effectively putting you in a blind spot. "I have no reason to not believe the locals; it fits that we have some... unfortunate bad eggs among our ranks. Most of the Marked Merk Mercenaries are refugees from our war-torn country and homeland, after all. Mercenaries come from more walks of life than we'd care to admit but being rough around the edges is to be expected... so allow me to apologize for that unruly bunch."
        
        Well if that's the case... you have to admit that you were at least a bit curious about her strength. After a big entrance like that it'd be-
        
        "If I or my men meet you again, we will come to blows."
        
        [silly|There it is!|Wait, what?] You wait until she turns and looks over her shoulder at you yet again. Why did she hold onto it that long? While the exercise can be fun, this fight is far from necessary for them.
        
        "It's precisely because you've been besting us, actually; we have a reputation to uphold and cannot allow someone to hinder us when they don't command an army against our ranks. All of us were hired by someone from this region to help restore order as well. Before our commander Leofric vanished, we were doing quite well at facing down these harpies and even combating some of the orcs in the area. Unfortunately, the majority of our soldiers aren't large enough nor experienced enough these days to take on... unorthodox foes like these. And now we're starting to even lose to you..."
        
        Turning her nose up, the woman's expression became one of anger.
        
        "Leofric would simply sleep with an opponent or their leader but he maintained some semblance of order by wrestling them down if they still weren't content with keeping things rather orderly. I don't approve of my mentor and commander being so open... but it worked." Her face flushes red momentarily before she grumpily steers and starts her horse forward, calling back to you one final time as the distance grew between you.
        
        "But without him, we're now in a dire strait of inexperience. So I hope you can help train our riffraff extensively if you meet on the field. I too will test my own spear against you if we meet again however. Try to maintain some standard of honor, though; I am not some beast like the rest of my men. I will be more than happy to show you that in battle lest you choose to yield. I have no time for cowards or weaklings."
        
        Jen's back slips away over the hill and the trotting clops of her horse's hooves become distant. You sigh in a mix of relief and annoyance; while you've avoided trouble for now, you can't help but sense a fight with this woman will be far tougher than the ones you've had against the other mercenaries.
rows.translation:
你承认自己确实遭到了袭击，但你对那次搜查一无所知。每次与那些雇佣兵会面时，他们唯一的目的就是抢劫或强奸你。也许你确实主动挑起了那么一两次争端，但绝对是他们先动手的。

        你的这番话让那位女子措手不及；她厌恶地回头望向自己刚刚来的那座山。她一手拽着马绳，严肃地让马转过身去，不再面向你，然后才失望地再次将目光转向你。
        
        我总觉得有些事情没有被告知全貌……幸好我终于知道了真相，哪怕是听一个陌生人说的。”

等等……她居然相信你的话？

“当然相信了。”她转过头，只让你看到她的眼罩，这样一来，你就完全被她蒙在鼓里了。 我没有理由不相信当地人的说法；毕竟，我们当中确实存在一些……不良分子。大多数‘标记者佣兵’其实都是来自我们这个饱受战争摧残的国家的难民。佣兵们来自各种各样的社会阶层，这一点我们也不愿承认，但他们性格粗犷、行事直率，这也是可以预料到的。所以，请允许我为那一群不听话的人道歉。
        
        嗯，如果是这样的话……你总得承认，你对她真正的实力至少是有点好奇的。以那样的方式登场之后，接下来肯定会发生……

“如果我或者我的手下再遇到你，我们就决一死战。
        
        [silly|就是它了！|等等，什么？] 你就等着看她再次转过身来，回头看你的吧。她为什么要把那个东西留那么久呢？虽然这样的练习确实挺有趣的，但这场争斗对他们来说其实完全没有必要。

“其实，正是因为你们一直都在打败我们，所以我们才不得不这么做；我们有着自己的声誉需要维护，不能允许某个没有军队来与我们对抗的人阻碍我们前进。 我们所有人都是被这个地区的某位人士雇佣来协助恢复秩序的。在我们的指挥官利奥弗里克失踪之前，我们在对付这些女妖以及消灭该地区的一些兽人方面表现得相当不错。 不幸的是，如今我们的大多数士兵要么体型不够高大，要么经验不足，根本无法应对这样的非传统敌人。现在，我们甚至开始在比赛中输给你们了……
        
        那女人撇了撇嘴，脸上露出了愤怒的表情。

“利奥弗里克只会和对手或他们的首领发生关系，但如果对方仍然不满足于保持秩序的话，他就会把他们制服，以此来维持某种表面的秩序。我并不赞同我的导师兼指挥官如此放纵……但这种方法确实有效。”她的脸瞬间涨得通红，然后不高兴地催促马匹前进，随着距离逐渐拉大，她最后还冲你喊了一句。
        
        但没有他，我们现在确实陷入了因缺乏经验而带来的困境。因此，我希望如果在战场上相遇，你能帮助对我们这些新兵进行全面的训练。当然，如果再次交战，我也会用我的长矛与你较量。不过，请尽量保持一定的荣誉准则——我可不像我的那些手下那样野蛮。如果你们选择投降，我很乐意在战斗中证明这一点。我对懦夫和弱者可没有耐心。
        
        珍已经翻过了那座小山，她马蹄的轻快蹄声也逐渐远去。你既感到宽慰，又有些恼火——虽然暂时躲过了麻烦，但你不禁意识到，与这个女人交手，将会比你之前对付那些雇佣兵时困难得多。

rows.original:
Why would you admit to having fought the mercenaries all this time? You're just some traveler minding their own business; really, it's not that far from the full truth. But even before the words finish leaving your mouth, the horse-rider's demeanor sours with a scowl, squeezing her spear and lowering her back slightly into a readied ride.

        "As expected! I knew you would lie! I came to hear the other side of things but my men described you well enough to find you! You couldn't even pass a simple test of honesty and confess yourself!? By Leofric's axes, I'll show you the true fury of the Marked Merk Mercenaries!"
        
        Raising her spear and trotting around to square up with you, you're certain that it's too late to get out of this. [party.som|You|The two of you|All of you] quickly ready [party.som|yourself|yourselves|yourselves] for battle!
rows.translation:
你为什么要承认自己这段时间一直在与那些雇佣兵战斗呢？你不过是个只想安安静静过日子的旅行者罢了；说实在的，这个说法其实已经很接近真相了。但话还没说完，那个骑马的人就已经面露怒容，紧紧握住长矛，微微挺直身子，准备随时出发。

        果然如此！我就知道你会撒谎！我来这里本来是想了解事情的真相，但我的手下们把你的品行描述得非常清楚，所以我终于找到了你！你连这么简单的诚实测试都通不过，竟然还要自己承认真相吗！？以利奥弗里克的斧头起誓，我会让你见识到‘被标记的默克佣兵’真正的愤怒！她举起了长矛，小跑着朝你冲过来，准备与你交战——你顿时意识到，现在想要逃脱已经太晚了。 [party.som|你|你们两个|你们所有人] 迅速准备就绪 [party.som|你自己|你们自己|你们自己] 准备战斗吧！

rows.original: Atop a black, silver-dapple steed similar to a Shire-breed horse, you can clearly identify the female commander of the Marked Merk Mercenaries. A short woman coming around 5'2", Jen sits atop it with a bronze-tipped spear clasped in her right hand and her horse's reins held tightly in the left. The muted, bronze glimmer of her heavy armor worn over her puffy orange pantaloons and a black undershirt provides ample protection; albeit without helmet, she gets the benefit of an intimidating snarl and perfect opportunity to glare at you with her good eye.
rows.translation: 骑在一只外形类似夏尔马的黑银相间的骏马背上，人们可以清楚地认出那位“标记之佣兵团”的女指挥官。珍身高约5英尺2英寸，她右手握着一把矛柄末端镀有青铜的长矛，左手紧紧地牵着马绳，坐在马背上。 她穿着厚重的铠甲，铠甲上散发着暗淡的青铜色光芒；这套铠甲与她那蓬松的橙色裤子和黑色内衣搭配在一起，为她提供了足够的保护。虽然没有头盔，但她那张令人生畏的面孔，以及她那只完好的眼睛，都让她有了瞪视他人的绝佳机会。

rows.original: [rand |"So you yield!? I never would have thought you a coward; perhaps I was wrong to think you a worthy adversary!" |"I've faced pixies more intimidating than you! Do you dare run from battle!? Pathetic and despicable!" |"Why are you running? Why are you running!? Ha! Yellow-blooded scum!" |"Does defeat catch you by the nerves, [pc.name]? rows.original: With the battle over and Jen on the ground as per usual, you can empathize with the headstrong lass and her growing scowl. How many times can she throw herself at you and keep losing before it's one too many? The raven-haired lancer's sapping strength and tiring change to a frown seem to mark it well however; Jen squeezes handfuls of dirt vainly between her fingers, hissing between her teeth with disdain and futility plaguing her voice. "I... I keep losing again and again! By Tira and Sorra's supple bodies, how am I such a failure?" Well this is a conundrum; how do you even start? Words are hard enough as is but as you approach her, you have to at least give her some credit. There are many things she does right after all, even if she can't best you. It isn't like her loses make her an incompetent warrior — it just means she's losing to someone who's strong. "I..." Her eye squints, tears welling beneath it as she looks to her spear. "I still shouldn't lose so-" "Jennavieve!" The boom of a deep, whiskey-soaked voice draws your attention upward as a near-ethereal figure blocks out the [dayNight|sun|moon]light.
rows.translation: 战斗已经结束，而珍像往常一样倒在地上。你完全能够理解这个固执的女孩以及她那越来越浓重的愁容。她还能再多少次冲向你，然后一次又一次地失败呢？然而，那个黑发长矛手那令人精疲力竭的力量，以及她那逐渐浮现的愁容，似乎都在清楚地表明：这一次，可能真的是最后一次了。珍徒劳地用手指抓取着泥土，咬牙切齿地发出嘶嘶声，那种失望与无助的情绪充斥着她的整个心灵。 我……我一次又一次地失败！看在蒂拉和索拉那柔美身躯的份上，我怎么会这么差劲呢？” 这确实是个难题……该从哪里开始说呢？轻型是组织语言就已经很困难了，而当你真正想要接近她、跟她说话时，至少得先 一些 值得肯定的是，她确实做对了很多事情，即使她无法战胜你。她的失败并不意味着她是一个无能的战士——这只说明她输给了一个更强大的人罢了。 “我……”她眯起眼睛，泪水在眼眶中打转，同时望向自己的长矛。“我本来不应该输的 珍娜薇芙！ 一个低沉而充满威士忌气息的声音突然响起，你的注意力立刻被吸引住了——一个仿佛来自天际的神秘身影挡在了你的视线前方 [dayNight|太阳|月亮]轻型。

rows.original: [var0 |You dodge right, bounding out of the way seconds before a man almost three whole feet taller than the average human [silly |superhero lands |crashes into the ground ]. Despite how durable the rocky ground of the Foothills are, the simple connection of hand-on-stone splinters and crumbles the immediate area around it. A punch like that would have knocked you out with ease if you weren't so fast. The man stands upright with a devilish, satisfied smirk. "You dodged it," he boasts, shaking his hand free of the crumbled stone dust. The other hand, though, lowers a massive axe down from his other shoulder, its thick bronze blade crashing down almost as hard as the punch just from its weight. "It must be you Tira sent me to meet, [pc.name]!" The lieutenant gasps and shakily clambers to her feet, her eyes transfixed on the back of the man. Despite being beaten by you, Jen's energy is anything but lacking in the presence of this unusual reinforcement. "Leofric! We must head back! I've been looking all over for you and-" The human titan doesn't even look back at her, simply waving back dismissively at her. "Silence, Jennavieve! This is the reason I came here! My greatest battle is now — I want to enjoy it properly!" [flags.JEN_TALKED_LEOFRIC |This is the man she talked about: Commander Leofric. |You don't know who this Leofric is but you can tell this isn't going to be easy. ] The man's torso and arms are covered in tattoos dedicated to the Goddess of Death; he isn't wearing anything to guard his torso besides a pair of massive pauldrons and a gorget around his neck, the crackle of tar black lightning racing along the lines of his muscles. His brilliant blonde hair streaks a few strands of gray, too, as if the man is settling down. "I came all this way just to meet you. To find out the one who was giving my Jennavieve such a hard time... you must have no idea who you're dealing with! But that's better for both of us: it's time I enjoy myself a bit!" He shifts the axe into his other hand and lifts it again, cracking his neck and quickly looking back at the defeated lieutenant. "You got it? Get out of here! You're in the way!" She flinches and bites her lip, clenching her hands into fists beneath his scorn. Leofric doesn't look back at her again, but it does the trick; Jen gets up and whistles, summoning her steed to her side and remounting. Despite the sense of defeat she had held, the appearance of her commander settles her emotion near instantly. She starts riding off and looks back, yelling at his back. "Fine! But don't think I'll just let you get away the next time I see you, Leofric! We need you back with us!" The lieutenant leaves you and the air between you and the giant man grows frigid. He stares at you for several seconds, squeezing the grip of his axe so hard you can hear the bronze groan – and then finally relents. Taking a breath, he stands up and relaxes. "Not yet," he mutters. "Not yet..." With that, he turns and leaves – not in the direction Jen was going, either. That was a strange encounter, to say the least. rows.translation: [var0 |你及时向右躲开，在那个身高比普通人高出将近三英尺的男子即将撞上你的瞬间，成功避开了危险。 [silly |超级英雄之地 |重重摔在地上 ]尽管山足部地区的岩石地面非常坚硬，但用石头碎片简单拼凑而成的武器，依然足以摧毁其周围的区域。 如果你的反应没有那么快的话，那样一拳肯定足以把你击晕。 那个男人挺直身子，脸上带着一副邪恶而满足的 smirk。 “你躲过了一劫，”他得意地说道，一边将沾满碎石灰尘的手部甩了甩。而他的另一只手部，则从另一侧肩膀上放下了一柄巨大的斧头——那厚重的青铜斧头，仅仅因为自身的重量，落下的力量就几乎与刚才那一拳相当。 一定是你，蒂拉让我来见你的 [pc.name]中尉倒吸一口冷气，颤抖着站了起来，她的目轻型紧紧盯着那个男人的背影。尽管被你打败了，但在这个不寻常的支援者的帮助下，珍依然充满了活力。 rows.original: Jenna needs to relax; you start by helping her up to her feet — much to her shock — and take a step back to give her some space. So there's definitely no need for any further fighting unless she's dead-set on getting fucked or punched. "Oh. Um... so you... aren't going to do something to me? I don't know what to say, really; I er... guess we can talk. Don't think that this makes us friends or that I'll forgive your actions though!" Her right hand shifts over her armor-clad chest before thumping against it defiantly, Jen smirking right at you as if she didn't just get embarrassed in battle. "Next time, I'm going to best you and undo this blemish upon my honor and the honor of my fellow mercenaries for sure. And claim bragging rights of course!"

rows.original: Since you've got her attention, now seems the perfect time to get the rundown on her mercenary company. Specifically, you're curious about why they're even here. Are they just in it to harass the locals? "Of course not." Jen's answer carries a sharp and baffled inflection, the one-eyed lieutenant setting one of her hands to her hip before poking your [pc.chest] with the other gauntlet-clad hand. "We were hired by a specific someone to handle a specific problem. And that's all you're going to get to learn about that; we have a confidentiality clause with our employers!" Well, that didn't go far; but thankfully it seems it's about to bear fruit; Jen is already turning so that you can see the symbol etched into her pauldron. "The Marked Merk Mercenaries hail from the southeast, out beyond the sea. Specifically, we hail from Tronarii; the land of shimmering bronze." [var0 |This isn't the first time you've heard the name; what's her take on the nation? |You've never heard of Tronarii; what's it like there that caused the mercenaries to leave and come all the way here? ] "For one; weather. Tronarii is... very warm compared to the more traditional weather and chill winds of the ol' Marches. As the name might imply, though, Tronarii has a reputation; it provides more bronze than any other nation in the world. Whether it be weapons, armor, tools... most bronze you've probably seen or felt that you didn't see personally forged? It likely came from our homeland." That'd explain their armament; compared to the locals, the mercenaries are quite well-armed. Given the abundance of bronze, you figure it must be due to the fact they get paid in goods? "Yeah." The cavalry gal shifts the poking hand to her lips, whistling out for her steed before casually continuing. "In Tronarii, mercenary groups like ours are common because we help the merchants in their trade wars... literally." She pauses as the steed trots up, approaching and masterfully remounting in a single stride; just before extending a hand demandingly. A clasping motion and then a simple backhanded wave toward the spear give you the hint you need, quickly recovering the tool of war from its place on the ground and getting it back to her. Up close, the bronze head of the weapon certainly looks mastercrafted. "Like all things, we follow money." Jen gives a small swish of the spear to get your attention off it and up to her. "Commander Leofric isn't a native anyway; he supposedly grew up not terribly far from these lands and had some connections. After we sailed over, he poked around and we got this job... and we've been here for months now on contract. Most of our guys aren't bad but considering the nation is full of folks who thrive off a well-off economy fueled by our bronze production? Most aren't... humble to put it kindly. But we mercenaries are far from bad guys; we're getting paid and have plenty keeping us busy to prevent any worse trouble. If things don't start improving... who knows what might happen." Considering all the muggings her mercenaries have attempted on you, she's not wrong in worrying. Sitting around and talking about the morons who kick guys like Dale into some light thievery isn't worth it however; you've got things to do besides for clog up the lancer's schedule. Talking about the mercenaries certainly helps keep things fresh when considering how to handle them, after all. "No problem... after all, you did defeat me honorably. It was the least I can do. Perhaps one day you could visit Tronarii; the last of the most recent bloody merchant feuds supposedly ended a month after we arrived... it might not be a bad trip. If you could stomach the month at sea, anyway. I assure you; it's not for the faint of heart and has plenty of temporary port-landings in some... not so savvy places." With a passing and uncharacteristic shiver for someone so outwardly serious, Jen raises her spear in a passing salute before giving a small tug and muttering of foreign tongue to get her horse trotting off and leaving you to continue adventuring.
rows.translation: 既然你已经引起了她的注意，现在似乎正是了解她那家雇佣兵公司的最佳时机。具体来说，你很好奇他们为什么会来到这里——他们只是来骚扰当地人的吗？ “当然不是。”珍的回答中带着一丝尖锐而困惑的语气。那名独眼中尉将她的一只手部搭在腰上，然后继续问道…… [pc.chest] 用另一只戴着护手部的手部说道：“我们是被某位特定的人雇佣来解决某个特定的问题的。关于这件事，你们就只能了解到这些；因为我们和雇主之间有保密协议！ 嗯，这个尝试并没有取得太大进展；但幸运的是，看来它终于要结出果实了——珍现在已经转过身来，你们可以看到她护肩上刻着的那个符号了。 “那些被标记的佣兵们来自东南方，就在大海的另一边。 具体来说，我们来自特罗纳里；那片闪耀着青铜轻型芒的土地。 [var0 |这已经不是你第一次听到这个名字了；她对这个国家有什么看法呢？ |你从未听说过特洛纳里；那里究竟发生了什么，才会让那些雇佣兵离开那里，远道来到这里呢？ ] 首先，就是气候。与马尔凯地区那种传统的寒冷气候相比，特罗纳里伊的气候要温暖得多。不过，正如其名字所暗示的那样，特罗纳里伊还有一个著名的特点：它生产的青铜数量在世界上任何国家都名列前茅。无论是武器、盔甲还是工具……你见过的或使用过的那些青铜制品，如果其中没有一些是当地手部工锻造的，那么它们很可能是来自我们的故乡。 这就解释了他们为何拥有如此精良的武器；与当地人相比，这些雇佣兵的武装确实要先进得多。考虑到青铜资源如此丰富，想必他们得到的报酬就是这些物资吧？ “没错。”那名骑兵将手部放在嘴唇边吹了个口哨，召唤她的坐骑，然后继续说道：“在特罗纳里，像我们这样的雇佣兵组织很常见，因为我们会真正帮助商人们进行贸易战争……真的是这样。 当那匹骏马小跑着靠近时，她停下了动作，熟练地一跃而上，然后伸出手部来。握住武器后，她朝那支长矛挥了挥手部，这个简单的动作让你明白了她的意图——你迅速从地上捡起那件战争工具，递给了她。近距离看，这件武器的青铜制枪头确实显得工艺精湛。 就像所有事情一样，我们都是被金钱所驱使的。”珍轻轻晃了晃长矛，想把你的注意力从那把长矛上转移到她身上。“莱奥弗里克指挥官本来就不是这里的人；据说他是在离这片土地不远的的地方长大的，也有一些人脉关系。我们来到这里之后，他通过一些手部段帮我们得到了这份工作……从那以后，我们就根据合同在这里工作了好几个月。我们队里的大多数人其实都还不错，但考虑到这个国家里有很多人都是依靠我们生产的青铜所带来的繁荣经济而过上富足的生活，那么……他们中的大多数人其实也就只能算是一般罢了。 谦逊 说得好听点吧。但我们这些雇佣兵其实远不是什么坏人；我们有人付钱给我们工作，也有很多事情要做，这样就能避免惹上更大的麻烦。如果情况没有开始好转……谁知道会发生什么呢。 考虑到她的雇佣兵们曾经对你犯下那么多抢劫行为，她感到担心也是情有可原的。 然而，只是坐在那里议论那些把像戴尔这样的家伙逼迫去干些小偷小摸的蠢货，实在没什么意义。你们还有其他事情要做，总不能让兰瑟的日程安排被这些事情占据吧。不过，讨论那些雇佣兵的问题，确实有助于我们在思考如何应对他们时保持思路清晰。毕竟，了解他们的特点和行为模式，对我们制定策略是非常有帮助的。 没问题……毕竟，你是以公平的方式击败我的。这是我至少应该做的。或许有一天你可以去看看特罗纳里；最近那些血腥的商战据说在我们到达一个月后才结束……那次旅行或许不会太糟糕。 当然，前提是你能忍受在海上度过的那一个月时间。我向你保证，这种经历绝对不适合胆怯的人，而且在一些……不太熟悉的地方，途中还会有一些临时停靠的港口可供休息。」 詹突然打了个寒颤——对于一个外表如此严肃的人来说，这种反应实在有些反常。她举起长矛行了一个简短的致意，然后轻轻一拉马绳，用一种外语低声说了些什么，让马小跑着离开了，留下你继续你的冒险之旅。
