rows.original: Time to address the super annoying belt in the room[flags.JEN_TALKED_BELT| again]; why does she wear a partial chastity belt? "Because a mercenary doesn't want to get knocked up if they're beaten and captured?" Jen's face flushes red, giving you an oddly aggressive and agitated shove considering how friendly she was mere moments ago. "You had your way with me and think the answer isn't obvious!?" Scoffing and averting her gaze, you can't help but wonder; does she keep the key on her? If so, wouldn't that make a defense like that pointless? "It doesn't use a key; it's magically bound and requires me to say the release phrase." Crossing both of her arms over her chestplate, the woman carefully reaches down and grabs the hem of her pants. A strong tug loosens her belt and lets her pull the trousers down just enough for you to see the contraption without any sex on the table to distract you. The bronze garment clearly has some softer material along the inside from the soft fabric running just over the top rim at her waist; but the majority of the belt is solid and sturdy. It would take multiple strikes of a seasoned and strong pick to get through there; they'd likely be better off being murderers at that point, though, than rapists. But just as she said, the odd vaginal-protecting belt lacks any sort of keyhole; instead it bears a simple glyph over the obvious block of its lock along the "strap" wreathing her thighs. "It's an annoying thing to wear but I assure you it has come in handy more than you'd think; if I didn't have this then Leofric and the others would have been dragging me back to camp with a baby in my belly after our last job. My cavalry squad and I weren't just defeated but taken for breeding stock. The orcs — unlucky compared to the ones who kidnapped my comrades — that nabbed me were too pussy to risk fucking with something that whirred to life with how powerful its defensive magic is. So instead of trying to knock me up they just took turns on my... butt... and made me use my mouth." So she got tossed around with some orcs? That explains why she's not some shy virgin and was actually okay with you having your way with her — regardless of how dishonorable it may be. "Sh-shut up!" Jen shoves you hard enough to send you flying back before revolving around and storming over to her nearby horse. She recovers her things with a scowl. "I don't want to talk about my sex life! I'm here to fight, not think about those green beasts slamming away at my body, filling and wringing every orgasm from their bodies and mine- GAH, FUCK! WHY DID YOU MAKE ME THINK ABOUT IT!? NOW I'LL HAVE TO TRY AND FORGET ABOUT IT ALL OVER AGAIN!" Clambering up and onto her steed, the woman made the animal turn and gallop so fast you barely have the time to move out of the way. And after almost getting run over, you can't help but feel like it might not be smart for a mercenary with bad — or maybe good? — memories of orcs to be fighting in the Foothills.[pc.ra orc| She seemingly has no issue with you but it isn't as if you've been chaste with her.] [party.has arona|"... Does she not see how green I am or did she run into something called an orc that doesn't look like me?" The orc amazonian behind you sighs, shaking her head for only a moment before chuckling. "Not that I mind; must mean she considers me honorable or whatever. Must put me on the 'might fuck' list."]
rows.translation: 是时候解决房间里那个超级烦人的传送带问题了。[flags.JEN_TALKED_BELT| 再次]为什么她会戴着那种半封闭式的贞操带呢？” “因为雇佣兵可不想在被打败俘虏之后怀孕啊。” 詹的脸一下子涨得通红，考虑到她刚才还那么友善，这一下子的反应显得既激烈又烦躁。 你对我为所欲为，却觉得答案并不明显！？” 你嗤之以鼻，同时移开了视线，不禁在想：她把钥匙带在身上吗？如果带在身上，那样的防御手段不就毫无意义了吗？ “这个装置并不需要钥匙，它是通过魔法固定的，我只需要说出解锁的咒语就可以了。 那名女子将双臂交叉在胸前，小心翼翼地低头抓住自己的裤脚。她用力一拉，腰带便松开了，于是她把裤子往下拉了一点，让你能够清楚地看到那个装置——当然，这里没有任何可能分散你注意力的性感场景。 这件青铜制成的服饰在腰部上方确实使用了一些较为柔软的材料，这些柔软的织物覆盖在边缘部位；但腰带的大部分部分仍然坚固结实。要想破坏这些材料，需要用一把经验丰富且力量强大的工具多次敲击才行；不过，在那种情况下，凶手可能比强奸犯更合适这个角色呢。 但正如她所说，这种奇怪的阴道保护装置上并没有任何钥匙孔；相反，在环绕她大腿的“带子”上，锁的位置处有一个简单的符号。 虽然戴着它很麻烦，但我可以向你保证，它的用处其实比你想象的要大得多；要不是有这个，上次完成任务后，Leofric和其他人就会把我拖回营地，而那时我的肚子里还怀着个孩子呢。 我的骑兵小队不仅被击败了，还被那些兽人抓去当种马用了。那些抓我的兽人——比起那些绑架我同伴的兽人来说，他们可真是太没胆量了——他们根本不敢去招惹这种防御魔法如此强大的生物。 所以他们并没有试图让我怀孕，而是轮流对我的……屁股……进行刺激，还让我用嘴去完成某些动作。 所以她被一些兽人折腾来折腾去？这就解释了为什么她并不是那种害羞的处女，反而能接受你对她做出那些事——无论这些行为有多不体面。 “闭嘴！”珍用力推了你一下，把你推得倒退了几步，然后转身冲向她附近的马。 她皱着眉头拿回了自己的东西，说道：“我根本不想谈论我的性生活！我来这里是来打架的，而不是去想那些家伙如何冲击我的身体，如何将他们和我的高潮都释放出来 该死，真见鬼！为什么你要让我想起这件事啊！现在我又得重新努力去忘记它了……那名女子爬上自己的坐骑，随即驱使马匹加速奔跑，速度快得让你几乎来不及躲开。而在差点被马撞到的之后，你不禁会想：对于一个对兽人有着复杂回忆的雇佣兵来说，在这些丘陵地带作战，或许并不是明智的选择……又或许，恰恰相反呢？[pc.ra orc| 她看起来对你并没有意见，但你们之间也并没有真正发生什么吧。] [party.has arona|……她难道没看到我有多绿吗？还是说她遇到了一个长得和我不一样的兽人？”你身后的那位兽人亚马逊女子叹了口气，摇摇头，但很快又笑了起来。“其实我并不介意；这说明她应该把我当成 可敬的 或者别的什么。反正肯定得把我列入“绝对不能招惹的人”名单里。]
rows.raw: " Time to address the super annoying belt in the room[flags.JEN_TALKED_BELT| again]; why does she wear a partial chastity belt? "Because a mercenary doesn't want to get knocked up if they're beaten and captured?" Jen's face flushes red, giving you an oddly aggressive and agitated shove considering how friendly she was mere moments ago. "You had your way with me and think the answer isn't obvious!?" Scoffing and averting her gaze, you can't help but wonder; does she keep the key on her? If so, wouldn't that make a defense like that pointless? "It doesn't use a key; it's magically bound and requires me to say the release phrase." Crossing both of her arms over her chestplate, the woman carefully reaches down and grabs the hem of her pants. A strong tug loosens her belt and lets her pull the trousers down just enough for you to see the contraption without any sex on the table to distract you. The bronze garment clearly has some softer material along the inside from the soft fabric running just over the top rim at her waist; but the majority of the belt is solid and sturdy. It would take multiple strikes of a seasoned and strong pick to get through there; they'd likely be better off being murderers at that point, though, than rapists. But just as she said, the odd vaginal-protecting belt lacks any sort of keyhole; instead it bears a simple glyph over the obvious block of its lock along the "strap" wreathing her thighs. "It's an annoying thing to wear but I assure you it has come in handy more than you'd think; if I didn't have this then Leofric and the others would have been dragging me back to camp with a baby in my belly after our last job. My cavalry squad and I weren't just defeated but taken for breeding stock. The orcs — unlucky compared to the ones who kidnapped my comrades — that nabbed me were too pussy to risk fucking with something that whirred to life with how powerful its defensive magic is. So instead of trying to knock me up they just took turns on my... butt... and made me use my mouth." So she got tossed around with some orcs? That explains why she's not some shy virgin and was actually okay with you having your way with her — regardless of how dishonorable it may be. "Sh-shut up!" Jen shoves you hard enough to send you flying back before revolving around and storming over to her nearby horse. She recovers her things with a scowl. "I don't want to talk about my sex life! I'm here to fight, not think about those green beasts slamming away at my body, filling and wringing every orgasm from their bodies and mine- GAH, FUCK! WHY DID YOU MAKE ME THINK ABOUT IT!? NOW I'LL HAVE TO TRY AND FORGET ABOUT IT ALL OVER AGAIN!" Clambering up and onto her steed, the woman made the animal turn and gallop so fast you barely have the time to move out of the way. And after almost getting run over, you can't help but feel like it might not be smart for a mercenary with bad — or maybe good? — memories of orcs to be fighting in the Foothills.[pc.ra orc| She seemingly has no issue with you but it isn't as if you've been chaste with her.] [party.has arona|"... Does she not see how green I am or did she run into something called an orc that doesn't look like me?" The orc amazonian behind you sighs, shaking her head for only a moment before chuckling. "Not that I mind; must mean she considers me honorable or whatever. Must put me on the 'might fuck' list."]"

rows.original:
The mercenaries started it but the way she's spoken briefly about him before; who is the commander of these mercenaries and why isn't he leading them? What good is he if he's just off and about and leaving them without orders? Your question strikes a nerve almost instantly; Jen's face turns almost purple in anger before quickly dropping her eye to glare down at the ground.

        "Leofric-... the Commander is how we earned our name; his entire body is covered with those stupid marks of Tira and... and he thinks that perhaps this is where he is supposed to... meet his fate."
        
        [flags.TODO_CODEX_TIRA
            |Considering what you know of the Goddess, that can only mean one thing.
            |Meet his fate? Does that mean-
        ]
        
        "Our Commander believes that this job, that these Foothills? They're meant to be his final battleground. When he arrived, it wasn't even a week before he woke me and asked me to help him gather his gear." Jen's eye darkens, grinding her teeth beneath tightly pinched lips. "I didn't even ask; I thought it was just him wanting to get out and do some scouting to find more orcs to fight or harpies to beat up. By the time I was really awake and thinking clearly, he shoved that damned note in my hand and told me I was in charge unless we met again."
        
        The horserider carefully slides her hand down into her pocket, withdrawing a slip of course stationary. It appeared rather rough, grooves and bends in its surface to suggest it had been squeezed tight more than a handful of times. She offers it to you for the moment, allowing you to unfurl and read its contents; or rather, content.
        
        "All he left was the names of women I remember him sleeping with whenever we moved around to the next job back in Tronarii; I guess he wanted me to know where any potential kids of his might live. Tiran paladins are big sticklers for living life to the fullest... but the Commander's heart is so big I guess even he lost some fanaticism to prepare for the idea of some young kid not having a father. If he really was dead... I would like to meet them, though."
        
        After a quick readover, your [pc.eyes] snap back up and onto the one-eyed woman to see she's actually crying from her good eye. There's no outward weakness; but her voice had hung on the mention of children. Anyone with a brain could tell something was happening between the pair of them.
        
        [comp.|"Maybe you should ask her how she feels after this. I'd bet she'd like that," [comp.name] says.]
        
        Carefully reaching out and taking the note, Jen sets to quickly recovering her spear before marching to her horse in silence. It's not until she's mounted and trotted right back to you that the tough flat-chested gal wipes away the stream with the fur lining of her gauntlet. And at last, her confidence returns and she shoots that fiery smirk at you.
        
        "But enough about that and regret; I intend to find him and bring him back." The woman grasps her spear, settling it into its rung on her saddle. "Even if I have to use force... I won't let the mercenaries lose their Commander."
        
        Giving a small tug of the reins and departing, Jen leaves you to get back on your way to adventuring.
rows.translation:
这些雇佣兵是挑起了事端，但之前她也曾简短地提到过这个人——这些雇佣兵的指挥官究竟是谁？为什么他不亲自带领他们行动呢？如果他只是到处闲逛，却不发号施令，那他还有什么用处呢？ 你的问题几乎立刻就触到了她的痛处；詹的脸因愤怒而变得通红，随后她迅速低下头，目光盯着地面。

“利奥弗里克——……‘指挥官’这个称号正是我们靠他的功绩获得的；他的全身都布满了那些该死的提拉印记…………而他觉得，也许在这里，他才会遇到自己的命运。
        
        [flags.TODO_CODEX_TIRA
            |根据你对那位女神的了解，这只能说明一件事。
            |遭遇他的命运？这是意味着……
        ]
        
        我们的指挥官认为，这个地方，就是这些丘陵地带，应该是他的最终战场。他刚到的时候，还不到一周，就叫醒我，让我帮他准备行装。”詹的眼神变得黯淡下来，紧咬着嘴唇，牙齿不停地咯咯作响。 我甚至都没有问原因；我以为他只是想出去探探路，找些兽人来战斗，或者找些女妖来对付罢了。直到我真正清醒过来，开始仔细思考时，他才把那张该死的纸条塞到我手里，告诉我从现在起由我来负责这件事，除非我们再次见面。"
        
        那位骑马的女子小心翼翼地将手伸进口袋，取出一张显然已经皱巴巴的纸条。纸条的表面布满了褶皱和弯曲，显然已经被反复挤压过很多次。她现在将这张纸条递给你，让你可以将其展开并阅读上面的内容——或者说，那为数不多的内容。
        
        他留下的只有那些女人名字，那些是我记得他在特罗纳里工作时，每次我们换工作地点时和他一起过夜的女人的名字。我想，他是想让我知道他的孩子如果有的话，可能会住在哪里。提兰的圣骑士们一向主张尽情享受生活……但这位指挥官的心胸实在过于宽广，我想就连他也放弃了那种极端的态度，愿意接受一个孩子可能没有父亲这个事实。如果他真的去世了……我倒是想见见那些孩子。
        
        快速浏览一遍之后，你的 [pc.eyes] 猛地回过头，看向那个独眼女人，才发现她实际上是用好眼睛在哭泣。她外表上看不出任何虚弱之态，但一提到孩子，她的声音就变得颤抖起来。任何稍加留意的人都能看出，这两个人之间肯定发生了什么。
        
        [comp.|也许你应该问问她，经历这些之后她有什么感受。我敢打赌，她会很乐意回答这个问题的。 [comp.name] 说。]
        
        珍小心翼翼地接过那张纸条，迅速取回她的长矛，然后默默地走向她的马。直到她骑上马，小跑着回到你身边时，这个身材结实、胸部平坦的女孩才用她护手上的毛皮内侧擦去了脸上的泪水。 终于，她的信心重新回来了，她朝你露出了那个充满挑衅的微笑。

“不过，关于这些遗憾和懊悔的事情就到此为止吧。我决心找到他，把他带回来。”这位女子握紧手中的长矛，将其固定在马鞍上的支架上。 即使我必须使用武力……我也绝不会让那些雇佣兵失去他们的指挥官。”

詹轻轻拉了一下缰绳，然后离开了，让你继续继续你的冒险之旅。

rows.original: So before, she seemed to hang up on the idea that their commander has kids... why? [flags.JEN_TALKED_FEELINGS|Refresh your memory, as it were, so that you don't bother her for a while longer?] The question catches Jen off-guard; a soldier and warrior like her clearly hadn't been expecting to get her questions and feelings prodded. Thankfully that bronze-clad exterior of hers isn't too hardened to keep her from answering, rather it does a fine job of accenting her cheeks flushing red and Jen tries averting her gaze. "The Commander is only on a first name basis with me and... well... he saved me when I was younger. When you're a smaller girl and some young, handsome stud of a paladin comes bellowing out from the dunes with his axes readied? Slaying some ugly bandit and taking you under his wing? Yeah; you'd get why I had a crush on him when I was younger." Past-tense means that she doesn't crush on him now? You're not quite certain you understand the train of thought she's aiming for. "I... er... guh. Fine, I... I still crush on him a bit... it's just not for the same reasons. When I was younger, he was just... hot. And he's still handsome now, even with his graying hair and some wrinkles on him... but I care for Leofric because he taught me everything. From riding a horse, to using a spear, to caring for my armor. He taught me prayers, to read and write, whatever there is to need to know? I learned from that big oaf." Her gaze turns toward her steed, calling it over with a quick whistle before giving its shoulder a soft pat. "I named my horse Leo because they're both the same; big and strong and braver than anything else. There were so many times Leofric ran into absolute death to save me; and it shows in that he has those scars all over him." A big scarred mercenary with a heart of gold to help out young girls? It seems like Leofric really is a bonafide hero, if a bit mad for running into what she literally calls absolute death. But if she really feels that way, has she tried telling him? "..." Jen's mouth opens but nothing comes out at first. She finally closes her eye and spills an unexpectedly cowardly statement. "No; I... don't want to risk being rejected." Mounting her steed in a rush, the woman swings her hand toward her spear for you to get and recover the weapon for her. "One day, I... maybe I will count myself lucky to be one of the women who was able to be at his side; lucky enough... to bear one of his children. Yet I fought through all these battlefields because he is my mentor and greatest friend. If I ruined that, I would never forgive myself. And until I know there's no chance of that... I can't afford to throw anything away for the sake of my feelings." With her spear returned, Jen raises the tool and rests it across her lap. The silence between the two of you is a bit daunting for a few moments but a quick clearing of your throat startles her into quickly flushing red and jabbering aloud. "Sorry, I... in ways, you remind me of him. The other mercenaries don't make an effort to ask me... how I feel. They care for me but... only you and Leofric have ever tried to figure out more about me; I appreciate that in you, [pc.name]. When we meet again, we should talk like this... I... suppose I enjoy it almost as much as testing my spear arm against you." A snap of the reins and Jen is trotting away upon her precious Leo. Maybe you'll get lucky enough to be there when or if she speaks heart. [pc.isDK|You can taunt her the whole time if she gets all mushy about it.]
rows.translation: 所以之前，她似乎一直纠结于这样一个想法：他们的指挥官也有孩子……为什么呢？ [flags.JEN_TALKED_FEELINGS|不妨让你的记忆重新恢复一下，这样你就不会再打扰她了，对吧？] 这个问题让珍措手不及；像她这样的士兵和战士，显然没有预料到自己的问题和感受会被如此深入地剖析。幸运的是，她那身青铜色的盔甲并没有让她变得过于冷漠，无法回答问题；相反，它反而很好地凸显了她脸颊上泛起的红晕。珍试图移开视线，避免面对这个问题。 那位指挥官和我只是以名字相称而已……嗯……在我还年轻的时候，他救了我。当你还是个小女孩的时候，如果有位年轻英俊的圣骑士从沙丘上冲过来，手里还握着斧头，你会怎么想呢？ 干掉那些丑陋的强盗，然后保护你？没错，这样你就明白我小时候为什么会喜欢他了。” “用过去时态来说，就是现在她已经不再喜欢他了？你其实还不太明白她想要表达的意思吧。 我……呃……好吧，我确实还是有点喜欢他……只不过原因已经不同了。小时候，他只是……看起来很帅而已。现在他虽然头发变白了，也有些皱纹，但依然很英俊……而我喜欢利奥弗里克，是因为他教会了我 一切从骑马到使用长矛，再到保养我的盔甲，他教会了我各种技能。他还教我祈祷文，以及读写知识，总之，凡是需要了解的东西，我都从那个大块头那里学到了。 她的目光转向自己的坐骑，快速吹了一声口哨将其唤来，然后轻轻拍了拍它的肩膀。 我把我的马叫做Leo，因为它们俩真的很像——同样高大强壮，而且比任何事物都更勇敢。有太多次，Leofric为了救我而冒上了生命危险；那些遍布他身上的伤痕就是最好的证明。” 一个满身伤痕、却有着金子般心灵的雇佣兵，愿意帮助年轻女孩们？看来Leofric确实是个真正的英雄啊，只不过他总是不顾危险地去救人，有时候甚至会陷入她所说的“生命危险”之中。不过，如果她真的这么认为的话，她有没有试着告诉过他呢？ ……”珍的张了张嘴，但起初什么话也没说出来。最终，她闭上了眼睛，说出了一个出人意料地懦弱的回答：“不，我……不想冒被拒绝的风险。” 那个女人匆忙地上马，然后朝她的长矛挥了挥手，让你去取来那件武器并交还给她。 有一天，我……或许我会认为自己很幸运，能够成为那些能够站在他身边的女性之一；也很幸运……能够为他生下孩子。但我之所以能够坚持走过这一切，是因为他是我的导师，也是我最亲密的朋友。如果我毁掉了这一切，我永远也无法原谅自己。而直到我确定这种可能性完全不存在之前……我绝不能为了自己的感情而放弃任何东西。 詹将长矛收了回来，把那件武器放在膝盖上。你们之间的沉默让她感到有些尴尬，但突然发出的清嗓声让她立刻面红耳赤，开始结结巴巴地说话起来。 “对不起，我……在某些方面，你让我想起了他。其他的雇佣兵从不会关心我的感受……他们虽然关心我，但只有你和利奥弗里克真正试图了解我更多的情况；我真的很感激你们。 [pc.name]当我们再次见面时，我们应该像这样交谈……我想，我其实和用我的长矛与你较量一样，都很享受这样的对话。” 詹轻轻一拉缰绳，她那匹珍贵的狮子座坐骑便小跑着离开了。也许你会幸运地在那里，听到她倾诉心声的那一刻。 [pc.isDK|如果她变得过于情绪化，你就可以一直取笑她。]
rows.raw: " So before, she seemed to hang up on the idea that their commander has kids... why? [flags.JEN_TALKED_FEELINGS|Refresh your memory, as it were, so that you don't bother her for a while longer?] The question catches Jen off-guard; a soldier and warrior like her clearly hadn't been expecting to get her questions and feelings prodded. Thankfully that bronze-clad exterior of hers isn't too hardened to keep her from answering, rather it does a fine job of accenting her cheeks flushing red and Jen tries averting her gaze. "The Commander is only on a first name basis with me and... well... he saved me when I was younger. When you're a smaller girl and some young, handsome stud of a paladin comes bellowing out from the dunes with his axes readied? Slaying some ugly bandit and taking you under his wing? Yeah; you'd get why I had a crush on him when I was younger." Past-tense means that she doesn't crush on him now? You're not quite certain you understand the train of thought she's aiming for. "I... er... guh. Fine, I... I still crush on him a bit... it's just not for the same reasons. When I was younger, he was just... hot. And he's still handsome now, even with his graying hair and some wrinkles on him... but I care for Leofric because he taught me everything. From riding a horse, to using a spear, to caring for my armor. He taught me prayers, to read and write, whatever there is to need to know? I learned from that big oaf." Her gaze turns toward her steed, calling it over with a quick whistle before giving its shoulder a soft pat. "I named my horse Leo because they're both the same; big and strong and braver than anything else. There were so many times Leofric ran into absolute death to save me; and it shows in that he has those scars all over him." A big scarred mercenary with a heart of gold to help out young girls? It seems like Leofric really is a bonafide hero, if a bit mad for running into what she literally calls absolute death. But if she really feels that way, has she tried telling him? "..." Jen's mouth opens but nothing comes out at first. She finally closes her eye and spills an unexpectedly cowardly statement. "No; I... don't want to risk being rejected." Mounting her steed in a rush, the woman swings her hand toward her spear for you to get and recover the weapon for her. "One day, I... maybe I will count myself lucky to be one of the women who was able to be at his side; lucky enough... to bear one of his children. Yet I fought through all these battlefields because he is my mentor and greatest friend. If I ruined that, I would never forgive myself. And until I know there's no chance of that... I can't afford to throw anything away for the sake of my feelings." With her spear returned, Jen raises the tool and rests it across her lap. The silence between the two of you is a bit daunting for a few moments but a quick clearing of your throat startles her into quickly flushing red and jabbering aloud. "Sorry, I... in ways, you remind me of him. The other mercenaries don't make an effort to ask me... how I feel. They care for me but... only you and Leofric have ever tried to figure out more about me; I appreciate that in you, [pc.name]. When we meet again, we should talk like this... I... suppose I enjoy it almost as much as testing my spear arm against you." A snap of the reins and Jen is trotting away upon her precious Leo. Maybe you'll get lucky enough to be there when or if she speaks heart. [pc.isDK|You can taunt her the whole time if she gets all mushy about it.]"

rows.original: She sure seems to have some feelings about Leofric...
rows.translation: 她似乎对利奥弗里克确实怀有某种感情……
rows.raw: "She sure seems to have some feelings about Leofric..."

rows.original: You need to find out what she's so emotional about before you can ask about it!
rows.translation: 在你询问原因之前，你首先需要弄清楚她为什么会如此情绪化！
rows.raw: "You need to find out what she's so emotional about before you can ask about it!"

rows.original: You're not feeling particularly frisky enough to go at Jennavieve but you also don't have time nor really want to talk right now; you just need to get going on your way. So you walk away, leaving her on the ground to lick her wounded pride. You doubt that the two of you will ever stop this game of cat and mouse as long as she's looking for her absent leader and you're traveling through the Foothills. No reason to worry about dealing with her for now.
rows.translation: 你并没有特别想去找珍娜薇芙，但同时你也没有时间，也不真的想聊天；你只是想继续自己的路。于是你走开了，留下她独自在地上，去舔拭自己受伤的自尊心。你认为，只要她还在寻找她那位不在身边的“领导者”，而你还在穿越山脚地带，你们之间的这种“猫捉老鼠”的游戏就永远不会结束。目前来说，没有必要担心要怎么应付她。
rows.raw: "\n    You're not feeling particularly frisky enough to go at Jennavieve but you also don't have time nor really want to talk right now; you just need to get going on your way. So you walk away, leaving her on the ground to lick her wounded pride. You doubt that the two of you will ever stop this game of cat and mouse as long as she's looking for her absent leader and you're traveling through the Foothills. No reason to worry about dealing with her for now."

rows.original: Collapsing [party.som|in defeat|beside [comp.name]|among your surrendering allies] while Jen raises her weapon in triumph; the one-eyed lancer's posture easily boasts for her, doubly so after angling her spear's tip toward the heavens. "And now that you know defeat, I have avenged one blemish upon our pristine records! You'll do wise to never forget this experience either; if you know what's good for you, you'll turn tail and never come here again. Even if you actually think yourself worthy of challenging me and the Marked Merk Mercenaries, let's face it; who are you but a stepping stone in our path to glory?" Running her lance through the loop of your coin purse and hefting it away, she rifles through the sack for a moment to collect her own prize. Unfortunately that means that a princely amount of your precious electrum is now hers; Jen tosses the violated bag into your lap once she's satisfied, leaving you to lick your wounds.
rows.translation: 崩溃 [party.som|在失败中|此外 [comp.name]|在那些选择投降的盟友之中] 当珍得意地举起她的武器时，那个独眼长矛手的姿态更是为她增光添彩——尤其是当他将长矛的矛尖指向天空的时候。 “现在你们终于知道了什么是失败，我也为我们那无瑕的记录洗清了一个污点！ 你最好也永远不要忘记这次经历；如果你知道什么对自己有利，就应该立刻转身离开，再也不来这里。即使你真的认为自己有资格挑战我和那些被标记的雇佣兵，但事实是什么呢？你只不过是我们通往荣耀之路上的一个垫脚石罢了。她将长矛穿过你的钱袋的环扣，然后把钱袋拿走，接着在袋子里翻找了一会儿，以获取她自己的奖励。不幸的是，这样一来，你那些珍贵的电银就有相当一部分因此被她拿走了 她的等珍满意之后，她就会把那个被破坏的袋子扔到你腿上，让你自己去想办法解决这个问题。
rows.raw: " Collapsing [party.som|in defeat|beside [comp.name]|among your surrendering allies] while Jen raises her weapon in triumph; the one-eyed lancer's posture easily boasts for her, doubly so after angling her spear's tip toward the heavens. "And now that you know defeat, I have avenged one blemish upon our pristine records! You'll do wise to never forget this experience either; if you know what's good for you, you'll turn tail and never come here again. Even if you actually think yourself worthy of challenging me and the Marked Merk Mercenaries, let's face it; who are you but a stepping stone in our path to glory?" Running her lance through the loop of your coin purse and hefting it away, she rifles through the sack for a moment to collect her own prize. Unfortunately that means that a princely amount of your precious electrum is now hers; Jen tosses the violated bag into your lap once she's satisfied, leaving you to lick your wounds."

rows.original: Pushing through the streets of Hawkethorne leads you to a rather unusual sight at the blacksmith's place. A massive cart being pulled by a pair of younger steeds stuffed with a large and unspeakably immense bounty of glimmering bronze; countless swords and pieces of armor as well as plenty of testing alloys. Although they had wealth in copper and tin and various other metals, the true value of such bars was acting as a measure of grading the metal toward a certain and final mix to allow an almost exact alloy reference. "I've brought more work for you, blacksmith." [flags.JEN_MET |Jen's beaming smile doesn't falter for even a moment while she pushes a hefty bag of electrum into the larger orc's open palm. It's at times like this — when Jen was with someone of impressive stature — that you can appreciate just how small the woman is while dismounted yet still demanding respect from any man or woman of greater stature as if granting them a service simply for being so astounding or skilled. |A short woman with black hair and specks of green visibly highlighting some of the wavy hairstyle. The five foot tall human bears bronze armor as well; including the familiar symbol of the mercenaries you've seen in the Foothills. Is this their supposed commander? If so, she must have a lot of wealth to her name if she's getting all of those goods repaired; the quantity of bronze could likely occupy any blacksmith for ages. ] Ogrish however seems perfectly attuned to his client and has little mind for reputation or appearances getting in the way of work; in fact, the burly blacksmith is already turning his tusked smile at the massive delivery. "Ah, another heavy order! You mercenaries sure do get banged up tussling around with those troublemakers out in the Foothills. As long as you keep paying so well, how could I say no? All of this electrum helps out the whole village in the long run, after all. I'll probably get all of it finished in about a week like always." [flags.JEN_MET |Jen's eye lights up and her grin tuns to a smirk; perhaps she had been expecting a tougher degree of negotiation. But she nods and releases the bag so Ogrish can fully take the payment before turning her gaze to the steeds. |The woman grows rather pleased, her head turning enough so you can see an eyepatch over her left eye. Her lips even curl into a warm, satisfied smirk! It definitely looks like the one-eyed woman got the better deal of it, waving gingerly toward the horses. ] "I intend to leave our steeds in town as well; they're safer here and you can use them around your forge while you have them. They've got plenty of fodder, too, so there is no reason to spend more on them. It's not like they're being worked nearly as hard as my personal steed, after all." The local blacksmith nods knowingly and steps around to one of them, patting the flank of one of the beasts until it whinnies dismissively. "There's not a whole ton we can do with them around the place but I'm sure I'll think of something; if your steed ever needs armor you can always make a custom order, you know. I can handle any new shoeing you need done for the fella or these beauties, too." [flags.JEN_MET |Jen rolls her eye before brushing past him and even past you; she doesn't even notice it's you thanks to you being in her blindspot. |Walking up and past you with a roll of her eye, the woman puts you in her blindspot while shouting back to Ogrish over her shoulder. ] "A true horsewoman never needs armor for her steed if she knows when to charge! Besides, I never trained him to wear that sort of equipment so it'd only slow him down. I'll swing by some other time with more orders though, alright?" Ogrish's smile momentarily turns to a scowl but a quick sigh and it vanishes; perhaps he thought she needed to care for her horse more. The orc blacksmith raises his left hand in a dismissive wave before moving around to the back of the wagon and pulling free a bronze-plated vest. Turning it over in his grasp — inspecting the dented surface — even you can tell just how fine the metal itself is. "I'll never get used to working with this Tronarii bronze." With the two splitting up however, you figure it's about time to get back to your own business; after all, Ogrish made good money while you sat there watching the pair. Surely you can make more than a blacksmith if you get out there and back to the profitable art of adventuring. Maybe some of those mercenaries can oblige helping you out with some 'donations' of their own.
rows.translation: 穿过鹰棘镇的街道，你会在铁匠铺看到一幅颇为不寻常的景象：一辆巨大的马车被两匹年轻的马牵引着，车上装满了数量庞大、价值连城的闪亮青铜制品——数不清的剑、盔甲，还有各种用于测试的合金材料。 尽管他们拥有大量的铜、锡以及其他各种金属，但这些金属条的真正价值在于，它们能够作为衡量金属成分比例的标准，从而确保最终得到的合金成分完全符合预期。 “铁匠，我又带来了新的工作给你。" [flags.JEN_MET |当珍将那个沉重的电银袋子推到那个高大的兽人手中时，她那灿烂的笑容丝毫没有减弱。就在这样的时刻——当珍与那些地位崇高的人在一起时——你才会真正意识到，尽管她身材娇小，但她依然能够赢得那些地位更高的人的尊重；仿佛她为与这些人相处而感到荣幸，甚至觉得能为他们服务是一种荣幸。 |这位身材矮小、黑发中夹杂着些许绿色头发的女性，波浪形的发丝更加凸显了她的容貌。这位身高五英尺的女性身着青铜铠甲，铠甲上还印有那些在山脚地区常见的佣兵标志。难道这就是他们的指挥官吗？如果是的话，她肯定拥有巨额财富，才能负担得起修理所有这些武器的费用——这么多青铜材料，足以让任何铁匠忙上好几年了。 ] 然而，奥格瑞什似乎与他的雇主配合得非常默契，他完全不在乎名声或外表是否会妨碍工作；事实上，这个魁梧的黑铁匠已经露出了他那带着獠牙的笑容，准备迎接这一大批货物了。 啊，又是一笔大额订单！你们这些雇佣兵在山脚地带和那些捣乱分子打斗，确实经常受伤。只要你们继续支付这么高的报酬，我怎么可能会拒绝呢？毕竟，这些电银最终还是会帮助到整个村庄的。 像往常一样，我大概需要一周的时间来完成所有这些工作。 [flags.JEN_MET |珍的眼睛亮了起来，她的笑容也变成了狡黠的笑意；或许她原本期待着一场更为激烈的谈判。不过她还是点了点头，将袋子交给了奥格瑞什，让他先拿走全部报酬，然后她才把目光转向那些马匹。 |那个女人显得非常满意，她转动着头，让你能够看到她左眼上戴着的眼罩。她的嘴唇甚至露出了温暖而满足的微笑！看来，这个独眼女人确实得到了更好的交易结果，她小心翼翼地朝那些马匹挥了挥手。 ] 我也打算把我们的马留在城里吧；在这里它们更安全，而且你在使用锻造设备的时候也可以利用这些马。它们也有足够的饲料，所以没有必要再为它们花费额外的费用。毕竟，这些马的工作强度远没有我的坐骑那么高。当地的铁匠会心地点点头，然后走到其中一匹兽旁边，轻拍它的侧腹，那匹兽不耐烦地发出了一声嘶鸣。 “在这种地方，我们对这些兽没什么太多办法，但我肯定能想出办法来；如果你的坐骑需要盔甲，你随时都可以定制，你知道的。 对于那个家伙，或者这些漂亮的家伙，你们需要的任何新的鞋面更换工作，我都可以处理。 [flags.JEN_MET |珍翻了个白眼，然后从他身边走过，甚至也从你身边经过了；由于你正好处于她的视线盲区，她甚至没有注意到是你。 |那个女人翻了个白眼，从你身边走过，这样一来，她就完全没注意到你了，而她还在一边回头对奥格瑞什喊话。 ] 一个真正的骑手，只要知道何时该冲锋，就根本不需要为自己的坐骑配备盔甲！再说，我也从未训练过它佩戴那种装备，因为那只会让它行动迟缓。不过，改天我会带着更多的命令再来拜访你，好吗？奥格瑞什的笑容瞬间变成了皱眉，但很快他又叹了口气，那皱眉也就消失了；或许他觉得她应该多照顾一下自己的马。这位兽人铁匠挥了挥左手，表示不以为意，然后走到马车的后面，取下了那件青铜制成的护胸。 他在手中仔细端详着这个有凹痕的表面——就连你也能看出这种金属本身的质地是多么精良。 “我永远都无法习惯使用这种特洛纳里青铜材料。” 不过，既然他们俩已经分开了，你也就觉得是时候回去继续自己的事情了；毕竟，在你坐那儿看着他们的时候，Ogrish已经赚到了不少钱。 如果你真正投身到那些充满利润的冒险事业中去，肯定能取得比当铁匠更显著的成就。或许那些雇佣兵中也会有人愿意帮助你完成一些任务吧。捐赠款项他们自己的。

But deep down at the bottom, you spy [var0|a small vial labeled %"Ovilixer"|a huge, golden-colored egg|[a] [var1] egg] that's been left behind by the nest's prior denizens..."

rows.original: You grab the left-behind item and, seeing no way forward from here, turn back the way you came...
rows.translation: 你拿起了被遗忘在后面的物品，发现在这里无法继续前进，于是便原路返回了……
rows.raw: "\n        You grab the left-behind item and, seeing no way forward from here, turn back the way you came..."

rows.original: Not long after you set out, you hear a rumbling from a hill up above you. You twist around just in time to see a cavalcade of head-sized stones tumbling down towards you, kicking up a cloud of dust and shattered stone as they come!
rows.translation: 你刚出发不久，就听到头顶上的山丘上传来一阵隆隆声。你及时转过身去，正好看到一大群拳头大小的石头正向你滚落下来，它们坠落时扬起了阵阵尘土和碎石！
rows.raw: "\n    Not long after you set out, you hear a rumbling from a hill up above you. You twist around just in time to see a cavalcade of head-sized stones tumbling down towards you, kicking up a cloud of dust and shattered stone as they come!"

rows.original: You book it as hard as you can, running back the way you came.
rows.translation: 你用尽全力奔跑，沿着来时的路往回赶去。
rows.raw: "You book it as hard as you can, running back the way you came."

rows.original: the rocky downpour smashes into the path, kicking up a dark cloud of dust. Luckily, [target.combatName] [tps|is|are] unharmed!
rows.translation: 倾盆大雨猛烈地砸在道路上，卷起了一片漆黑的尘土。幸运的是， [target.combatName] [tps|已|已] 毫发无伤！
rows.raw: "the rocky downpour smashes into the path, kicking up a dark cloud of dust. Luckily, [target.combatName] [tps|is|are] unharmed!"

rows.original: fast as possible, but still end[tps|s] up pelted by a hail of stones!
rows.translation: 尽快完成，但最终还是要达到目标。[tps|s] 被一阵石子砸中了！
rows.raw: "fast as possible, but still end[tps|s] up pelted by a hail of stones!"

rows.translation: 尽量跑得比那些巨石快！

rows.original: You quickly look around, trying to find somewhere to bunker down!
rows.translation: 你迅速环顾四周，试图找到一个可以躲藏的地方！
rows.raw:
"
        You quickly look around, trying to find somewhere to bunker down!
        
        "

rows.original: A moment later and you're running for a small rocky outcropping, a shelf of stone that will surely protect you from the rockslide. You[party.solo|| and your companion[party.som|||s]] duck into the shadow of the outcropping and get small, watching as hundreds of pounds of stone goes roaring past. The slide lasts for just a minute before things settle down, and you're able to claw your way out and back towards whence you came.
rows.translation: 片刻之后，你开始朝着一块小岩石峭壁奔去——那块突出的石架肯定能保护你免受山体滑坡的侵袭。[party.solo|| 以及你的同伴[party.som|||s]] 赶紧躲到岩石的阴影里，保持低矮的姿势，看着数百磅重的石头呼啸着从你身边飞过。这种滑动的状态只会持续一分钟，之后一切就会恢复平静，你就可以爬出来，回到原来的地方了。
rows.raw: "A moment later and you're running for a small rocky outcropping, a shelf of stone that will surely protect you from the rockslide. You[party.solo|| and your companion[party.som|||s]] duck into the shadow of the outcropping and get small, watching as hundreds of pounds of stone goes roaring past. The slide lasts for just a minute before things settle down, and you're able to claw your way out and back towards whence you came."

rows.original: You spend just a little too long looking for shelter: by the time you realize there's none to be found, it's too late to run completely out of the way: you end up slammed into the ground by stone, pelted black and blue by debris!
rows.translation: 你花了太长时间寻找避难所：等到你意识到根本找不到任何地方可以躲藏时，已经来不及躲开了——最终，你被石头砸中，还被碎片砸得浑身都是伤！
rows.raw: "You spend just a little too long looking for shelter: by the time you realize there's none to be found, it's too late to run completely out of the way: you end up slammed into the ground by stone, pelted black and blue by debris!"

rows.original: [target.CombatName] run[tps|s] as fast as possible, but still end[tps|s] up pelted by a hail of stones!
rows.translation: [target.CombatName] 运行[tps|s] 尽快完成，但最终还是要达到目标。[tps|s] 被一阵石子砸中了！
rows.raw: "\n\n[target.CombatName] run[tps|s] as fast as possible, but still end[tps|s] up pelted by a hail of stones!"

rows.original: Use a little quick thinking to find somewhere safe to hide!
rows.translation: 迅速动脑筋，找个安全的地方躲起来吧！
rows.raw: "Use a little quick thinking to find somewhere safe to hide!"

rows.original: You throw your hands together, channeling your arcane power into a single, solid plate of magical force that surrounds you[party.solo|| and your companion[party.som|||s]]. All you can do is focus your will into the shield and hope it will hold.
rows.translation: 你将双手部合拢，将自身的神秘力量汇聚成一块坚实的魔法力场，将其环绕在自身周围。[party.solo|| 以及你的同伴[party.som|||s]]你所能做的，就是将自己的意志集中到那面盾牌上，希望它能够坚守住。
rows.raw:
"
        You throw your hands together, channeling your arcane power into a single, solid plate of magical force that surrounds you[party.solo|| and your companion[party.som|||s]]. All you can do is focus your will into the shield and hope it will hold.
        
        "

rows.original: And it does! You hold fast as hundreds of pounds of stone comes tumbling down at you, but the lion's share just bounces off your shield, sliding to the side. You're left standing in the middle of a semi-circle of clear ground, surrounded by knee-high debris. Whew. You take a moment to catch your breath before moving on.
rows.translation: 果然如此！当你紧紧握住盾牌时，数百磅重的石头纷纷向你砸来，但其中大部分石头都只是从你的盾牌上弹开，滑到了旁边。最终，你站在一片半圆形的空地上，周围堆满了及膝高的碎石。呼……你稍微休息片刻，喘口气，然后继续前进。
rows.raw: "And it does! You hold fast as hundreds of pounds of stone comes tumbling down at you, but the lion's share just bounces off your shield, sliding to the side. You're left standing in the middle of a semi-circle of clear ground, surrounded by knee-high debris. Whew. You take a moment to catch your breath before moving on."

rows.original: You throw all your force of will behind the shield, but it's not enough to prevent at least some of the debris from getting through. You manage to ward off the worst of it, but small bits of rock punch through your shield left and right, pelting you black and blue! When the rockslide's finally passed, you're able to limp away, sore but not truly hurt.
rows.translation: 你用尽全力去支撑那面盾牌，但这样的力量仍然不足以完全阻挡所有飞溅而来的碎片。你勉强挡住了最凶猛的攻击，然而那些小石块还是不断地击中你的盾牌，将你砸得浑身是伤！当山体滑坡终于结束之后，你才勉强能够爬起来离开现场，虽然浑身疼痛，但实际上并没有受到严重的伤害。
rows.raw: "You throw all your force of will behind the shield, but it's not enough to prevent at least some of the debris from getting through. You manage to ward off the worst of it, but small bits of rock punch through your shield left and right, pelting you black and blue! When the rockslide's finally passed, you're able to limp away, sore but not truly hurt."

rows.original: [target.CombatName] run[tps|s] as fast as possible, but still end[tps|s] up pelted by a hail of stones!
rows.translation: [target.CombatName] 运行[tps|s] 尽快完成，但最终还是要达到目标。[tps|s] 被一阵石子砸中了！
rows.raw: "\n\n[target.CombatName] run[tps|s] as fast as possible, but still end[tps|s] up pelted by a hail of stones!"

rows.original: Put your magic to use and create an arcane barrier against the landslide!
rows.translation: 运用你的魔法，构筑一道神秘屏障，阻止山体滑坡的发生吧！
rows.raw: "Put your magic to use and create an arcane barrier against the landslide!"

rows.original: If only you were more gifted in the arcane!
rows.translation: 要是你能在神秘力量方面更有天赋该多好啊！
rows.raw: "If only you were more gifted in the arcane!"

rows.original: A short time after you set out, you come across a small clearing in a valley between the hills that's lousy with black scavenger birds, picking around and squawking noisily. Your approach causes them to scatter in a flapping, screeching whirlwind — you shield yourself from a few particularly ornery crows and march forward to see what they were fussing over. The clearing is home to a handful of discarded, broken weapons and tattered banners flicking in the breeze. One bears a symbol of a horned wolf, snarling in blood-red paint. A heavy warhorse lies dead in the middle, picked to pieces by the flock. It looks like there was a fight here, and not all that long ago... After a quick search, you manage to collect a nice pile of metal scraps from all the broken weaponry laying about. You have obtained some metal parts.
rows.translation: 在你出发不久后，来到了山丘之间的山谷中，那里有一片小空地，到处都是黑色的食腐鸟类，它们正在地上翻找食物，发出嘈杂的叫声。当你靠近时，这些鸟儿立刻四散飞开，发出阵阵惊叫声——你躲开了几只特别凶猛的乌鸦，继续向前走去，想看看它们在吵闹些什么。 这片空地上散落着一些被丢弃的、损坏的武器，以及在微风中飘动的破旧旗帜。其中一面旗帜上绘着一只长着角、正发出凶狠咆哮的狼的图案，图案用血红色的颜料绘制而成。中间还有一匹重型的战马，已经被那些生物撕得支离破碎，死在了那里。 看起来这里发生过一场打斗，而且就在不久之前…… 经过一番快速搜寻，你从那些散落在地的破损武器中收集到了一堆金属碎片。 你获得了一些金属零件。
rows.raw: " A short time after you set out, you come across a small clearing in a valley between the hills that's lousy with black scavenger birds, picking around and squawking noisily. Your approach causes them to scatter in a flapping, screeching whirlwind — you shield yourself from a few particularly ornery crows and march forward to see what they were fussing over. The clearing is home to a handful of discarded, broken weapons and tattered banners flicking in the breeze. One bears a symbol of a horned wolf, snarling in blood-red paint. A heavy warhorse lies dead in the middle, picked to pieces by the flock. It looks like there was a fight here, and not all that long ago... After a quick search, you manage to collect a nice pile of metal scraps from all the broken weaponry laying about. You have obtained some metal parts."

rows.original:
Not long after you start walking, you[party.solo|| and your companion[party.som|||s]] find your[party.solo|self|selves] face-to-face with a small crack in one of the nearby rock-faces — a cave, small enough that you have to duck to enter it, and shallow enough that you'd barely be able to fit your body inside. Doesn't look like anybody's been here recently: spiderwebs droop from the rocky edges around the entrance, making the idea of going inside... unpleasant.

        You shake your head and turn back.
rows.translation:
你刚开始行走不久，就[party.solo|| 以及你的同伴[party.som|||s]] 找到属于你的东西[party.solo|自己|自己] 你站在附近的一处岩壁前——那岩壁上有一道小小的裂缝。洞穴很小，进去时必须弯下腰，而且洞穴也很浅，几乎容不下你的身体。看起来最近没有人来过这里：蜘蛛网从入口周围的岩石边缘垂下来，让人一想到要进去就觉得……有些不自在。

你摇了摇头，转身离开了。
rows.raw:
"
        Not long after you start walking, you[party.solo|| and your companion[party.som|||s]] find your[party.solo|self|selves] face-to-face with a small crack in one of the nearby rock-faces — a cave, small enough that you have to duck to enter it, and shallow enough that you'd barely be able to fit your body inside. Doesn't look like anybody's been here recently: spiderwebs droop from the rocky edges around the entrance, making the idea of going inside... unpleasant.

        You shake your head and turn back."

rows.original: You set out along one of the nearby paths, heading into the foothills once more. The better part of an hour later, you're fairly certain you've been turned around more times than you can count, and there's no sign of anything interesting where you have ended up. But the surprisingly peaceful journey has left you[party.solo||r party] feeling refreshed, looking forward to what comes next... You[party.solo||r party] recover[party.solo||s] some health.
rows.translation: 你沿着附近的一条小路出发，再次进入了山脚地带。大约一个小时后，你几乎可以肯定，自己已经被绕了好几圈，而你现在所处的地方显然没有任何有趣的东西。不过，这段出奇地宁静的旅程确实让你感到[party.solo||派对] 感到精神焕发，期待着接下来会发生什么…… 你[party.solo||派对] 恢复[party.solo||s] 一些生命值。
rows.raw: " You set out along one of the nearby paths, heading into the foothills once more. The better part of an hour later, you're fairly certain you've been turned around more times than you can count, and there's no sign of anything interesting where you have ended up. But the surprisingly peaceful journey has left you[party.solo||r party] feeling refreshed, looking forward to what comes next... You[party.solo||r party] recover[party.solo||s] some health."

rows.original: Unfortunately, it seems that the tower's entrance is jammed shut, and no amount of pounding appears to be able to force these open. It doesn't even look like they were supposed to be opened by hand, anyway — though the crumbling masonry, you catch an eyeful of old mechanisms, brass gears and the like encrusted with green tarnish to the point of immobility. There has to be another way in... maybe it'll present itself when the time is right.
rows.translation: 不幸的是，塔楼的入口似乎被卡住了，无论怎么敲打都无法将其打开。这些门看起来本来就不是设计用来用手打开的——不过从那些摇摇欲坠的砖石结构中，还是可以看到一些古老的机械装置、黄铜齿轮之类的东西，它们都被绿色的锈迹覆盖得完全动弹不得了。肯定还有其他的入口……也许等到时机成熟时，就会找到那条路。
rows.raw: "\n    Unfortunately, it seems that the tower's entrance is jammed shut, and no amount of pounding appears to be able to force these open. It doesn't even look like they were supposed to be opened by hand, anyway — though the crumbling masonry, you catch an eyeful of old mechanisms, brass gears and the like encrusted with green tarnish to the point of immobility. There has to be another way in... maybe it'll present itself when the time is right."

rows.translation: 帮助这位可怜的有翼少女吧。

rows.original: As you approach the northeastern edge of the foothills, you're forced through a winding pass that curves in a vague "S". The place itself appears empty, but you spot the remains of the orcs' attempts to build fortifications — broken palisades and half-dug trenches, amidst other things. They seem to have attempted incorporating the local elven ruins into their building, with varying degrees of success; in some places, the crumbling stonework and statues are more a liability than anything else. The air within the pass proper is still, but high above you flurries of snow whip and whistle frenziedly as they're carried down from the mountains by the wind, creating an eerie howling noise that simply doesn't let up. One might be able to withstand it for one day, perhaps two, but anyone attempting to fortify the pass would risk being driven to wits' end by the constant screaming noise. Little wonder, then, that the fortifications have been abandoned partway through their construction. [flags.ORC_QUEST_DESTROYED |The orc camp was destroyed thanks to you. Whatever Kervus are left are likely limping home, no threat to anybody. Best go back the way you came, lest you find a troll nesting... |[flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED -1 0 |The orc camp ahead has been sealed off to you. There's no way that you'll be allowed much closer than this after your overeager actions within. Best to fall back the way you came. ||[var0 |Though you can see a path forward, it'd be suicide to approach an entire orc warcamp without a plan. |There's nothing much else you can do here, save press on; lingering in this place is probably asking for trouble. ] ] ]
rows.translation: 当你接近山脚地的东北边缘时，必须穿过一条蜿蜒曲折、呈“S”形走势的山隘。这个地方看起来空无一人，但你可以看到兽人试图建造防御工事的遗迹——断裂的栅栏、半挖出来的壕沟，以及其他一些残余物。 他们似乎试图将当地的精灵遗迹融入到他们的建筑中，但成功程度不一；在某些地方，那些摇摇欲坠的石砌结构与雕像反而成了累赘。 山口内部的空气十分静止，但当你抬头望去时，会看到大雪被风从山上吹下来，疯狂地旋转着、呼啸着，发出令人毛骨悚然的噪音，这种声音始终不绝于耳。 也许有人能够忍受这种噪音一天，甚至两天，但任何试图加固这条通道的人都会被这种持续的尖叫声逼得抓狂。因此，这些防御工事在建造到一半时就被放弃了，这也不足为奇了。 [flags.ORC_QUEST_DESTROYED |多亏了你，那个兽人营地被摧毁了。现在剩下的那些克尔维斯族人恐怕都只能一瘸一拐地回家去了，根本不会对任何人构成威胁。你最好还是原路返回吧，否则的话……可能会遇到一些麻烦呢…… |[flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED -1 0 |前方的兽人营地已经对你进行了封锁。由于你之前的鲁莽行为，你根本不可能再靠近那里。最好的办法就是原路返回。 ||[var0 |虽然你能看到前方的道路，但如果没有计划就直接前往整个兽人营地，无异于自寻死路。 |在这里，你也没什么别的办法了，只能继续前进；如果继续呆在这个地方，恐怕只会招来麻烦。 ] ] ]
rows.raw: " As you approach the northeastern edge of the foothills, you're forced through a winding pass that curves in a vague "S". The place itself appears empty, but you spot the remains of the orcs' attempts to build fortifications — broken palisades and half-dug trenches, amidst other things. They seem to have attempted incorporating the local elven ruins into their building, with varying degrees of success; in some places, the crumbling stonework and statues are more a liability than anything else. The air within the pass proper is still, but high above you flurries of snow whip and whistle frenziedly as they're carried down from the mountains by the wind, creating an eerie howling noise that simply doesn't let up. One might be able to withstand it for one day, perhaps two, but anyone attempting to fortify the pass would risk being driven to wits' end by the constant screaming noise. Little wonder, then, that the fortifications have been abandoned partway through their construction. [flags.ORC_QUEST_DESTROYED |The orc camp was destroyed thanks to you. Whatever Kervus are left are likely limping home, no threat to anybody. Best go back the way you came, lest you find a troll nesting... |[flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED -1 0 |The orc camp ahead has been sealed off to you. There's no way that you'll be allowed much closer than this after your overeager actions within. Best to fall back the way you came. ||[var0 |Though you can see a path forward, it'd be suicide to approach an entire orc warcamp without a plan. |There's nothing much else you can do here, save press on; lingering in this place is probably asking for trouble. ] ] ]"

rows.original:
Ahead you see a wide open valley between two of the largest hills in the range, though it's been closed off on all sides by a wooden palisade. Tanned-hide tents and wooden huts are laid out in long rows past the walls, each issuing a billowing column of black smoke from its roof. You can hear the unmistakable sounds of civilization within: a din of voices all speaking over one another, mixed with singing and shouting and every other emotive voice all flowing together into one indistinguishable din.
    
    [flags.ORC_GATES_OPEN
        |The gates of the orcish warcamp have been thrown open, indicating that you're free to come and go as you please. [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED|The thane and his guards are standing outside, but they pay you due deference after their earlier defeat.]
        |It would almost look like another village, if it weren't for the half-dozen orcish warriors standing outside in their hide armor and furry cloaks, leaning on two-handed axes and hammers. You're still too far off to have piqued their interest, thankfully, but they certainly confirm that this is some sort of orcish warcamp.
    ]
rows.translation:
前方，你看到一条宽阔的山谷，它位于这片山脉中两座最大的山丘之间，不过山谷的四面都被木栅栏围了起来。棕褐色的皮帐篷和木屋排列成长长的队列，延伸到栅栏之外，每间房屋的屋顶上都冒着滚滚的黑烟。你能听到里面传来的那些充满生活气息的声音：人们的喧闹声此起彼伏，歌声、喊叫声以及其他各种情感表达的声音交织在一起，形成了一片难以区分的嘈杂声浪。
    
    [flags.ORC_GATES_OPEN
        |兽人军营的大门已经敞开，这意味着你可以自由进出，随心所欲地行动。 [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED|那名领主和他的卫兵们站在外面，但在之前被你击败之后，他们已经对你表示了应有的尊重。]
        |要不是外面有那六名穿着皮甲、披着毛茸茸斗篷的兽人战士，倚着双手斧和锤子站在那里，这个地方简直会看起来像另一个村庄。幸运的是，你目前还离他们太远，还没有引起他们的注意，但这些人确实证明了这里是一个兽人的营地。
    ]
rows.raw:
"
    Ahead you see a wide open valley between two of the largest hills in the range, though it's been closed off on all sides by a wooden palisade. Tanned-hide tents and wooden huts are laid out in long rows past the walls, each issuing a billowing column of black smoke from its roof. You can hear the unmistakable sounds of civilization within: a din of voices all speaking over one another, mixed with singing and shouting and every other emotive voice all flowing together into one indistinguishable din.
    
    [flags.ORC_GATES_OPEN
        |The gates of the orcish warcamp have been thrown open, indicating that you're free to come and go as you please. [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED|The thane and his guards are standing outside, but they pay you due deference after their earlier defeat.]
        |It would almost look like another village, if it weren't for the half-dozen orcish warriors standing outside in their hide armor and furry cloaks, leaning on two-handed axes and hammers. You're still too far off to have piqued their interest, thankfully, but they certainly confirm that this is some sort of orcish warcamp.
    ]"

rows.original: Hold on, that's an entire war camp full of orcs. They're not just going to let you walk in... if they so much as see you, you're likely to be enslaved or killed.
rows.translation: 等等，那可是一个满是兽人的整个军营啊。他们绝对不会让你轻易进去的……只要他们看到了你，你很可能会被奴役或者杀死。
rows.raw: "Hold on, that's an entire war camp full of orcs. They're not just going to let you walk in... if they so much as see you, you're likely to be enslaved or killed."

rows.original: This is definitely the place you're supposed to be meeting River[QUEST_SHADES_OF_THE_PAST.stateRange 3| and Garret], but you don't see [QUEST_SHADES_OF_THE_PAST.stateRange 3|them|him] anywhere. If you're ready to enter the cave, perhaps you should start looking around.
rows.translation: 这里绝对就是你应该与River见面的地方。[QUEST_SHADES_OF_THE_PAST.stateRange 3| 还有加勒特]但是你却看不到。 [QUEST_SHADES_OF_THE_PAST.stateRange 3|他们|他] 随便哪个地方都行。如果你已经准备好进入洞穴了，或许应该开始四处寻找了。
rows.raw: "\n        This is definitely the place you're supposed to be meeting River[QUEST_SHADES_OF_THE_PAST.stateRange 3| and Garret], but you don't see [QUEST_SHADES_OF_THE_PAST.stateRange 3|them|him] anywhere. If you're ready to enter the cave, perhaps you should start looking around."

rows.original: Look for River[QUEST_SHADES_OF_THE_PAST.stateRange 3| and Garret] so you can enter the cave and find the medallion.
rows.translation: 寻找河流吧。[QUEST_SHADES_OF_THE_PAST.stateRange 3| 还有加勒特] 这样你就可以进入洞穴并找到那枚奖章了。
rows.raw: "Look for River[QUEST_SHADES_OF_THE_PAST.stateRange 3| and Garret] so you can enter the cave and find the medallion."

rows.original:
You approach the statue of the minotaur, drawing forth your waystone charm and holding it up towards his own gem-set blade. The moment you hold up your own charm, you feel a tension rising in the air, and the atmosphere crackles with power. You grit your teeth and step forward, forcing yourself towards the ancient idol.

        And then, suddenly the pressure breaks, and the wind howls through the valley. The gemstone in the center of the stone sword shines and begins to pulse with inner light... it's awake! You grin and close your fist around the charm, watching as the light fades. The idol is awakened once more...
rows.translation:
你走向弥诺陶洛斯的雕像，取出自己的路石护符，将其举向他那镶嵌宝石的刀刃。就在你举起护身符的那一刻，你感觉到空气中弥漫着一种紧张的气氛，整个空间仿佛都被能量所充斥，充满了电轻型火石般的氛围。 你咬紧牙关，向前走去，强迫自己朝着那座古老的偶像走去。

就在这时，突然间，那种压迫感消失了，狂风在山谷中呼啸而过。那把石剑中央的宝石开始发轻型，内部仿佛有轻型在跳动。…它醒来了！你露出微笑，将那枚护身符握在拳头中，注视着轻型芒逐渐消失。这个神像又一次被唤醒了……

You grin and close your fist around the charm, watching as the light fades. The idol is awakened once more..."

rows.original: Ihzalti is here, hiding in her mossy-doored cave. [silly|Maybe she has benis jokes to tell you!|Thankfully, there's no chance of getting knocked down like the first visit.]
rows.translation: 伊兹阿尔蒂就在这里，躲在她那扇长满苔藓的门后的洞穴里。 [silly|也许她有一些关于“阴茎”的笑话可以讲给你听呢！|幸运的是，这次不会再像第一次访问时那样有被击倒的风险了。]
rows.raw: "Ihzalti is here, hiding in her mossy-doored cave. [silly|Maybe she has benis jokes to tell you!|Thankfully, there's no chance of getting knocked down like the first visit.]"

rows.original: [silly|This strange moss' mystery has eluded you long enough!|A quick look couldn't hurt.]
rows.translation: [silly|这种奇怪的苔藓之谜，已经让你困惑了太久了吧！|随便看一眼也没坏处。]
rows.raw: "[silly|This strange moss' mystery has eluded you long enough!|A quick look couldn't hurt.]"

rows.original: Ahead of you, nestled at the back of a small hollow in the hills, is a crumbling stone tower — probably a relic leftover from the Belharan wars in the northlands, though it's hard to say for sure with how weathered it's been with age. What's left of it, all six stories and half the crennellations, is surrounded by a man-sized stone wall with rusty spikes jutting up from the top, dissuading any visitors from daring assail the tower. And yet, you can see that it does have a visitor, pulling on the gates with futile grunts of effort. It's a harpy, you can see that much at a glance, but as you draw near you realize she's not the garden variety you've seen flocking all over the foothills. This particular harpy's standing on two long human legs, bare beneath her wool tunic, with smooth pale skin. Her snow-colored wings sprout not from her arms, but from her shoulders, wrapping around her whole body with massive, majestic feathers. And yet despite her huge wings, the fiery-haired girl is struggling to open the rusty gates of the tower courtyard... She notices you[party.solo||r party] approaching, and her feathery tail shoots up behind her in surprise. "Ahh! Oh, uh, h-hi," she gasps sheepishly, hopping away from the fence and putting her hands up in the air, revealing a lack of weapons — or any possessions at all, aside from her loose-fitting shirt. She brushes a short red lock of feather-hair from her face, revealing large golden eyes staring at you. "You look adventure-y. Could you help me?" Help her? You glance between the strange harpy and the shoulder-high stone wall, letting perplexion flow across your features. "Can't you just fly over?" She takes a big bite into her lower lip, ruffling the feathers on the back of her head. "Eheh, um... not... really. I'm not so good at the whole flying thing. That's why I'm here! My sisters told me that the wizard in this tower can help me. Make me more, you know, normal." The titanic wings behind her sweep backwards, tips brushing the ground and curved tops shadowing her cheeks. If anything, she looks like she ought to be a lot better at flying. "These sisters," you ask, "they the same ones that have been trying to rob me?" The girl's pale cheeks darken, and she cuts her eyes back towards the tower. "P-probably, yeah. Our mother's been like that lately, encouraging them to go find men and treasure like it's going out of style. Which it had till now, you know? I don't do that, 'course. Can't fly, so I can't keep up with them even if I wanted to." She shakes her head and turns her attention back to you, fighting back her obvious embarrassment. "I'm Shar," she offers, extending a hand towards you. Unlike her sisters', it's wholly human in shape, though she's got long, sharp claws in place of nails. "Will you help me get this gate open, please?"
rows.translation: 在你前方，群山中的一个小山谷里，有一座摇摇欲坠的石塔——这很可能是北方地区贝尔哈兰战争留下的遗迹，不过由于岁月侵蚀，已经很难确定它的真正来历了。这座塔原本有六层楼高，还有半数的垛口结构，如今残余的部分被一堵与人身高相当的石墙围了起来，墙上还竖着生锈的尖刺，这些障碍足以阻止任何试图接近这座塔的人。 然而，你仍然可以看到 做 有位访客来了，它正用徒劳无功的努力拉扯着大门。那是一只女妖，一眼就能看出来，但当你靠近时，你会发现它并不是那种在山脚下成群飞舞的普通女妖。 这只特殊的哈比人用两条修长的人类双腿站立，羊毛长袍下露出光洁的苍白肌肤。她那雪白色的翅膀并非长在手部臂上，而是从肩膀处展开，巨大的羽毛覆盖着她的整个身体，显得格外庄严而威武。 然而，尽管她拥有那双巨大的翅膀，这个火红头发的少女却仍在努力试图打开塔院那锈迹斑斑的大门…… 她注意到了你。[party.solo||派对] 她正慢慢靠近，突然，她那像羽毛一样的尾巴因为惊吓而猛地竖了起来。“啊！哦，呃，嗨……”她羞涩地喘着气，跳开了围栏，双手部举到空中，显然是没有携带任何武器——除了那件宽松的衬衫外，她身上根本没有任何其他东西。她把那一缕红色的羽毛头发从脸上拨开，露出那双金色的大眼睛，直直地盯着你。“你看起来很有冒险精神呢，能帮帮我吗？ 帮她吗？你将目光在那个奇怪的哈比女妖和那道齐肩高的石墙之间来回移动，脸上露出困惑的表情。“你就不能飞过去吗？” 她狠狠地咬了咬下唇，头顶的羽毛也因此微微颤动起来。“呃……其实不能。我不太擅长飞行啊。所以我才来到这里的！我的姐妹们说，这座塔里的巫师能帮助我，让我变得……更正常一些。 她身后那巨大的翅膀向后展开，翼尖轻轻触地，弯曲的翼面在阳光下投下阴影，仿佛遮住了她的脸颊。说实话，她看起来似乎应该更擅长飞行才对。 “这些姐妹……”你可能会问，“就是那些一直试图抢劫我的人吗？ 女孩苍白的脸颊顿时涨红了，她又将目光转向那座塔。“大概吧，是的。我们母亲最近一直这样，鼓励她们去寻找男人和宝藏，好像这是什么过时的行为似的。其实直到现在，这种做法也还算流行吧？我当然不会这么做。我又不会飞，所以就算我想跟上她们，也根本做不到。 她摇了摇头，又将注意力转回到你身上，努力掩饰自己明显的尴尬。“我叫莎尔，”她伸出手部向你说道。与她的姐妹们不同，她的手部完全是人类的形状，只不过手部指上长着长长的、锋利的爪子，而不是指甲。“请你帮帮我，把这道门打开好吗？

rows.original: Help Shar pry open the gate. If there's really wizardry involved, better be ready for anything... no matter how abandoned this place looks.
rows.translation: 帮助莎尔把大门撬开。如果这里真的涉及魔法，那么无论这个地方看起来多么荒废，我们都必须做好应对一切的准备……
rows.raw: "Help Shar pry open the gate. If there's really wizardry involved, better be ready for anything... no matter how abandoned this place looks."

rows.original: Help her add another harpy to the robbing flock that's been harassing you? No thanks.
rows.translation: 帮她再加入一只女妖到那群一直在骚扰你们的盗贼队伍里吗？不用了，谢谢。
rows.raw: "Help her add another harpy to the robbing flock that's been harassing you? No thanks."

rows.original:
"Alright, I'm in," you say, taking the harpy's offered hand. "I'm [pc.name]."

    Shar beams at you, wings fluttering behind her hard enough to lift her heels off the dirt. "Thank you! Oh, thank you so much. Nobody else would help me, not even my sisters. I just... I think I just need a boost over the gate, and then I'm sure the wizard will come if I knock on his door."
    
    You glance through the gate at the tower again. Hard to see if it even has a door anymore. And either way, you know enough from your time here in the Marches to tell that just tossing an innocent girl over a gate into a wizard's lair probably isn't going to end well for her. [pc.isDK|It'll just be a waste of your time boosting her over if she gets plastered on the ground a second later.|You'd better accompany her in, or she's likely to get hurt.]
    
    You tell Shar to step aside and [pc.clMulti blackmage warrior thief whitemage charmer|crack your knuckles, approaching the gate and channeling aetheric power through your fingers. A quick blast of raw magic is enough to send the old gate tumbling back off its hinges.|square up to the gate. One swift kick is all it takes to send it crashing back, right off its hinges.|take a knee next to the gate. Picking the lock takes you just a few moments; it's an old design, practically elementary, and no sooner do you hear it click and fall to the side than the whole gate simply falls back and crashes to the dirt.|crack your knuckles, approaching the gate and channeling aetheric power through your fingers. A quick blast of raw magic is enough to send the old gate tumbling back off its hinges.|lean yourself up against the gate, wiggling your eyebrows at it. "Hey baby, could you door me a favor and open?"
    
    Your weight was apparently all it needed to break off its hinges, and the whole gate crashes to the dirt. You give it a wink. "Thanks!"]
    
    "Wow!" Shar cheers, watching as the dust settles. "That was [pc.cl charmer|interesting|amazing]! I've never seen anything like that before. You really are the hero I needed."
    
    "I'm ready to go in... b-but maybe you could come with me? It's kinda spooky in there..."
rows.translation:
好的，我加入了，”你说道，握住了那只女妖伸来的手。“我 [pc.name]夏尔朝你灿烂地一笑，她的翅膀剧烈地振动，甚至让她的脚跟离开了地面。“谢谢你！真的，太感谢你了。没有人会帮助我，就连我的姐妹们也不会。我只是……我觉得只需要有人在我通过那道门的时候帮帮我，然后只要我去敲那位巫师的门，他肯定会出现的。你再次透过大门望向那座塔。几乎看不清它是否还有门存在。不过，根据你在这里的经历，你很清楚：把一个无辜的女孩扔过大门，送进巫师的巢穴，她的下场肯定不会好。 [pc.isDK|如果她刚被击倒，你再去帮助她，那只会浪费你的时间而已。|你最好陪她一起去，否则她很可能会受伤的。]
    
    你让Shar退到一边去，然后 [pc.clMulti blackmage warrior thief whitemage charmer|活动手指，靠近那扇大门，让以太能量从指尖流淌而出。只需释放一道纯粹的魔法能量，就能让那扇古老的门从铰链上脱落下来。|直接面对大门吧。只需一脚猛踢，就能把它彻底撞回原处，让它彻底失去作用。|在大门旁边跪下来。撬开锁只需要几分钟时间；这种锁的设计非常简单，几乎毫无难度。当你听到锁“咔嗒”一声被撬开、掉到一边的时候，整扇大门就会立刻倒塌下来，重重地落在地上。|活动手指，靠近那扇大门，让以太能量从指尖流淌而出。只需释放一道纯粹的魔法能量，就能让那扇古老的门从铰链上脱落下来。|你靠在门上，挑了挑眉毛对它说道：“嘿，宝贝，能帮个忙把门打开吗？”

显然，你的体重就足以让门从铰链上脱落，于是整扇门“砰”地掉在了地上。你朝它眨了眨眼：“谢谢！]
    
    哇！”莎尔兴奋地叫道，看着尘埃渐渐落定。“那真是 [pc.cl charmer|有趣|太棒了]我以前从未见过这样的东西，你真的是我所需要的英雄。”

“我准备进去了……但是，也许你可以陪我一起去吧？里面有点阴森森的……

rows.original:
You shake your head and turn to leave. No way you're helping one of that thieving flock.

    "H-hey!" Shar protests, following you a few paces. "Don't blame me for them being nasty to you. That's not fair! I just... I just want to be normal. Come on..."
    
    You're already on the path back the way you came. If Shar's as desperate as she sounds, she'll still be there if you change your mind.
rows.translation:
你摇了摇头，转身准备离开。绝对不可能去帮助那群小偷。

“喂！等等！”莎尔跟在你身后几步，急切地喊道，“别因为他们对你不好就责怪我。那太不公平了！我只是……我只是想过正常的生活而已。求你……”

你已经踏上了原路返回的脚步。如果莎尔真的像她说的那样绝望，那么只要你改变主意，她依然会在那里等着你。

"
    You shake your head and turn to leave. No way you're helping one of that thieving flock.

    "H-hey!" Shar protests, following you a few paces. "Don't blame me for them being nasty to you. That's not fair! I just... I just want to be normal. Come on..."
    
    You're already on the path back the way you came. If Shar's as desperate as she sounds, she'll still be there if you change your mind.
    
    "

rows.original:
You once again catch the attention of a little feathered troublemaker pawing at the gates of the crumbling tower, trying to find a way inside. She looks up at you with wide, hopeful eyes. 

        "Hi, again! D-did you change your mind about helping me? I really can't get in no matter what I try, at least not without impaling myself on those big spikes on the wall. What do you say?"
rows.translation:
你又一次吸引了一只正在啄弄那座摇摇欲坠的塔门、试图寻找进入方法的羽毛茸茸的小家伙的注意。它用充满希望的大眼睛望着你。

“嗨，又是你！你改变主意要帮助我了吗？我真的没办法进去，不管我怎么尝试，至少如果不先被墙上的那些大尖刺刺伤的话是进不去的。你觉得呢？

rows.raw: "Help her add another harpy to the robbing flock that's been harassing you? No thanks."

rows.original:
The white-feathered harpy hops up on your approach, her wings talking louder than her flapping arms. "[pc.name], you're back! Can we go in together, please? I tried to go in by myself but I freeze up after only one step. It's too scary and I umm, I can't fight and I can't fly..."
         
        She holds her clenched fists close to her chest. "Will you help me?"
rows.translation:

rows.original: Just as you're thinking on how old the statue must be, you notice its fingers start to move. You've got just enough time to grab Shar and throw her behind you before the statue — the golem thrusts its spear into the ground, pulling itself off its pedestal with a groan like breaking rock. "W-what!? It's alive!" Shar screams, scrambling back. Rather than running for her life, though, the harpy-girl grabs a chunk of metal from the broken gate and runs to your side, wielding it like a blunted spear. She sets her shoulders and spreads her wings, trying to make herself look as threatening as possible. It looks like Shar's fighting alongside you now!

rows.original:
The golem's spear-staff whirls around it with horrifying speed, battering your own [pc.weapon] aside. You stumble back, falling on your ass as the massive guardian advances. Rather than finishing you with its spear, the crumbling monstrosity raises one of its moss-covered feet to crush you once and for all.

    A second before it lands, you feel an impact on your shoulder, and you go rolling through the dirt. There's a scream behind you, and when you manage to get your bearings back and turn to face the golem, you see its foot coming back up in a plume of blood and feathers.
    
    Oh no, Shar...
    
    You stagger off as quick as you can, before the golem's attentions return to you. There's nothing left for you here...
rows.translation:
魔像手中的长矛以惊人的速度旋转着，不断攻击你方的人员。 [pc.weapon] 你踉跄着后退，就在那巨大的守护者逼近之际，你摔了个屁股蹲。然而，这个摇摇欲坠的怪物并没有用长矛结束你的生命，而是抬起它那被苔藓覆盖的足部，准备彻底将你踩碎。

就在它的足部即将落下的前一秒，你感到肩膀被什么东西撞了一下，随后你就滚进了泥泞之中。 你背后传来一声尖叫，当你终于回过神来，转身面对那个魔像时，你看到它的足部正带着一片血迹和羽毛重新抬起。

哦不，莎尔……

你赶紧踉跄着后退，生怕魔像再次将注意力转向你。 你在这里已经无路可走了……

rows.original:
As the final blows land on the golem, the last of its magic goes dark, and the construct crumbles to a pile of moss and marble. Dust flies in a thick, heavy cloud from its remains as you turn back to Shar.

    The harpy-girl sighs and slumps to her knees, letting her improvised spear clatter off to the side. "Oh Sorra... i-is it dead?"
    
    You nod. "Very."
    
    "I was so scared... it was trying to kill us! I'm so glad I had somebody with me, or I'd have gotten stomped on for sure. I'm not [a] [pc.class] like you! That was... that was so cool, watching you fight! Like something out of momma's storybooks."
    
    The fear drains right out of her as she starts to gush about the fight, recounting every parry and thrust with such enthusiasm that her fluttering wings bear her right back up to her feet. She starts following you as you approach the wizard's tower. The door's long ago crumbled to dust, letting you walk straight in. Shar's fast on your heels, bouncing with anticipation.
    
    "I hope this wizard's as powerful as my sisters said. I'll be able to fight like they can, with proper wings. Just butt-stomp anybody who wants to mess with me, like that evil statue, and... and..."
    
    She blinks, staring into the ruined tower over your shoulder. The interior is as ruined as the outside, a crumbling mess of old gray stone and thick vines. You can make out rotting chairs and a table inside, and stairs leading up that are missing half the steps. The fireplace opposite the door is dusted with ash and the carcass of a raccoon withered down to a skeleton.
    
    "... Oh," is all Shar has to say. She brushes past you towards the stairs and starts clambering, using little bursts from her wings to make up for her lack of athleticism, saving her from jumps and falls on the way.
rows.translation:
当最后的攻击击中那个魔像时，它身上剩下的所有魔力也瞬间消失了，那个由魔法构成的生物便崩解成了一堆苔藓和大理石碎片。从它的残骸中升起了厚厚的尘埃，你转身朝沙尔走去。

那个长着鹰爪的女孩叹了口气，跪倒在地，她临时制作的矛也掉在了旁边。“哦，索拉……它真的死了吗？”

你点了点头。“确实死了。”

“我当时真的好害怕……它竟然想要杀死我们！还好有你在身边，否则我肯定早就被它踩死了。我真是太幸运了…… [a] [pc.class] 太棒了！看着你战斗，真的太酷了……就像妈妈故事书里描述的场景一样。”

随着她开始热情洋溢地描述那场战斗，所有的恐惧都烟消云散了。她详细地回忆起了每一个招式和动作，语气充满兴奋，仿佛她那扑腾的翅膀真的让她重新站了起来。 当你接近巫师的塔楼时，她开始跟在你身后。那扇门早已腐朽成尘，因此你可以直接走进去。莎尔紧随你的足部步，兴奋地蹦蹦跳跳。

“希望这位巫师真的像我的姐妹们说的那样强大。 有了合适的翅膀，我就能像他们一样战斗了。任何想要招惹我的人，我都会像踩碎那座邪恶的雕像一样，把他们踩得粉身碎骨……”

她眨了眨眼，目光透过你的肩膀望向那座已被毁坏的塔楼。塔的内部和外部一样破败不堪，满是灰色的碎石和茂密的藤蔓。 里面可以看到一些腐烂的椅子和桌子，还有一段缺失了半数台阶的楼梯。门对面的壁炉上积满了灰烬，而一只浣熊的尸体也已经干枯得只剩下骨架。
    
    ……哦，”夏尔只是这样说道。她从你身边掠过，朝着楼梯走去，开始攀爬起来。她用翅膀轻轻一振，以此来弥补自己运动能力的不足，这样在攀爬的过程中才不会摔倒。

rows.original:
You climb up the last of the shattered stairs a few minutes later, arriving at the highest floor of the tower. It's the master's chambers, of that there's no doubt: it's dominated by a canopy bed and tattered remnants of silks and blankets, and [pc.cl blackmage whitemage|occult wards and seals|strange runes] have been carved all along the walls. A skeleton — human, this time, or near enough — is lying on the bed in the tatters of a night robe.

        "The wizard..." Shar moans, staring down at it. "There hasn't been anyone living here since forever, has there?"
        
        No, there certainly has not.
        
        You watch the harpy's wings tuck in against her back, and her little white tail flattens against her thick behind. "My sisters lied... did they know about the monster, too?"
        
        [pc.dcb|Probably. Maybe they were trying to get their mutant sister killed?|Doubtful... it only activated when you stepped into the courtyard. They'd have just flown over, right?|"Naaaah," you giggle. "That'd be way too mean."]
        
        She shakes her head and sits down on the edge of the bed, as far away from the skeleton as she can manage. "No wizard, no magic, no fixing my wings... I guess I'm stuck on the ground after all. Sorra must not love me very much."
        
        You glance around at the arrow-slit windows and cracked floors, showing the way down into the long shaft of the tower. "You're not on the ground now!"
        
        She blinks, looking up at you like you're speaking in tongues... and then she laughs, a hearty belly laugh that sees her doubling over and smiling ear to feathery ear. "Hahaha! Oh, that's... that's clever! I love it. Maybe I ought to stay here, then, get a little closer to the clouds. This fellow's not using the place anymore, and it's safe enough now that the statue's crumbled. That'd show my sisters who's boss, getting a tower of my own!"
        
        No doubt. And then you'd know where to find her again, too.
        
        "R-really? You would? It's settled then! I'll try and tidy up, maybe find somewhere to bury mister wizard and his pet cat downstairs. Thank you so much, [pc.name]. I promise, I'll be here if you ever want to, you know..."
        
        You give Shar a smile and turn to go.
rows.translation:
几分钟后，你爬上了最后一段残破的楼梯，来到了塔的最高层。毫无疑问，这里就是主人的寝室：房间中央摆放着一张 canopy bed，周围散落着破烂的丝绸和毯子 [pc.cl blackmage whitemage|隐秘的守卫与封印|陌生的符文] 墙壁上到处都刻着花纹。一张床子上，躺着一具骷髅——这次是人类骨骼，至少看起来很像人类。那骷髅穿着一件破烂的睡袍。

“那个巫师……”夏尔低声呻吟着，盯着那具骷髅。“从很久以前起，这里就再也没有人住过了，对吧？”

是的，确实没有人住过了。

你看到那只女妖的翅膀紧紧贴在背上，她那条白色的小尾巴也平贴在粗壮的臀部上。“我的姐妹们撒了谎……她们难道也知道有那个怪物存在吗？
        
        [pc.dcb|也许吧。他们可能是想让他们的变种人姐姐死掉？|不太可能……它只有在你走进院子的时候才会启动。他们本来可以直接飞过去吧？|才不会呢，”你笑着说，“那样太残忍了。]
        
        她摇了摇头，坐到了床边，尽量远离那个骷髅。“没有巫师，没有魔法，也无法修复我的翅膀……看来我终究还是只能留在地上了。索拉应该并不是很喜欢我吧。你环顾四周，那些被箭孔穿透的窗户和裂开的地板，都显示出这条通往塔内长通道的路。“你现在已经不在地面上了！”

她眨了眨眼，抬头看着你，仿佛你在说些她听不懂的话。然后她笑了，那是一种爽朗的笑声，让她整个人都弯成了两截，笑容从耳朵一直蔓延到发梢。“哈哈哈！哦，太……太聪明了！我太喜欢了。也许我应该留在这里，再靠近云朵一些吧。 这个家伙已经不再使用那个地方了，而且现在雕像已经毁坏了，那里也变得足够安全了。这样就能让我的姐妹们知道谁才是真正的老板——我也要有自己的塔楼了！

毫无疑问。而且这样你也就能知道以后在哪里能找到她了。
        
        真的吗？你愿意帮忙？那就这么定了！我会尽量把事情处理好，也许还能找个地方把那位巫师先生和他的宠物猫埋在楼下。真的太感谢你了 [pc.name]我保证，无论你什么时候需要我，我都会在这里的，你知道的……”

你对着Shar笑了笑，然后转身离开了。
