你坐在附近的一块岩石上，然后示意莎尔过来。她微笑着走向你，当你把她拉到自己腿上、用一只手部臂搂住她的腰时，她发出了少女般银铃般的笑声。她兴奋地扑闪着翅膀，依偎在你身边，把头靠在你的肩膀上。 [pc.chest]你微笑着，用手部指轻轻梳理她那浓密的红发，慢慢地从她的背部一直抚到她翅膀的根部。当你的手部指触碰到她的羽毛时，她轻轻喘息着，身体微微颤抖，你的手部陷入那柔软如绒的羽毛之中。当你抚摸她的时候，Shar发出了一声愉悦的轻哼；你几乎没注意到，她那纤细的小手部臂已经环抱住了你。 [pc.hips]紧紧地抱住你。你微笑着看着她，心满意足地沉醉在她柔软温暖的怀抱中，享受着她那像羽毛般轻柔的触感，以及她那柔软、富有弹性的身体紧贴着你的感觉。

你愉快地抚摸着莎尔几分钟，享受着她那柔软、蓬松的身体。不过，最终你还是放开了她，只在她的耳朵后面留下了一道抓痕，同时轻轻拍了拍她那圆润、柔软的尾巴。

“呵呵，感觉真是太棒了 [pc.name]你的动手部能力真棒！”她在你的额头上快速吻了一下，然后振翅飞走了。“让你继续工作吧！回头见！ [pc.title]你愉快地打了个哈欠，然后将注意力重新集中在前方的道路上。
rows.raw:
'
        You sit down on a nearby rock and motion Shar over. Smiling, she walks up to you, giggling girlishly when you pull her down onto your lap, wrapping an arm around her waist. Her wings flutter excitedly as she snuggles up to you, resting her head on your [pc.chest]. Smiling, you run your fingers through her thick crimson locks, slowly tracing your way down her back to the base of her wings. She gasps and shudders as your stroke her feathers, hand sinking into the downy softness. Shar lets out a quiet, happy moan as you pet her; you barely noticed her dainty little arms wrap around your [pc.hips], clutching tightly to you. You smile down at her, content to lose yourself in her soft, warm body, enjoying the pillowy wings brushing against you and the supple, yielding flesh pressed against yours.

        You spend a few pleasant minutes stroking Shar, enjoying your soft, fluffy harpy. Eventually, though, you let up, leaving her with a scratch behind the ear and a pat on her big, plush behind.
        
        "Hehe, that felt amazing, [pc.name]. You're great with your hands!" She gives you a quick kiss on the forehead before bouncing off, spreading her wings. "I'll let you get back to it! See you again soon, [pc.title]!"
        
        You yawn pleasantly and turn your attentions back to the road ahead.'

rows.original: Shar has such beautiful, snow white wings. They're unlike any other harpy's, and so incredibly soft. It's hard to resist the urge to reach out and pet her.
rows.translation: 莎尔的翅膀如此美丽，洁白如雪。她的翅膀与其他任何女妖的翅膀都不同，而且柔软得令人难以置信。人们实在忍不住想要伸手去抚摸她。
rows.raw: "Shar has such beautiful, snow white wings. They're unlike any other harpy's, and so incredibly soft. It's hard to resist the urge to reach out and pet her."

rows.original:
[flags.SHAR_PLAY_TIMES 1 2
            |You suggest to Shar that you ought to continue her fighting practice — she's got to learn to defend herself, doesn't she? The ginger harpy nods eagerly, "Yeah! I've been waiting with bated breath for you to teach me again. O-oh, hold on just a second, I've got something to show you!"

            Shar bolts into the tower, beating her snowy wings behind her hard enough to get a couple inches of lift up the stairs. She vanishes through the open arch of the door, and you hear a clatter and crash from inside as she starts searching for... something. Finally, she comes bounding back out, holding aloft a sword. Well, a wooden sword, but one that's been carved into the unmistakable shape of a Belharan gladius, with its leaf-shaped blade and short handle. The training sword's held together with string and leather, but as she hacks and slashes with it, it seems sturdy enough to serve. With a big grin, she presents the blade to you in both hands, as if she was handing over a master-crafted blade to a heroic warrior.
            
            "How long have you been working on this?" you ask, examining her handiwork.
            
            She giggles. "Since we last played! I knew as soon as we were done, I wanted to learn to use a real weapon... a knight's weapon. Been carving this ever since!"
            
            Well, alright. Let's see what she's got. You help remind her of her fighting stance, pressing your chest into her back and making her mirror the movements of your arms and legs. Her wings flutter behind her, downy feathers brushing your cheeks as the harpy settles into the stance. Gently, you start to move her arms in a slowed-down series of strikes and parries, showing her a few basic attacks and blocks. She catches on quick, and after a few minutes you step back from her, correcting her posture and maneuvers from a short distance as she once again mimics the moves you've taught her. Though she's a bit unsteady and constantly looks to you for correction or reassurance, you can't help but notice the girl has a certain grace and fluidity, almost making the simplest of strikes seem like dancing.
            
            You end things again when you see Shar huffing and puffing, sweat staining the front of her tight shift. "You did good, Shar. Let's call it for now."
            
            "I'm getting better, aren't I?" she asks, whirling her fake sword around her hips. She makes two whole revolutions before it goes spinning out of her hand and hurtles through one of the tower windows, crashing into something ceramic-sounding itself. Shar grimaces and fixes her attention on you, wings tucked.
            
            "Better... but not perfect. We'll work on it more," you tell her.
            
            She nods enthusiastically, bouncing on her heels. "Yay! Thanks so much, [pc.name]. I'll rest up and be ready to go for next time!"
            
            She comes in for a hug before bounding back towards the tower. "Bye, [pc.name]!" she calls as she vanishes into the open doorframe. Smiling to yourself, you turn your attentions back to your travel.
            |You ask Shar if she's up for a little swordplay. She nods eagerly, immediately producing the wooden sword she made. You help her get into proper stance and form, then step back and drill her through a few new strikes, parries, and flourishes. Though she begins the session nervous and constantly unsure of herself, by the end of the hour she's lucid and fluid, her movements carrying the innate grace and beauty you noticed the first time you trained her. She's still a bit unsteady at times, and with almost every move looks to you for approval, but a simple nod or smile has her working twice as hard, smiling wide as she lays low her make-believe opponents. Once in a while, you could swear you hear the harpy-girl muttering names under her breath, though you never quite make them out.

            Soon, Shar's panting heavily, working herself to the bone to perfect her technique. You call the session at the end of the hour, but before your "Good job," is halfway out your lips, Shar leaps on you with a giggling hug, pressing herself tight against your chest. Laughing with her, you stroke the harpy girl's feathers and tell her she's doing well. "Thanks so much, [pc.name]! You're the best teacher in the whole wide world!"
            
            You laugh it off, but just as Shar's about to take off for home, she plants a quick kiss on your cheek before bouncing back towards the tower. "I'm gonna sleep like a log now!"
            
            You smile and shake your head before heading on ahead with a little skip in your step.
            |As you consider what to do with the perky little harpy perched before you, her eyes drift downward to your [pc.weapon], and a big smile spread across her face. "Oh, oh! [pc.name], could you teach me how to use that? I wanna learn how to fight like you do! Please please please?"

            You look around the mountainside courtyard, eventually spying a long sproutling of a tree nearby. You snap off a branch, just about the right length and heft of a short spear and spend a few minutes carving into it with your knife, creating a blunted point and strapping it on by a few strands of string and leather. By the time you're done, it's a reasonable, albeit a bit crude, toy spear. With a squeal of glee, Shar takes it from you and bounds back, making loud "WOOSH!" sounds as she takes a few mock thrusts, each nearly throwing her off balance. Giggling loudly, the eager little harpy asks, "Okayokay, what do I do now?"
            
            You step behind Shar, pressing your [pc.chest] into her back as you take her arms in yours, guiding her into a basic fighting stance. Her wings flutter behind her, downy feathers brushing your cheeks as the harpy settles into the stance. Gently, you start to move her arms in a slowed-down series of strikes and parries, showing her a few basic attacks and blocks. She catches on quick, and after a few minutes you step back from her, correcting her posture and maneuvers from a short distance as she mimics the moves you've taught her. Though she's a bit unsteady and constantly looks to you for correction or reassurance, you can't help but notice the girl has a certain grace and fluidity, almost making the simplest of strikes seem like dancing.
            
            "You might make a decent fighter after all," you say, ruffling Shar's feathery hair as she finishes another set of thrusts, her buxom chest heaving as she begins to tire.
            
            "What do you think, [pc.name]? D-did I really do well?"
            
            You assure her she did, and that she'll only get better with time and practice.
            
            "You mean it? Oh, thank you so much!" the little harpy cries, jumping into your arms and locking you in a big, tight hug. "I'm gettin' pretty tired now, but if — when — I see you again, will you promise to teach me some more?"
            
            You nod and wave as Shar bounds back towards the tower. "Bye, [pc.name]!" she calls as she vanishes into the open doorframe. Smiling to yourself, you turn your attentions back to your travel.
        ]
rows.translation:
[flags.SHAR_PLAY_TIMES 1 2
            |你建议莎尔继续她的战斗训练——她总得学会保护自己，对吧？那个红发的女妖兴奋地点了点头：“没错！我一直都在迫不及待地等着你再教我呢。哦，等一下，我有点东西要给你看！

            夏尔猛地冲进塔内，雪白的翅膀在身后剧烈地拍打，使她能够向上爬升几英寸的楼梯。她穿过敞开的门拱消失了，而从里面传来了碰撞声和嘈杂声，显然她已经开始进行搜寻了。终于，她蹦蹦跳跳地跑了回来，手里举着一把剑——嗯，其实是一把木剑，但它的形状完全就是贝拉兰短剑的模样，有着叶片状的刀刃和短柄。这把练习剑是用绳子和皮革固定在一起的，不过当她用它挥砍的时候，看起来确实足够结实，可以使用了。 她咧着大大的笑容，双手将那把刀递给你，仿佛是在将一把精心打造的武器交给一位英勇的战士。
            
            你花了多长时间来制作这个？”你一边询问，一边仔细观察她的作品。

她咯咯笑了起来：“从我们上次一起玩游戏之后就开始做的！一完成游戏，我就立刻决定要学习如何使用真正的武器……一个骑士应该用的武器。从那以后，我就一直在制作这个！
            
            好吧，那就看看她能做些什么吧。你帮忙提醒她保持正确的战斗姿势：把你的胸膛贴在她的背上，让她模仿你手臂和腿的动作。当这个女妖进入战斗姿态时，她的翅膀会在背后扇动，柔软的羽毛会轻拂你的脸颊。 你轻轻地引导她，以缓慢的动作示范了一系列攻击和格挡动作，向她展示了几个基本的攻击技巧与防御方法。她很快就掌握了这些动作，几分钟后，你退到了一旁，从距离稍远的地方纠正她的姿势和动作技巧，而她则再次模仿着你教给她的那些动作。 虽然她动作有些不稳，总是需要你的纠正或安慰，但你不得不注意到，这个女孩身上确实有一种独特的优雅与流畅感，使得她最简单的动作看起来都像是在跳舞。
            
            当你看到莎尔气喘吁吁、汗水浸湿了她那紧身的工作服时，你又一次制止了她的动作。“你做得很好，莎尔。暂时就到这里吧。”

“我正在进步，对吧？”她一边说着，一边将那把假剑在腰间旋转。她让剑绕了整整两圈，然后它突然从她手中飞了出去，穿过塔楼的一扇窗户，撞到了什么东西上，发出类似陶瓷破碎的声音。莎尔皱起了眉头，然后将注意力重新集中在你身上，双翼紧紧地收了起来。
            
            已经好多了……但还不够完美。我们还会继续改进的，”你对她说。

她兴奋地点了点头，还轻轻跳起了脚跟：“太好了！真的非常感谢你！ [pc.name]我先休息一下，下次再继续行动吧！”

她进来拥抱了我一下，然后又蹦蹦跳跳地跑回了塔楼里。“再见啦！ [pc.name]再见！”她边说着边消失在了敞开的门框中。你微笑着，又将注意力重新转向自己的旅途。
            |你询问莎尔是否愿意一起练习一下剑术。她急切地点了点头，立刻拿出了自己制作的木剑。你帮助她摆出正确的姿势和动作要领，然后退后一步，教她练习一些新的攻击招式、格挡动作以及花式剑法。 虽然她在训练开始时显得紧张不安，总是缺乏自信，但一个小时结束后，她的动作已经变得流畅而自然，那些你第一次见到她训练时就注意到的优雅与美感再次显现出来。她有时仍然会显得有些不稳，几乎每一个动作都会看向你寻求认可，但只要你简单地点头或微笑，她就会加倍努力，脸上洋溢着笑容，继续与那些假想的对手部进行训练。 偶尔，你会觉得仿佛能听到那个女妖般的女孩在低声念着什么名字，不过你始终听不清楚那些内容。

不久之后，莎尔的呼吸变得愈发急促，她正在竭尽全力地练习，以求将这项技巧掌握得更加娴熟。 时间刚过一小时，你就打算结束这次会话，就在你刚要说出“干得不错”这句话的时候，莎尔突然笑着扑上来，紧紧抱住你，把身体紧紧贴在你的胸前。你陪着她一起笑，同时轻轻抚摸着这个拥有鹰爪面容的女孩的羽毛，对她说她做得很好。 太感谢了， [pc.name]你真的是全世界最棒的老师啊！”

你笑着回应，但就在莎尔准备回家时，她突然在你脸上快速吻了一下，然后蹦蹦跳跳地跑回了塔楼。“我现在要睡个好觉了！”

你微笑着摇了摇头，然后迈着轻快的步伐继续前行。
            |当你思考该如何处理眼前这只活泼可爱的小女妖时，她的目光不由自主地落在了你的身上 [pc.weapon]她的脸上绽放出了灿烂的笑容。“哦，哦！ [pc.name]你能教我怎么使用那个吗？我想学会像你一样战斗！求你啦求你啦！”

你环顾四周，最终在山坡上的院子里发现了一棵正在发芽的树。你折下一根树枝，它的长度和重量正好适合做成一根短矛，然后你用刀把树枝削尖，再用几根绳子和皮革把它固定好。 当你完成制作后，就会得到一支还算不错、虽然有点粗糙的玩具长矛。夏尔高兴地尖叫着从你手部中接过它，然后蹦蹦跳跳地跑开，一边模拟着使用长矛刺击的动作，一边发出“呜呼！”的声响，每次刺击都差点让她失去平衡。 大笑着，那个迫不及待的小女妖问道：“好吧好吧，现在我该做什么呢？”

你走到莎尔的身后，按住了她的 [pc.chest] 当你握住她的手部臂，引导她进入基本的战斗姿势时，她的翅膀在身后轻轻颤动，柔软的羽毛轻拂着你的脸颊。你缓缓地引导她进行一系列缓慢的攻击与格挡动作，向她演示了一些基本的攻击技巧和防御方法。 她学习得很快，几分钟后，当你站在稍远的地方观察她时，会发现她正在模仿你教给她的动作，同时你也不断纠正她的姿势和动作技巧。虽然她还有些不稳，总是向你寻求帮助或鼓励，但你不得不注意到，这个女孩身上有一种独特的优雅与流畅性，使得最简单的动作看起来都像是在跳舞。
            
            说起来，你或许能成为一个不错的战士呢。”你一边说着，一边轻轻拨弄着莎尔那蓬松的羽毛。此时，她刚刚完成又一组攻击动作，那饱满的胸脯因疲劳而微微起伏。

“你怎么看？”你继续问道。 [pc.name]我、我真的做得很好吗？”

你安慰她，告诉她她确实做得很好，而且随着时间和练习，她的表现一定会更好。

“你是认真的吗？哦，太谢谢你了！”小女妖兴奋地叫道，跳进你的怀里，紧紧地抱住了你。“我现在有点累了，但是如果——等我们再见面的时候，你能再教我一些吗？”

你点了点头，然后看着莎尔跑回塔楼的方向，挥了挥手部说：“再见。 [pc.name]再见！”她边说着边消失在敞开的门框中。你微笑着，又将注意力重新转向自己的旅途。
        ]

            You nod and wave as Shar bounds back towards the tower. "Bye, [pc.name]!" she calls as she vanishes into the open doorframe. Smiling to yourself, you turn your attentions back to your travel.
        ]'

rows.original:
After a moment's consideration, you decide to start at the beginning: your first adventure here in the Frost Marches, setting out at Cait's side to find her missing sister.

        [party.has cait|"And [pc.heShe] was so heroic!" your pink priestess adds, putting a hand to your shoulder. "I wandered into town bloody and broken, but nobody else would even acknowledge me. Nobody but [pc.name]."]
        
        You tell her that it all started with a blizzard, trapping you in the little hamlet of Hawkethorne for about a week. Just as it was starting to clear up, though, a young catgirl priestess came staggering in all bloodied. She's said that she and her sister had been ambushed, and her sister had been dragged off by the men that did it. Cait, the priestess called herself, begged for help, but you were the only one who would answer her call.
        
        "Of course you did!" Shar grins. "You helped me, too. That's the kinda person you are."
        
        It sure seems like it. And just like with Shar's golem, you hadn't expected to find so many enemies in your path to Calla. The black-robed and tattooed cultists tried to prevent you climbing the nearby hill to where their temple was, but no matter how hard they hit you, you and Cait refused to fall back. Eventually, you made it to the top of the hill...
        
        [flags.SHAR_STORY_TOLLUS
            |"And there was Tollus!" Shar gasps, tensing for the fight as if she was really there.
            |"W-what was up there?" Shar whimpers, tensing despite her distance from the conflict.
        ] You pull her close, telling that indeed, standing before a great crackling portal to another world was a tall, gaunt man covered in lurid tattoos screeching about his dark mistress while he threw Calla into the writhing portal. Cait charged in first, clashing staff to staff with the bald man as the battle began. 
        
        It was the hardest battle you'd ever fought in your life — by that point, anyway. Tollus was a powerful wizard, wielding corrupted magics and a bladed staff with equal skill. The harder you hit, the more he fell back upon his dark arcana, nearly driving you to the brink. [
            flags.BEAT_TOLLUS
            |Luckily, you managed to overpower him in the end, forcing the cult-master to flee.
            |In fact, you couldn't beat him, no matter how hard you pushed yourself — back then, you were too weak.
        ]
        
        Shar gasps, but you carry on — the most important part of the story is still ahead. In that moment, the portal exploded in a conflagration of wild magic, blasting you unconscious as the temple crumbled around you. When you came to, a red demon was standing over you...
        
        "W-what happened then?"
        
        [flags.TUT_STATUS 6|You grin at the captivated harpy, but tell her "That's a story for another time..." ]What's important from your first encounter with Kasyrra was that the demoness told you that she'd be back for your soul. You've got no choice but to stop her if you want to keep your soul, to say nothing of the chaos that's engulfing the world in her wake.
        
        "You're gonna beat her butt! I'm sure of it!" Shar cheers, fluttering her wings in your lap. "No way some nasty demon-wench is gonna triumph over my [pc.name]."
        
        Not if you have anything to say about it... But that's enough for storytime. You ruffle Shar's feathery red hair, rough enough to make her eyes squeeze closed as she giggles and squeals. "Thanks for sharing, [pc.name]! Give that demon a kick in the twat for me, okay?"
        
        "We'll see," you say, hefting her off your lap. Time to get back to the mission.
rows.translation:
经过片刻思考，你决定从头开始：重新经历你在霜冻边境的第一次冒险，与凯特一起出发，去寻找她失踪的妹妹。

        [party.has cait|然后 [pc.heShe] 真是太英勇了！”你的粉色女祭司一边说，一边把手放在你的肩上。“我满身是伤地走进了小镇，但没有人愿意理会我。除了……没有人。 [pc.name]."]
        
        你告诉她，这一切都是因为一场暴风雪，你被困在了鹰棘镇这个小村庄里，大约有一周的时间。然而就在天气开始放晴的时候，一位年轻的猫女祭司蹒跚着走了进来，浑身是血。她说她和她的妹妹遭到了埋伏，而她的妹妹被那些袭击他们的人带走了。 那个自称为女祭司的凯特恳求帮助，但只有你回应了她的呼唤。

“你当然会帮忙了！”沙尔笑着说，“你也曾帮助过我，你就是这样的一个人。”

看来确实是这样。 就像在应对莎尔的魔像时一样，你在前往卡拉的路上也完全没有预料到会遇到如此多的敌人。那些身穿黑袍、身上布满纹身的邪教徒试图阻止你登上附近的山丘，去往他们的寺庙所在之处，但无论他们如何攻击你，你和凯特都坚决不肯后退。 最终，你成功登上了山顶……
        
        [flags.SHAR_STORY_TOLLUS
            |还有托卢斯！”莎尔惊呼道，她仿佛真的置身于那场战斗之中，全身都绷紧了。
            |那、那上面发生了什么？”夏尔颤抖着问道，尽管她与冲突的发生地相距甚远，但她依然感到紧张不安。
        ] 你将她拉到身边，告诉她：的确，在那扇通向另一个世界的巨大、发出噼啪声的传送门前，站着的是一个高大而消瘦的男人，他的身上布满了鲜艳的纹身；那个男人正在大声呼喊着他那暗影的女主人，同时还将卡拉推进了那扇不断扭动的传送门之中。 战斗一开始，凯特就率先冲了上去，她的法杖与那个光头男子的法杖激烈地碰撞在了一起。

那绝对是你这一生中经历过的最激烈的战斗——至少在那个时候是如此。托卢斯是一位强大的巫师，他能够熟练地运用那些被污染了的魔法，同时也能熟练地操纵那根带刃的法杖。 你攻击得越猛烈，他就越是依赖那些暗影的秘术，几乎要把你逼到绝境。 [
            flags.BEAT_TOLLUS
            |幸运的是，你最终成功地制服了他，迫使那个邪教头目逃走了。
            |事实上，无论你多么努力地去尝试，你也根本无法打败他——在那个时候，你实在太弱小了。
        ]
        
        夏尔倒抽了一口气，但你继续前行——故事中最重要的部分还在后面。就在那一刻，传送门在狂暴的魔法爆炸中彻底毁灭，巨大的冲击力使你失去了意识，而周围的寺庙也在瞬间崩塌。当你恢复意识时，一个红色恶魔正站在你的面前……

“那、然后发生了什么？
        
        [flags.TUT_STATUS 6|你对着那被迷住的哈皮露出微笑，但告诉她：“这个故事改天再讲吧…… ]你与卡希拉的初次相遇至关重要，因为那个女恶魔当时告诉你，她会回来夺走你的灵魂。如果你想保住自己的灵魂，就不得不阻止她——更不用说她所造成的、正在席卷整个世界的混乱了。

“你一定能打败她的！我绝对相信！”莎尔在你膝边扑腾着翅膀，兴奋地说道，“那个讨厌的女恶魔怎么可能战胜我呢 [pc.name]如果你有什么要说的的话，当然可以……不过，故事时间到此为止吧。你轻轻拨了拨莎尔那蓬松的红发，那些头发摸起来相当粗糙，以至于她咯咯笑着，眼睛都不自觉地闭了起来。‘谢谢你分享这些故事。 [pc.name]帮我把那个恶魔的屁股踢一顿，好吗？”

“我们看看吧，”你说着，把她从你腿上抱起来。是时候继续执行任务了。

rows.original: Tell Shar the story of your first encounter with the vile master of Kasyrra's demon cult.
rows.translation: 向莎尔讲述你第一次遇见卡希拉恶魔崇拜团那个邪恶首领的经历吧。
rows.raw: "Tell Shar the story of your first encounter with the vile master of Kasyrra's demon cult."

rows.original: The first thing that comes to mind after Shar's request is your conquest of the Alraune. You tell Shar that here in the foothills, she can see everything coming at her from the windows of her tower, but in the forest, it's nothing but darkness and brush that hides enemies behind every bush. Within that ancient and shadowed woods, you encountered a group of beautiful green temptresses — living plants with vines and flowers drooling with nectar. Living, walking temptresses of the forest, demanding that all within assist their mother in propagating their race. "Sounds like my sisters!" Shar giggles. She's not wrong. Maybe the reason's related — or maybe everything in the Marches is just oversexed? Either way, the result was the same: you were accosted at every turn by the effigies who wanted nothing more than to breed. It quickly became clear that you needed to track down this 'mother' of theirs and put a stop to her machinations. And so you began your march through the forest, fighting at every step, until finally you reached a glade surrounded by human-sized flowers covered in writhing vines. Shar coos, fluttering her wings. "How beautiful! There are so few flowers and pretty things here in the hills... and up in the mountains, where mother lives, it's all snow and ice. I'd love to see that garden someday, even with all the monsters!" Speaking of monsters... You tell her that as soon as you entered the garden, you were confronted by another of the effigies, this one a songstress covered in warpaint and beating away on a set of drums as all her sisters danced around her. The Herald commanded her siblings to capture you in the name of their mysterious mother. Of course, you defeated her, but that only made the Herald run screaming back to her mother. Shar giggles at that, kicking her feet and nearly doubling over. "S-she really went crying home to her mommy? Haha! Wow, that makes me seem brave!" Oh yeah, it was a heroic moment for the plant-slut. Nevertheless, the Herald's cries did draw the attention of the corrupted glade's matron, the Alraune herself. She appeared from a titanic flower: a huge, voluptuous green-skinned woman whose lower body was the heart of her verdant flower, surrounded by animated vines that attacked with lusty abandon. Her tentacles grabbed and groped at you relentlessly, but it turned out that the plant matron had a severe weakness to fire and holy power, and after a great struggle to escape her grappling vines, you were able to climb into her flowery exterior and forced her into submission. Of course, you first asked the Alraune "Why are you doing this? What made you want to attack people?" "You mean, what made her evil?" Shar asks. Exactly. What could make a sweet little plant turn into a monster that attacked people at any opportunity. The answer? The only thing that made sense, of course, was the influence of your demonic nemesis Kasyrra. Your one-harpy audience gasps, covering her mouth as you mention the dark temptress's name. Of course Kas was behind the Alraune; she abandoned the corrupted creature in your path to slow you down, keep you from chasing her further north. "W-what happened to the Alraune, though? Did you smite her with your sword of righteousness?" [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED |You sure did. For all her crimes, for all her corruption, there was only one possible end to the Alraune. Even if you were of a mind to spare a corrupted foe, she was literally planted in the earth. There was no removing her, and so you struck the tainted tart down. Shar gasps when you describe the killing blow, but cheers when you tell her that the monster's death caused its remaining minions to flee in the night, leaving the forest much safer than before. |In this case, no. The Alraune matron was a product of her creatrix, an unwitting pawn to Kasyrra's plans. You couldn't bring yourself to kill her, but there was no way you could simply leave her to her own devices. So you subjugated her, made her yours, bent her body and will to your own service. In so doing, you deprived Kasyrra of a valuable ally and secured the trade road through the Old Forest. Shar blushes bright red as you describe the process, but nevertheless, she gives a little cheer when you confirm that to this day, the Alraune is still subservient to you. ] And that's the end of that story. Shar smiles and nestles her cheek into your shoulder, "Thanks for the story! You always sound so heroic and awesome by the end. I hope someday I can be half as strong..." With a little luck and dedication, she just might be. You ruffle her feathery red hair and tell her to keep practicing. For now, you'll take your leave.
rows.translation: 在听到莎尔的请求后，我首先想到的就是你们曾经征服阿尔劳恩的事。你告诉莎尔，在这些山足部下，她可以从塔楼的窗户里清楚地看到一切即将向她袭来的敌人；但在森林里，到处都是暗影和灌木丛，这些障碍物会隐藏住藏在每一丛灌木后的敌人。 在那片古老而阴暗的森林里，你遇到了一群美丽的绿色诱惑者——那些长着藤蔓和花朵、散发着甘甜花蜜的活生生的植物。它们就像是森林里行走的诱惑者，要求所有经过那里的生物帮助它们的“母亲”繁衍后代。 听起来和我姐姐们一样啊！”莎尔咯咯地笑了起来。 她说的没错。也许原因就在这里——又或者，也许整个边境地区的人都过于热衷于繁衍后代了？不管怎样，结果都是一样的：无论你走到哪里，都会遇到那些一心只想繁衍后代的生物。 很快你就意识到，必须找到他们的这个“幕后主使”，并阻止她的阴谋。于是，你开始在森林中艰难前行，每前进一步都不得不与敌人战斗，直到最终，你来到了一片被人类大小的花朵环绕的空地，那些花朵上还缠绕着蜿蜒的藤蔓。 沙尔轻声鸣叫着，扑动着翅膀。“多美啊！在山丘上，这样的花朵和美丽的景色真是太少了……而在妈妈居住的山区，到处都是冰雪。我真希望能有朝一日能看到那个花园，哪怕那里有各种各样的怪物！说到怪物……你告诉她，你一进入那个花园，就遇到了另一个这样的怪物——那个怪物是一个涂满战涂的歌手，她正在敲打鼓，而她的所有姐妹都在她周围跳舞。 那位女先知命令她的兄弟姐妹们以她们那位神秘母亲的名义抓住你。当然，你最终打败了她，但这也使得那位女先知惊慌失措地跑回去向她的母亲报告。 夏尔听到这个说法后忍不住咯咯笑了起来，足部不停地踢着，差点笑翻在地。“她真的哭着回家找妈妈了？哈哈！哇，真是太搞笑了 我 看起来真勇敢啊！” 哦，没错，对那个‘植物荡妇’来说，那确实是一个英勇的时刻。不过，那位传令官的呼喊确实吸引了那片被腐蚀的森林里的女王——阿尔劳娜本人的注意。她从一朵巨大的花朵中出现了：那是一个皮肤呈绿色的庞然女子，她的下半身其实就是那朵绿色花朵的核心部分，周围缠绕着那些充满欲望的藤蔓，它们不断地向她发起攻击。 它的触手不断地抓住你、缠绕着你，但事实证明，这种植物怪物对火焰与神圣力量有着极大的弱点。经过一番艰苦的挣扎，你终于摆脱了它那些缠绕你的藤蔓，爬上了它那布满花朵的外表，迫使它屈服了。 当然，你首先问了阿尔劳娜：“你为什么要这么做？是什么让你想要攻击别人呢？” “你是想问，是什么让她变成了邪恶的存在？”莎尔问道。 没错。究竟是什么让一株原本可爱的小植物变成了一只一有机会就会攻击人的怪物呢？ 答案是什么呢？当然，唯一合理的解释就是你的恶魔宿敌卡希拉的影响。当你提到这个邪恶女魔的名字时，在场的观众们都惊呼出声，纷纷捂住嘴巴。毫无疑问，卡希拉才是幕后黑手；她放任那个被腐蚀的生物出现在你的路上，就是为了拖慢你的足部步，阻止你继续向北方追击她。 那么，阿尔劳奈到底发生了什么事？你是用你的正义之剑击中了她吗？ [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED |你确实做到了。对于她所犯下的所有罪行，对于她所表现出的所有腐败行为，阿尔劳奈只有一个可能的结局。即使你愿意宽恕一个堕落的敌人，但她已经被彻底埋入地下——根本不可能再将她挖出来。因此，你果断地消灭了这个被污染的怪物。当你描述那致命一击时，夏尔会倒抽冷气；但当你告诉她，这个怪物的死亡使得它剩下的爪牙在夜色中四散逃窜，从而使森林变得比以前安全了许多时，她又会欢呼起来。 |在这种情况下，不行。阿尔劳恩这位女祭司其实是她的创造者有意设计出来的产物，只是卡希拉计划中一个无意识的棋子。你实在不忍心杀死她，但也不能任由她为所欲为。所以你征服了她，让她成为你的工具，迫使她的身体和意志为你服务。 通过这样的行动，你剥夺了卡希拉这个宝贵的盟友，同时也确保了穿越古旧森林的贸易道路的安全。 当你描述这一过程时，莎尔的脸颊顿时变得通红，但当你确认直到今天，阿尔劳内仍然受你的控制时，她还是高兴地欢呼了一声。 ] 故事就这样结束了。莎尔微笑着，把脸颊贴在你的肩上：“谢谢你讲这个故事！每次听完你的讲述，你总是显得那么英勇、那么了不起。我希望有朝一日，自己也能有你一半的能力……” 只要稍加努力和坚持，她完全有可能做到。你轻轻揉了揉她那红色的头发，鼓励她继续练习。现在，你该告辞了。
rows.raw: " The first thing that comes to mind after Shar's request is your conquest of the Alraune. You tell Shar that here in the foothills, she can see everything coming at her from the windows of her tower, but in the forest, it's nothing but darkness and brush that hides enemies behind every bush. Within that ancient and shadowed woods, you encountered a group of beautiful green temptresses — living plants with vines and flowers drooling with nectar. Living, walking temptresses of the forest, demanding that all within assist their mother in propagating their race. "Sounds like my sisters!" Shar giggles. She's not wrong. Maybe the reason's related — or maybe everything in the Marches is just oversexed? Either way, the result was the same: you were accosted at every turn by the effigies who wanted nothing more than to breed. It quickly became clear that you needed to track down this 'mother' of theirs and put a stop to her machinations. And so you began your march through the forest, fighting at every step, until finally you reached a glade surrounded by human-sized flowers covered in writhing vines. Shar coos, fluttering her wings. "How beautiful! There are so few flowers and pretty things here in the hills... and up in the mountains, where mother lives, it's all snow and ice. I'd love to see that garden someday, even with all the monsters!" Speaking of monsters... You tell her that as soon as you entered the garden, you were confronted by another of the effigies, this one a songstress covered in warpaint and beating away on a set of drums as all her sisters danced around her. The Herald commanded her siblings to capture you in the name of their mysterious mother. Of course, you defeated her, but that only made the Herald run screaming back to her mother. Shar giggles at that, kicking her feet and nearly doubling over. "S-she really went crying home to her mommy? Haha! Wow, that makes me seem brave!" Oh yeah, it was a heroic moment for the plant-slut. Nevertheless, the Herald's cries did draw the attention of the corrupted glade's matron, the Alraune herself. She appeared from a titanic flower: a huge, voluptuous green-skinned woman whose lower body was the heart of her verdant flower, surrounded by animated vines that attacked with lusty abandon. Her tentacles grabbed and groped at you relentlessly, but it turned out that the plant matron had a severe weakness to fire and holy power, and after a great struggle to escape her grappling vines, you were able to climb into her flowery exterior and forced her into submission. Of course, you first asked the Alraune "Why are you doing this? What made you want to attack people?" "You mean, what made her evil?" Shar asks. Exactly. What could make a sweet little plant turn into a monster that attacked people at any opportunity. The answer? The only thing that made sense, of course, was the influence of your demonic nemesis Kasyrra. Your one-harpy audience gasps, covering her mouth as you mention the dark temptress's name. Of course Kas was behind the Alraune; she abandoned the corrupted creature in your path to slow you down, keep you from chasing her further north. "W-what happened to the Alraune, though? Did you smite her with your sword of righteousness?" [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED |You sure did. For all her crimes, for all her corruption, there was only one possible end to the Alraune. Even if you were of a mind to spare a corrupted foe, she was literally planted in the earth. There was no removing her, and so you struck the tainted tart down. Shar gasps when you describe the killing blow, but cheers when you tell her that the monster's death caused its remaining minions to flee in the night, leaving the forest much safer than before. |In this case, no. The Alraune matron was a product of her creatrix, an unwitting pawn to Kasyrra's plans. You couldn't bring yourself to kill her, but there was no way you could simply leave her to her own devices. So you subjugated her, made her yours, bent her body and will to your own service. In so doing, you deprived Kasyrra of a valuable ally and secured the trade road through the Old Forest. Shar blushes bright red as you describe the process, but nevertheless, she gives a little cheer when you confirm that to this day, the Alraune is still subservient to you. ] And that's the end of that story. Shar smiles and nestles her cheek into your shoulder, "Thanks for the story! You always sound so heroic and awesome by the end. I hope someday I can be half as strong..." With a little luck and dedication, she just might be. You ruffle her feathery red hair and tell her to keep practicing. For now, you'll take your leave."

rows.original: Tell Shar about your encounter with the Alraune, the corrupted plant-creature of the Old Forest.
rows.translation: 告诉莎尔你与旧森林中那种被腐蚀的植物生物——阿尔劳恩的遭遇吧。
rows.raw: "Tell Shar about your encounter with the Alraune, the corrupted plant-creature of the Old Forest."

rows.original:
"Will you tell me a story, [pc.name]?" Shar asks innocently, fluttering up beside you. "You're best, bravest person I've ever met! You've got to have lots of awesome stories, don't you?"

    You suppose, if she's asking so nicely, you could share one with her[pc.bg minstrel|. That is your job, after all]...
    
    Shar cheers and guides you over to the tower's stoop, hopping straight into your lap and curling a white-feathered wing around your shoulders.
rows.translation:
你能给我讲个故事吗？ [pc.name]？”夏尔天真地问道，轻快地飞到了你身边。“你是我见过最棒、最勇敢的人了！你一定有很多精彩的故事吧？”

你心想，既然她这么诚恳地请求，那你不妨跟她分享一个吧。[pc.bg minstrel|毕竟，那是你的工作。]夏尔欢快地叫着，把你引到塔楼的台阶旁，直接跳到你怀里，然后用它那白色的羽毛搭在你的肩上。

rows.original: Remembering that you have some more ovilixer on hand, you pull out the vial of thick alchemical brew and wave it teasingly before Shar's eyes. The little harpy squirms and flutters in place, clearly desirous of the concoction, yet unwilling to just up and ask you for it. Guess you'll just have to take the lead here. Leaning in close, you brush aside a bit of Shar's fluffy feather-hair and whisper into her ear. "You want some more of this, don't you?" "Y-yes, please," Shar squeaks. Her cheeks flush darkly, wings beating quickly behind her. "May I?" "Of course, that's why I brought it out in the first place." Even more flustered now, Shar just smiles a stupid little smile and looks down at her feet. "I, um, guess we should head inside for this, shouldn't we? I'd rather not risk one of my sisters looking down from above and seeing me like this. I mean, I'm fine with you, [pc.name], but they..." You grin and pat her on the head again. "Well, if you're going to be so bashful about it." Practically giddy with excitement, Shar skips back into the tower with you on her heels, bounding over the ground with short flaps of her large wings. The little harpy can barely contain herself as she plops herself on a rickety old rocking chair, folding her wings about her body like an oversized blanket about her shoulders. [rand |"You've done quite a bit to clean up the place," you remark. "Most harpies I've seen aren't this fastidious." Shar squirms in her seat, her face coloring a little. "I... well, I like things to be neat. Dust makes me sneeze and I end up kicking up more of it with my wings, which makes me sneeze even more... besides, I think I owe it to the old wizard to keep his place tidy while I'm living in his tower, even if he's dead." "You're such a good girl, I don't see how anyone could ever be mad at you." "It's just... when we have a roof over our heads, it's always someone else's. No harpy's ever built anything more than a nest; even my mom's home is a ruin, put up by people in the past and then abandoned. It makes me feel a little sad inside. I'm not sure why." "Oh." "Look at me, killing the mood like this. You've gone to all this trouble to get me something nice; I should be happy instead!" Yeah... |"You know, Shar... have you ever figured out why you have such a strong reaction to this stuff?" The little harpy just rubs her forehead and smiles sheepishly. "About as much as I know why my wings are on my back and not on my arms like all my sisters. I'm ok with not knowing. It doesn't hurt me any... in fact, it feels really good. Why would I complain? Ovilixer's just that much more enjoyable for me." Good for her, then. |"Guess we're in luck again today," you say. "I keep on finding more of this stuff left and right. Do your sisters not care about leaving their stashes of ovilixer ripe for the taking? They keep on losing them all over the foothills." Shar sniffs a little, then taps her forehead, her face screwing up. Gods, she's so cute when she tries to think hard. "Oh, it's perfectly fine. Most of my sisters are scatterbrains, they've never really needed to use their heads, after all. Part of the reason they're always trying to get their hands on more coin is that they keep on losing it frivolously. The same goes for things they own, I suppose... knowing that, them accidentally leaving the stuff in their nests when they move really isn't much of a surprise." Interesting... |"You know, I've wondered... sure, your sisters may brew up the ovilixer on their own, but where do the bottles and vials come from, anyway? Or the ingredients for the brew, for that matter? I can see them gathering up the reagents, but glass isn't something that you can just pick up anywhere." Shar thinks a moment. "Well, I know they've been harassing all manner of people who wander into the foothills and beyond. What do you think they do with the money they manage to lift?" "Spend it, obviously. I haven't seen any great gleaming piles in any of the abandoned nests I've come across." "Yeah, but it's not as if they can just walk in anywhere and put down their coin. Most people don't regard us harpies as any more than beastfolk, and that tries entering a settlement, she'd just be shooed off. Even the people in the valley down south won't deal with my sisters, and rightly so." You consider that. "Okay... so who does trade with you?" "Well, there are certain people who are willing to come out to the sticks and trade with us, away from prying us. People who can pass for civilized. They act as middlemen between us and the villages." "That's interesting. Do you have more details?" Shar shakes her head. "No, Zhara does most of the talking, as she ought to. I'm sorry. I wasn't really included in many things my sisters did... but that's where the glass and a bunch of other things come from, anyway." You step up and take hold of Shar by her shoulders, causing the little harpy to flutter a little. "Maybe it's for the best; that way they didn't rub off on you too much." ] "Oh! Just look at me chattering on. Probably sounds like I'm stalling for time, huh?" "Even if you are, I don't mind. I could listen to the sound of your voice all day." That sets off the little harpy; she grips the forward edge of the chair with her free hand and starts kicking and fidgeting. "Um, uh, best get to it, haha!" The forced laughter is completely unconvincing, but Shar pulls out the stopper and tips the bottle's contents down her throat. Squeezing her eyes shut at the sweet taste, she swallows a few times to down the thick liquid, thumping her chest. When she's done, the red-haired chick licks her lips and looses a happy sigh. "Ovilixer always tastes so sweet," she muses. "And it always makes me feel so warm and tingly, too..." Oh, she's going to feel a lot more in the next few moments. You sit down beside Shar, and wait for the alchemical concoction to take effect.
rows.translation: 想起自己手部头还有一些卵液提取剂，你拿出了那小瓶浓稠的炼金药剂，在莎尔面前晃了晃，逗弄着她。那只小女妖在原地扭动身体、扑腾着翅膀，显然非常想要这种药剂，却又不愿意直接开口向你索取。 看来这次只能由你主动了。你凑近一些，拨开莎尔身上一些蓬松的羽毛，然后在她耳边低声说道。 你还想再来一点，对吧？ 是的是的，请吧。 沙尔发出尖锐的叫声，她的脸颊变得通红，翅膀在身后快速地扑动。 可以吗？ 当然，这就是我当初把它拿出来的原因。 现在更加慌乱了，莎尔只是露出一个傻乎乎的微笑，然后低头看着自己的足部。 我，呃，我想我们还是进去吧，不是吗？我可不想让我的姐妹们从上面看到我这个样子。当然，我对你没意见 [pc.name]但是他们…… 你微笑着再次拍了拍她的头。 唉，既然你这么不好意思开口的话…… Shar兴奋得几乎站不稳了，她紧跟着你跑回塔楼，那双巨大的翅膀轻轻一拍，她就蹦蹦跳跳地跑了起来。这只小女妖几乎控制不住自己的情绪，她扑通一声坐到一把摇摇欲坠的旧摇椅上，然后将翅膀像一条巨大的毯子一样搭在身上。 [rand |你为清理这个地方确实付出了很多努力。 你说道。 我见过的大多数鹰身女妖都没有这么挑剔。 莎尔在座位上坐立不安，她的脸颊微微泛红。 我……嗯，我就是喜欢把东西整理得井井有条。灰尘会让我打喷嚏，而我用翅膀拍打灰尘后，反而会扬起更多的灰尘，这就导致我更加频繁地打喷嚏……另外，我觉得既然我住在那位老巫师的塔里，就算他已经去世了，我也应该帮他保持那里的整洁。 你真是个好女孩，我想没人会生你的气吧。 就是……当我们有地方遮风挡雨的时候，那往往都是别人的房子。那些鹰身女妖从来都没有建造过什么比鸟巢更大的东西；就连我妈妈的家也只是一片废墟，是过去别人搭建起来后又被抛弃的。这让我心里感到有些难过，不过我也不明白为什么。 哦。 看看我，这样破坏气氛多不好。你们费了这么大劲给我准备这么好的东西，我应该感到高兴才对啊！ 嗯…… |你知道吗，莎尔……你有没有想过，为什么你对这类东西会有如此强烈的反应？ 那只小女妖只是揉了揉额头，然后害羞地笑了起来。 其实我也搞不懂为什么我的翅膀长在背上，而不是像我所有的姐妹们那样长在手臂上。不过我并不在意这个，知道也好，不知道也好，并不会对我造成任何困扰……事实上，这种状态反而让我感觉很好。我为什么要抱怨呢？对我来说，使用‘Ovilixer’这个工具反而更加有趣。 那她做得真好。 |看来今天我们又走运了。 你说呢。 我到处都能发现这种东西。你们的姐妹们难道就不担心把那些‘卵液提取器’随意放在那里，让别人随便拿走吗？它们被扔在山脚下的各处，到处都是。 莎尔轻轻嗅了嗅鼻子，然后用手敲了敲自己的额头，脸上露出了困惑的表情。天啊，当她努力思考的时候，真是太可爱了。 哦，没什么大不了的。我的姐妹们大多都记性不好，毕竟她们从来都不需要动动脑子。她们总是想赚更多的钱，原因之一就是她们总是把钱随便花掉。我想，她们对自己拥有的东西也是如此……知道了这一点，所以她们在搬家时不小心把东西忘在原来的地方，也就不足为奇了。 有意思…… rows.original: Taking the small glass vial out from your possessions, you dangle it in front of Shar's eyes. "Know anything about this? I found it while scrounging about in an abandoned nest. Might've belonged to one of your sisters." The little harpy's eyes light up at the sight. "Oh! It's ovilixer!" "So you do know what it is." Shar blushes a little and looks askance, instinctively folding her wings about herself protectively. "W-well, how could I not? Every harpy does! The big brew get-together is a pretty important event, you know! Even if I never got any myself, I had to attend. My sisters would never let me skip it for anything." You rub your chin. "The big brew get-together, you say?" Now Shar looks even more embarrassed. "W-well, it's, um, really..." Maybe she should sit down before she collapses from sheer awkwardness. The poor little harpy's red all the way to her neck, and clings to you while you lead her back into the tower and find a small stool for her to sit on. Shar bites her lip and fidgets nervously while you clear a spot on the ground before her, and urge her to go on. "Well?" "Um, well, that's what Zhara calls it. My sister, that is; she's Mother's favorite. Everyone comes together when there's a new moon and we brew up a big batch of the stuff... Zhara always gets first dibs. Anything that's left over is bottled and handed out... what you're holding there probably came from one of those. Ovilixer doesn't spoil, so when men dry up or the girls have a hard time... they've always got a last resort." "Ah. And what's it about ovilixer that's so important to harpies?[pc.ra harpy| After all, I may be a harpy right now, but I wasn't born one, so I wouldn't know.] It must be pretty important for everyone to gather up like that just to make the stuff." She fidgets awkwardly, rubbing at one of her wings. "I... uh, well..." "Deep breaths, now. Deep breaths. I'd rather you not pass out," you laugh. "We... well, harpies like laying eggs. My sisters really enjoy it. Won't shut up about it. But not everyone can get lucky enough to find a mate to scratch the itch when it comes, or even if they can maybe they don't want to make any chicks yet. Well... that's where ovilixer comes in. My sisters can lay eggs all they want, and feel really good doing it. The eggs are just duds, of course, unless they get a man while they're carrying. My sisters leave them all over the place, really — no one pays them much mind because they aren't going to hatch. Sometimes people or animals find them and turn them into dinner, but most of the time they just go bad where they lie. It's quite the waste." Interesting... well, since she's mentioned how good it makes her sisters feel, you wonder if Shar feels the same way. You dangle to vial in front of her and ask, "Well, would you like some?" Now Shar's really flustered, practically hyperventilating on the spot. Her cheeks are such a dark crimson that you can practically feel the heat venting off of her. "Y-you want me to have it?" You nod. "I wouldn't have tempted you otherwise. After all you've been through, I think you deserve to feel as good as your sisters." "I..." Tears well up in Shar's eyes; the poor thing looks positively giddy with excitement. It takes a bit for her to finally take a deep breath and steady herself, forcing words out despite her own trembling breath. "Okay, I'll do it! I'll lay eggs for you, [pc.name]! You helped me when no one else, would, you got me this awesome tower all to myself... if you want me to lay eggs for you, I'll be your personal hen. And... and I know it'll feel good to boot." "Right," you say. "It's all yours, then." It's so cute: Shar's trembling so much you have to carefully guide her fingers to make sure she doesn't drop the vial by accident. She inspects the label, pulls out the stopper, and hesitates. "Um... oh! What color of egg would you like me to lay?" You raise an eyebrow. "You can do that?" "I think so, at least. Zhara says she focuses on one of the colors of the goddess's wings and her eggs always come out the same hue. I just have to focus very hard when it's, um, you know, happening, and the rest should come naturally..." Well, if she says she can... is there a particular color of egg you'd like Shar to lay for you?
rows.translation: 你从自己的物品中取出了那个小玻璃瓶，然后将其悬在莎尔的眼前。 你知道这件事吗？我在一个废弃的巢穴里发现的，可能属于你们的某个姐妹。 看到这一幕，小女妖的眼睛亮了起来。 哦！是卵液提取器！ 所以你 做 知道那是什么。 莎尔微微脸红，侧着头，本能地将翅膀护在身前，仿佛在保护自己。 嗯，我怎么可能不去呢？每个女妖都会去的！这种大规模的聚会可是非常重要的活动，你懂的！即使我自己从来都得不到什么好处，我也必须参加。我的姐妹们绝对不会允许我因为任何理由缺席的。 你摸了摸下巴。 你说的就是那个大型聚会吧？ 现在，莎尔看起来更加尴尬了。 嗯，其实…… 也许她应该先坐下来，否则会因为尴尬得晕倒的。那个可怜的小女妖的脸都红到了脖子，当你带着她回到塔里，找了一把小凳子让她坐下来时，她还是紧紧地抓着你的手。你给她在地上清理出一个地方，让她坐下，但她却不停地咬嘴唇，显得非常紧张不安。 那么？ 嗯，其实就是扎拉这么叫它的。我的姐姐，她是母亲最宠爱的孩子。每逢新月的时候，大家都会聚在一起，然后一起制作大量的这种东西……扎拉总是能优先得到。剩下的部分就会被装瓶保存起来，然后分发给大家……你手里拿的这个，很可能就是从那些瓶子里拿出来的。这种‘卵化剂’不会变质，所以当男人们缺水，或者女孩子们遇到困难的时候……他们总是有这个最后的解决办法。 啊。那么，卵化剂究竟有什么对女妖们来说如此重要呢？[pc.ra harpy| 毕竟，我现在可能已经变成了一只女妖，但我本来并不是这样的，所以我也不清楚。] 对每个人来说，能够齐心协力来完成这些事情，肯定是非常重要的。 她笨拙地坐立不安，不停地揉搓着自己的翅膀。 我……呃，那个…… 现在，深呼吸。深呼吸。我可不想你昏过去。 你笑了。 我们……嗯，那些女妖就像喜欢下蛋一样。我的姐妹们 真的吗 好好享受吧。人们会一直谈论这个话题的。但是，并不是每个人都有幸找到能满足自己需求的伴侣；即便找到了，有些人也可能还不想马上开始谈恋爱。嗯……这就是卵化剂出现的原因。 我的姐妹们想下多少蛋都行，而且她们做这件事的时候还会感到非常开心。当然，那些蛋都是没用的——除非它们在孵化期间遇到了雄性。我的姐妹们会把蛋随便扔得到处都是，其实也没人会在意，因为那些蛋根本不会孵化出来。 有时候，人们或动物会找到它们并将它们当作食物，但大多数情况下，它们只是会在原地腐烂掉。这实在是太浪费了。 有意思……既然她提到了这能让她的姐妹们感到多么开心，那就不由让人想知道，Shar是否也有同样的感受。你可以把那个小瓶子举到她面前，然后问她： 嗯，你想来一些吗？ 现在 莎尔真的慌了神，几乎在当场喘不过气来。她的脸颊呈现出深红色的颜色，你几乎能感觉到她身上散发出的热量。 你…你是想让我拿走它吗？ 你点了点头。 否则我也不会诱惑你的。经历了这一切之后，我认为你理应像你的姐妹们一样感到快乐。 我…… 莎尔的眼中噙满了泪水；这个可怜的孩子看起来兴奋得几乎要晕倒了。过了好一会儿，她才终于深吸一口气，稳住自己，尽管呼吸还在颤抖，但她还是努力说出了那些话。 好的，我愿意做！我会为你生蛋的。 [pc.name]! 当其他人都拒绝帮助我的时候，是你伸出援手，还让我独占了这座超棒的塔……如果你想让我为你“生蛋”，我愿意成为你的专属“母鸡”。而且……我知道，这样做一定会让我感到很开心。 好的。 你说呢。 那么，这一切都归你所有了。 太可爱了：莎尔的双手一直在颤抖，因此你必须小心地引导她的手指，确保她不会不小心把小瓶子弄掉。她仔细检查了标签，拔出了瓶塞，然后犹豫了一下。 嗯……哦！你希望我下出什么颜色的蛋来呢？ 你挑了挑眉毛。 你真的能做到吗？ 至少我是这么认为的。扎拉说，她会专注于女神翅膀上的某一种颜色，因此她下的蛋总是呈现出相同的色调。只要在我需要集中注意力的时候，认真去做，其余的事情应该就会自然而然地发生…… 嗯，如果她说她能做到……那么有没有某种特定的颜色，你希望莎尔为你生出这样的蛋呢？

What does matter is that she enjoys herself. She somehow manages to blush even deeper. "O-okay!" |"Okay!" Shar chirps. "I'll do my best to lay [a] [var1] egg for you, [pc.name]!" There, there. This is her first time attempting this, after all — she shouldn't push herself. Instead, she should get a feel for her wings, no pun intended. "Mmmh..." ] There's no excuse to further delay the deed, and so Shar raises the bottle to her lips and tips her head back, swallowing the thick, white liquid in one gulp. She shows such enthusiasm for the act that you're worried she might choke, but the little harpy's perfectly fine and sets down the bottle with a satisfied smack of her lips. "That was really sweet!" Sweet? You're not sure ovilixer's supposed to taste sweet — maybe [pc.ra harpy|true ]harpies have a different reaction to the alchemical substance than you might. Your thoughts are cut short, though, by a big, stupid smile pulling itself across Shar's face, her eyes as wide as dinner plates as her body twitches with sensation. By and large, the little harpy's blush returns in full force — no, even stronger than it was before. It starts from the bridge of her nose, flushes her pale cheeks cherry red, then creeps down her neck into her collarbone; as Shar starts panting, her perky tits heave as her body heats up. Even her huge wings start beating at the air, fanning herself as the potion's effects course through her body. Maybe this might not have been the best of ideas. Worried, you grab Shar by the wrist and find her skin hot — not burning as if she were running a high fever, but warm in a more salacious manner. Growing weak about the knees and waist, Shar moans and slumps against you, her elegant arms wrapping about your neck even as her wings fold to cover the both of you like a huge, feathery quilt. The thin shift isn't enough to hide the outline of her stiff nipples, and you swear her panties are soaked even as she presses her body against you, enveloping you in her sweet avian scent. There's no doubt at this point that Shar's reacting well to the ovilixer, maybe a little too well. A side effect of her mutation? Who knows? "I... I..." Shar begins, clearly confused by what's happening to her, but not disliking it either. The little harpy nuzzles her face into your neck, keeping one arm hooked about your collarbone while the other caresses her flat tummy. "I feel kind of full... but all squirmy inside, [pc.name], like there're butterflies in my stomach..." "All right, time out, time out!" you cry. Shar doesn't seem intent on stopping, though, so you grab a nearby bucket of water. Shar must have been cleaning up the tower when you arrived to have left it out in the open, but any port in a storm. Gritting your teeth, you upend the bucket, dousing the lusty harpy with a shower of cold water. [pc.dcb|You'll be damned if you let yourself be accosted by a slutty harpy against your will.|This isn't Shar's fault, but you have to stop this anyway before she digs herself into a deeper hole.|While you'd usually be down for something sexy, consent is like, totally important!] That does the trick. Shar shrieks at the sudden chill, falling back on her ass and flailing about, beating her wings. Her wet clothes cling to the contours of her body, transparent with moisture, and she raises a hand to her mouth. "Oh, [pc.name]! I — um, I don't know what came over me! There just —" You wave off her apology. "It's fine. We didn't know the ovilixer would have such a strong effect on you. I take it none of your sisters ever took to it this well?" Shar shakes her head sheepishly, scattering drops of water all over the floor. She wrings out the worst of the water from her clothes and feathers, and sighs. "I'll have to clean up this mess later on..." "What happened back there, though?" The harpy-girl bites her lip and starts rolling the balls of her foot into the stone floor. "Well, I'm not quite sure myself. I remember the ovilixer tasting really sweet, and I was getting so excited about being able to feel really big and full like my sisters do, and then, um, it kind of becomes a blur from there..." Ah. "...Does this mean I can't take any more ovilixer? I don't feel any different, really, except there's a pretty heavy weight down here now." She points down with both hands at her lower belly, just below her belly button. "It's heavy, but it's nice... really nice." "No, no, of course you can." You step forward to run your fingers through Shar's damp red hair; she squirms a little, flapping her wings and sending droplets of water spraying in all directions. "We'll just have to be more careful about taking it all at once like you did, though. That, and now that we know what to expect, I'll be around to help you with your desires while the potion's taking effect." "Oh. For a moment, I was afraid... well, for a moment I was afraid I'd lost a good thing I'd found yet again..." You hold her tight. "There, there." Shar sniffles. "Sometimes I wonder if the only reason Zhara and the others haven't come and taken this tower from me is that they think the wizard and his statue's still here..." "Hush, don't cry, okay? I'll bring you more soon enough. In the meantime, why don't you enjoy getting to lay an egg for once? I'm sure you'll do it better than any other harpy you know! [pc.cunningRange 66|Besides, if you cry, you'll just have more water strewn about to mop up later on.]" "Right. I've got to..." Shar flaps her wings and pulls her shoulders together, composing herself. "I've got to get this cleaned up, I guess. Look, [pc.name], n-not to be pushy, but could you please give me a little time to be alone? I'm still a little light-headed, and I need to sort out everything before I can be presentable again. Please?" You'll give her the time she needs, then. Giving Shar one last look-over to ensure she's all right, you wave her goodbye and reluctantly step outside the tower. She'll be fine... you hope.
rows.translation: [var0 |你轻轻拍了拍莎尔的羽毛，让这只小女妖知道，她下任何类型的蛋你都完全不介意，这对你来说根本不是问题。什么 做 关键在于，她玩得很开心。 不知怎么的，她的脸红得更加厉害了。 好、好的！ |好的！ 喳喳”地叫着。 我会尽我最大努力去完成。 [a] [var1] 给你个提示吧。 [pc.name]!" 别紧张，别担心。毕竟，这是她第一次尝试这样做，她不应该强迫自己。相反，她应该先熟悉一下自己的“翅膀”——当然，这里并不是字面意义上的翅膀。 嗯…… ] 再也没有任何借口可以推迟这一行动了，于是莎尔将酒瓶举到嘴边，仰头将那浓稠的白色液体一饮而尽。她对这一举动表现得如此热情，以至于让人担心她会不会被呛到，但这个小女妖却完全没事，喝完后还满意地咂了咂嘴，然后将酒瓶放了下来。 那真是太贴心了！ 甜吗？你不确定卵化剂到底应该是什么味道才算甜吧——也许 [pc.ra harpy|true ]女妖们对这种炼金物质的反应可能与你想象的不同。然而，你的思绪很快就被莎尔脸上那抹灿烂而傻乎乎的笑容打断了——她的眼睛瞪得像餐盘一样大，全身都在因为那种反应而微微颤抖。 总体来说，那个小女妖的脸红现象又彻底出现了——不，甚至比之前更加明显了。这种红晕从她的鼻梁开始，让她那苍白的脸颊变成了樱桃红色，然后逐渐蔓延到她的脖颈，直至锁骨处；当莎尔开始喘息时，她那挺拔的胸部也会随着身体的发热而一起起伏。 就连她那巨大的翅膀也开始在空气中扑腾，试图为自己扇风降温，因为药水的效果正在她体内发挥作用。 或许这真不是个好主意。你心中充满担忧，抓住莎尔的手部腕，发现她的皮肤异常温暖——并不是那种高烧导致的灼热感，而是一种更加令人尴尬的温暖。 莎尔的膝盖和腰部逐渐变得无力，她呻吟着靠在你身上，她那优雅的双臂环绕着你的脖子，而她的翅膀则像一条巨大的、布满羽毛的被子一样将你们俩覆盖起来。那层薄薄的衣物根本无法掩盖她坚硬的乳头轮廓，当你感受到她将身体紧紧贴向你时，你甚至敢肯定她的内裤一定已经湿透了——同时，她那甜美的鸟类气息也完全包围了你。 现在可以肯定的是，莎尔对这种卵子处理设备反应良好，或许还有点 太 嗯，这可能是她基因突变带来的副作用吧？谁知道呢？ 我……我…… 夏尔开始行动了，她显然对发生在自己身上的事情感到困惑，但同时也并不反感。这只小女妖把脸贴在你的脖子上，一只手部臂搭在你的锁骨上，另一只手部则轻轻抚摸着她平坦的小肚子。 我有点吃饱了……但心里却还是觉得痒痒的，好像还有很多东西想吃一样。 [pc.name]感觉就像肚子里有蝴蝶在飞一样…… 好了，暂停，暂停！ 你哭了。不过，Shar似乎并没有停止的意思，于是你抓起旁边的一桶水。当你到达的时候，Shar肯定正在清理塔楼，所以才会把水桶放在那里，但在这种情况下，任何办法都行。你咬紧牙关，将水桶倒过来，用一阵冷水浇在了那只欲火中烧的哈比身上。 [pc.dcb|如果你任由一个淫荡的泼妇违背你的意愿来纠缠你，那你可就惨了。|这并不是莎尔的错，但无论如何你都必须阻止这件事，否则她的处境只会变得更加糟糕。|虽然你通常会喜欢一些比较刺激、有趣的事情，但获得对方的同意其实是非常重要的！] 这就对了。夏尔被突如其来的寒意吓得尖叫起来，整个人摔坐在地上，胡乱扑腾着翅膀。她湿漉漉的衣服紧贴在身上，因水分而显得半透明，她赶紧用手部捂住嘴巴。 哦， [pc.name]! 哎，我也不知道自己当时是怎么了！就是突然…… 你对她表示的歉意置之不理。 没关系。我们之前并不知道这种卵子净化器会对你产生这么大的影响。我想，你的姐妹们应该都没有人像你这样适应得这么好吧？ 莎拉羞怯地摇了摇头，结果水珠四溅，洒了一地。她把衣服和羽毛上的水分拧干，然后叹了口气。 以后我得把这个烂摊子收拾干净…… 不过，刚才那边发生了什么？ 那个长着鹰爪的女孩咬着嘴唇，开始用脚趾在石地上滚动。 嗯，我自己也不太确定。我记得那种卵子提取器尝起来非常甜，而且一想到自己也能像我的姐妹们一样变得那么丰满、那么有曲线，我就兴奋极了……不过之后，嗯，那些事情就有点模糊不清了…… 啊。 ……这是不是意味着我不能再服用任何卵子提取剂了？其实我并没有感觉到有什么变化，只是现在感觉腹部有点重型。 她用双手部指着自己的下腹部，就在肚脐下方的位置。 它很重，但手部感很好……真的很好。 不，不，你当然可以。 你走上前，用手部指轻轻梳理莎尔那湿漉漉的红色头发；她微微扭动身体，扑动着翅膀，导致水珠四溅开来。 不过，我们确实需要更加小心，不要像你那样一次性服用所有药剂。现在我们知道了该期待什么，所以在药剂发挥作用的过程中，我会一直在你身边，帮助你实现你的愿望。 哦，有那么一瞬间，我真的很害怕……嗯，有那么一瞬间，我担心自己又失去了一件好不容易找到的好东西…… 你紧紧地抱着她。 好了，好了。 莎尔开始抽鼻子了。 有时候我会想，扎拉他们之所以没有来夺走这座塔，是不是因为他们认为那位巫师和他的雕像仍然在这里…… 安静，不要哭，好吗？我很快就会再给你拿一些来的。不过现在，你为什么不试着自己下个蛋呢？我相信你肯定能做得比你认识的任何一只女妖都要好！ [pc.cunningRange 66|另外，如果你哭了，只会让更多的水弄得到处都是，之后还得去擦干净。]" 对了，我得去…… 莎尔拍动着翅膀，把肩膀收拢在一起，努力让自己平静下来。 我想，我得把这件事处理好才行。听着 [pc.name], 好吧，我并不是想强迫你，但能不能给我一点时间，让我独自待一会儿？我现在还是觉得有点头晕，需要先整理好自己的思绪，才能再次出门见人。拜托了？ 那么，你就给她所需要的时间吧。再仔细检查一遍莎尔，确保她没有问题，然后你向她道别，不情愿地走出了塔楼。希望她不会有事……你这么希望。
rows.raw: " [var0 |You pat Shar on her feathery hair and let the little harpy know you're perfectly fine with her laying any kind of egg, it doesn't matter to you. What does matter is that she enjoys herself. She somehow manages to blush even deeper. "O-okay!" |"Okay!" Shar chirps. "I'll do my best to lay [a] [var1] egg for you, [pc.name]!" There, there. This is her first time attempting this, after all — she shouldn't push herself. Instead, she should get a feel for her wings, no pun intended. "Mmmh..." ] There's no excuse to further delay the deed, and so Shar raises the bottle to her lips and tips her head back, swallowing the thick, white liquid in one gulp. She shows such enthusiasm for the act that you're worried she might choke, but the little harpy's perfectly fine and sets down the bottle with a satisfied smack of her lips. "That was really sweet!" Sweet? You're not sure ovilixer's supposed to taste sweet — maybe [pc.ra harpy|true ]harpies have a different reaction to the alchemical substance than you might. Your thoughts are cut short, though, by a big, stupid smile pulling itself across Shar's face, her eyes as wide as dinner plates as her body twitches with sensation. By and large, the little harpy's blush returns in full force — no, even stronger than it was before. It starts from the bridge of her nose, flushes her pale cheeks cherry red, then creeps down her neck into her collarbone; as Shar starts panting, her perky tits heave as her body heats up. Even her huge wings start beating at the air, fanning herself as the potion's effects course through her body. Maybe this might not have been the best of ideas. Worried, you grab Shar by the wrist and find her skin hot — not burning as if she were running a high fever, but warm in a more salacious manner. Growing weak about the knees and waist, Shar moans and slumps against you, her elegant arms wrapping about your neck even as her wings fold to cover the both of you like a huge, feathery quilt. The thin shift isn't enough to hide the outline of her stiff nipples, and you swear her panties are soaked even as she presses her body against you, enveloping you in her sweet avian scent. There's no doubt at this point that Shar's reacting well to the ovilixer, maybe a little too well. A side effect of her mutation? Who knows? "I... I..." Shar begins, clearly confused by what's happening to her, but not disliking it either. The little harpy nuzzles her face into your neck, keeping one arm hooked about your collarbone while the other caresses her flat tummy. "I feel kind of full... but all squirmy inside, [pc.name], like there're butterflies in my stomach..." "All right, time out, time out!" you cry. Shar doesn't seem intent on stopping, though, so you grab a nearby bucket of water. Shar must have been cleaning up the tower when you arrived to have left it out in the open, but any port in a storm. Gritting your teeth, you upend the bucket, dousing the lusty harpy with a shower of cold water. [pc.dcb|You'll be damned if you let yourself be accosted by a slutty harpy against your will.|This isn't Shar's fault, but you have to stop this anyway before she digs herself into a deeper hole.|While you'd usually be down for something sexy, consent is like, totally important!] That does the trick. Shar shrieks at the sudden chill, falling back on her ass and flailing about, beating her wings. Her wet clothes cling to the contours of her body, transparent with moisture, and she raises a hand to her mouth. "Oh, [pc.name]! I — um, I don't know what came over me! There just —" You wave off her apology. "It's fine. We didn't know the ovilixer would have such a strong effect on you. I take it none of your sisters ever took to it this well?" Shar shakes her head sheepishly, scattering drops of water all over the floor. She wrings out the worst of the water from her clothes and feathers, and sighs. "I'll have to clean up this mess later on..." "What happened back there, though?" The harpy-girl bites her lip and starts rolling the balls of her foot into the stone floor. "Well, I'm not quite sure myself. I remember the ovilixer tasting really sweet, and I was getting so excited about being able to feel really big and full like my sisters do, and then, um, it kind of becomes a blur from there..." Ah. "...Does this mean I can't take any more ovilixer? I don't feel any different, really, except there's a pretty heavy weight down here now." She points down with both hands at her lower belly, just below her belly button. "It's heavy, but it's nice... really nice." "No, no, of course you can." You step forward to run your fingers through Shar's damp red hair; she squirms a little, flapping her wings and sending droplets of water spraying in all directions. "We'll just have to be more careful about taking it all at once like you did, though. That, and now that we know what to expect, I'll be around to help you with your desires while the potion's taking effect." "Oh. For a moment, I was afraid... well, for a moment I was afraid I'd lost a good thing I'd found yet again..." You hold her tight. "There, there." Shar sniffles. "Sometimes I wonder if the only reason Zhara and the others haven't come and taken this tower from me is that they think the wizard and his statue's still here..." "Hush, don't cry, okay? I'll bring you more soon enough. In the meantime, why don't you enjoy getting to lay an egg for once? I'm sure you'll do it better than any other harpy you know! [pc.cunningRange 66|Besides, if you cry, you'll just have more water strewn about to mop up later on.]" "Right. I've got to..." Shar flaps her wings and pulls her shoulders together, composing herself. "I've got to get this cleaned up, I guess. Look, [pc.name], n-not to be pushy, but could you please give me a little time to be alone? I'm still a little light-headed, and I need to sort out everything before I can be presentable again. Please?" You'll give her the time she needs, then. Giving Shar one last look-over to ensure she's all right, you wave her goodbye and reluctantly step outside the tower. She'll be fine... you hope."

rows.original: As you approach the tower, Shar comes running out with a beaming smile. You can't help but notice that the cute little harpy is carrying something in her arms, wrapped up in a blanket: a big [var0] egg. It's easily a third larger than most other harpy eggs you've seen, filling her arms as she strides briskly towards you. "[pc.name]!" she chirps. "Good timing! I start thinking of you, and you manage to show up just in time! Here, this belongs to you!" Looking at Shar, you get the feeling that the egg isn't so much as heavy as it is fragile, and that simple fact is confirmed when she passes it over to you. Big and [var0], it's smooth to the touch as you struggle to find someplace amongst your possessions to stow away something of this size. "I had the egg while you were away, so it's important for you to have it before we do anything else. I know this goes without saying, but it's a beauty! Don't let it go stale, okay?" You ruffle Shar's lovely red feather-hair. "With how hard you worked to make it, I wouldn't dream of letting it go bad on my watch. Did all that come out of you? It's pretty big for a small harpy — did you have any problems?" She waves off your concern and titters, embarrassed. "Oh, don't worry about it. I won't say it was effortless, but it was easier than you might expect. Possibly even pleasurable, in a way. She blushes, locking her thighs together as the memory seems to wash over her. "W-well, enough of that! What're we going to do today, [pc.name]?"
rows.translation: 当你靠近那座塔时，莎尔面带灿烂的笑容跑了出来。你不禁注意到，这个可爱的小女妖怀里抱着什么东西，用毯子包得严严实实——那是一只很大的 [var0] 这个蛋，它的体积肯定比你见过的其他大多数女妖蛋都要大三分之一，当她快步向你走来时，这个蛋几乎把她的手臂都填满了。 "[pc.name]!" 她叽叽喳喳地叫着。 真是太巧了！我正好在想你，你就刚好出现了！来，这个是给你的！ 看着莎尔，你会觉得那个蛋与其说很重，不如说非常脆弱；而当她把它递给你时，这个事实得到了进一步的证实——那个蛋确实又大又脆弱。 [var0]它的触感非常光滑，不过当你试图在自己的物品中找到一个地方来存放这么大的东西时，会觉得有些麻烦。 你不在的时候，我把这个鸡蛋拿来了，所以在我们做其他事情之前，你一定要先吃到它。我知道这一点不用说也明白，但它真的非常美味！千万别让它变质了，好吗？ 你弄乱了莎尔那漂亮的红色羽毛。 你付出了这么多的努力才取得这样的成果，我绝对不会让它在我这里毁掉。这一切都是你自己的努力换来的吗？对于一只小小的女妖来说，这已经相当了不起了——你遇到过什么困难吗？ 她摆了摆手，表示不需要你的关心，然后害羞地笑了起来。 哦，别担心。虽然说过程并不轻松，但其实比你想象的要容易一些。甚至从某种意义上来说，还挺让人愉快的呢。 她的脸颊顿时红了，双腿也不由自主地紧贴在了一起，那些回忆仿佛一下子涌上了她的脑海。 嗯，好了，别说了！今天我们到底要做什么呢？ [pc.name]?"

rows.original: After ten minutes or so, Brother Sanders returns with a large basket holding several items wrapped in fine cloth. Balancing his burden in one hand, he reaches for the knocker on the heavy wooden door to the cloister and raps twice. "Shar, I'm coming in." Wait, did you get that right? Shar? Shar? Sanders thinks nothing of it as he turns the handle and pushes open the door — and yes, there stands Shar, looking up as the priest enters the cloister. The little harpy's got an apron tied about her front and a broom in her hands; a small dustpan and a rag for polishing metal complete the ensemble of domesticity as Brother Sanders steps in. "We've got someone wanting to use the cloister, so it would be appreciated if you could finish up your tasks shortly. Don't forget to empty the ashes from the censer — is something the matter?" "I... ah..." Shar's looking straight past Sander's shoulder and at you as she stumbles over her words. The broom trembles in her hands as color rises to her face, staining her cheeks a lighter shade of the vivid crimson of her feather-hair. "Okay!" Sanders sets down his burden, bemusement on his face, then looks back and forth between you and Shar. A small smile plays across his lips as realization dawns, then he steps back get out of the way and let the two of you take each other in. Just what is she doing here? "Just what are you doing here?!" This is Hawkethorne. You're supposed to be here. Or does she mean the chapel? Considering that you were just intending to spend some time away from the world and getting yourself right with the gods, yes, you're supposed to be here, too. Last time you checked, harpies weren't exactly welcome in the village walls, so again, what is she doing here? "All right, all right." Holding out his hands to either side, Sanders steps between the two of you. "This is a pleasant surprise, to be quite frank; I didn't know the two of you were already acquainted with each other. [pc.name], it's perfectly fine for Shar to be here. If anything, she's been quite a familiar face around the chapel of late." You can only shake your head at that. Just how did she get into this position in the first place? "Well, it began a little time after you brought back that Sorran artifact — Sorra's Succor, yes? — for the cloister. The night after I'd put it up on the wall, I heard noises coming from the cloister, so I went to investigate and found Shar here kneeling on the ground and looking positively enraptured. You can see why I found that a cause for concern." ...Really. And what does she have to say about all this? "I can't explain it myself, [pc.name]." Shar sets her broom against a wall and presses her hands to the sides of her head as she shakes. "Whenever I'm in this place, in the presence of the spear, no, all the other relics, too... I feel safe. At peace. I just woke up one morning and had this strange feeling drawing me down to the village; before I even knew it, my feet were moving on their own. So... here I am." How did she get past the gates? "Got a few rags together. Some elves have wings, and when people think of harpies they know harpies' wings go on their arms, not on their back. So..." "I vouched for her once I was certain she didn't harbour any ill intentions," Sanders adds. "The townsfolk know she's a harpy, don't worry about it. She'll be able to get in and out of the village unmolested so long as she doesn't cause trouble, and I don't believe she will. All sorts of colorful figures passing through Hawkethorne these days, what's one more?"
rows.translation: 大约十分钟后，桑德斯兄弟拿着一个装着几件用细布包裹好的物品的大篮子回来了。他一只手部稳稳地托着这个篮子，另一只手部去敲那扇厚重的木门，敲了两下。 莎尔，我进来了。 等等，你确定写对了吗？“Shar”？ 夏尔？ 桑德斯转动门把手部，推开了门——果然，夏尔站在那里，当神父走进修道院时，她正抬头看着他。这个小小的“女妖”身上系着围裙，手部里拿着一把扫帚；还有一个小簸箕和一块用来擦拭金属的抹布，这些道具让桑德斯修士一进门，就立刻感受到了那种家庭般的氛围。 有人想要使用那间静修室，所以如果你能尽快完成手部头的工作，那就太好了。别忘了把香炉里的灰清理干净——是不是出了什么问题？ 我……啊…… 莎尔在说话时有些结结巴巴，她的目光却直直地穿过桑德的肩膀，注视着你。她手部中的扫帚微微颤抖着，她的脸颊渐渐涨红了，那鲜艳的深红色与她羽毛般的头发颜色相得益彰。 好的！ 桑德斯放下手部中的负担，脸上带着困惑的神情，然后在你和莎尔之间来回看了看。当他意识到发生了什么时，嘴角浮现出一丝微笑，随后他退到一边，让你们俩能够拥抱在一起。 她究竟为什么会在这里呢？ 你在这里干什么？！ 这里是鹰棘镇。你本应该在这里的。还是说，她指的是那座小教堂？考虑到你当时只是想远离尘世，与神明重新建立联系，那么，没错，你确实应该在这里。上次你来的时候，应该还记得——那些鹰身女妖可不太受村民们的欢迎，所以，再次问你，这里到底是什么地方？ 她 你在这里做什么？ 好吧，好吧。 桑德斯将双手部伸向两侧，从你们两人中间走过去。 说实话，这真是个意外的惊喜；我之前并不知道你们俩已经认识了。 [pc.name]莎尔在这里完全没问题。事实上，最近她在小教堂里经常出现，已经成了大家熟悉的面孔了。 对于这件事，你只能摇头叹息。她究竟是怎么走到这一步的呢？ 嗯，这件事发生在你把那个索兰神器——也就是索拉的救赎之器，对吧？——带回修道院之后的不久。那天晚上，我把那个神器挂在墙上后，就听到修道院里传来一些声响，于是我去查看，结果发现夏尔在这里跪在地上，看上去简直入迷极了。你也能理解，为什么我会觉得这很令人担忧吧。 ……真的吗？那么，那又意味着什么呢？ 她 对于这一切，你有什么要说的吗？ 我自己也解释不清楚， [pc.name]." 莎尔将她的扫帚靠在墙上，双手部按在头两侧，开始摇晃身体。 每当我来到这个地方，站在这根长矛面前，不，其实是所有这些遗物面前……我就会感到安心，感到平静。有一天早上，我突然有一种奇怪的感觉，驱使着我走向这个村庄；甚至在我意识到之前，我的足部步就已经不由自主地开始移动了。所以……我就来到了这里。 她是怎么穿过那些大门的？ 我找了几块破布。有些精灵是有翅膀的，而当人们想到鹰身女妖时，他们就会知道鹰身女妖的翅膀是长在手部臂上，而不是背上。所以…… 在我确定她没有任何恶意之后，我才为她担保的。 桑德斯补充道。 镇上的居民都知道她是个女妖，所以不必担心。只要她不惹麻烦，就应该能够自由进出村子，而我认为她也不会惹事的。这些天鹰棘镇来来去去的人那么多，多一个她也没什么大不了的。
rows.raw: ' After ten minutes or so, Brother Sanders returns with a large basket holding several items wrapped in fine cloth. Balancing his burden in one hand, he reaches for the knocker on the heavy wooden door to the cloister and raps twice. "Shar, I'm coming in." Wait, did you get that right? Shar? Shar? Sanders thinks nothing of it as he turns the handle and pushes open the door — and yes, there stands Shar, looking up as the priest enters the cloister. The little harpy's got an apron tied about her front and a broom in her hands; a small dustpan and a rag for polishing metal complete the ensemble of domesticity as Brother Sanders steps in. "We've got someone wanting to use the cloister, so it would be appreciated if you could finish up your tasks shortly. Don't forget to empty the ashes from the censer — is something the matter?" "I... ah..." Shar's looking straight past Sander's shoulder and at you as she stumbles over her words. The broom trembles in her hands as color rises to her face, staining her cheeks a lighter shade of the vivid crimson of her feather-hair. "Okay!" Sanders sets down his burden, bemusement on his face, then looks back and forth between you and Shar. A small smile plays across his lips as realization dawns, then he steps back get out of the way and let the two of you take each other in. Just what is she doing here? "Just what are you doing here?!" This is Hawkethorne. You're supposed to be here. Or does she mean the chapel? Considering that you were just intending to spend some time away from the world and getting yourself right with the gods, yes, you're supposed to be here, too. Last time you checked, harpies weren't exactly welcome in the village walls, so again, what is she doing here? "All right, all right." Holding out his hands to either side, Sanders steps between the two of you. "This is a pleasant surprise, to be quite frank; I didn't know the two of you were already acquainted with each other. [pc.name], it's perfectly fine for Shar to be here. If anything, she's been quite a familiar face around the chapel of late." You can only shake your head at that. Just how did she get into this position in the first place? "Well, it began a little time after you brought back that Sorran artifact — Sorra's Succor, yes? — for the cloister. The night after I'd put it up on the wall, I heard noises coming from the cloister, so I went to investigate and found Shar here kneeling on the ground and looking positively enraptured. You can see why I found that a cause for concern." ...Really. And what does she have to say about all this? "I can't explain it myself, [pc.name]." Shar sets her broom against a wall and presses her hands to the sides of her head as she shakes. "Whenever I'm in this place, in the presence of the spear, no, all the other relics, too... I feel safe. At peace. I just woke up one morning and had this strange feeling drawing me down to the village; before I even knew it, my feet were moving on their own. So... here I am." How did she get past the gates? "Got a few rags together. Some elves have wings, and when people think of harpies they know harpies' wings go on their arms, not on their back. So..." "I vouched for her once I was certain she didn't harbour any ill intentions," Sanders adds. "The townsfolk know she's a harpy, don't worry about it. She'll be able to get in and out of the village unmolested so long as she doesn't cause trouble, and I don't believe she will. All sorts of colorful figures passing through Hawkethorne these days, what's one more?"'

rows.original: You can't quite believe you're hearing this, but it's happening all the same, isn't it? This is really getting you in the right frame of mind for three days' worth of quiet, peaceful meditation. A chuckle. "I see you might have some things to work out with Shar here, so I'll prepare the cloister while you do so. Let me know when you're ready to begin. [pc.name]... don't be too hard on her, all right? I'm not sure exactly why the relic might have drawn her to the chapel, but given that harpies are the beloved peoples of Sorra, I can hazard some theories. Why Shar and not any other of her sisters is still in the air, but it may have something to do with her mutation. Looking like that, you can't deny she's the spitting image of the goddess." It was a dangerous and stupid thing to do, walking into Hawkethorne like that, but everything's worked out just fine, you suppose. Shar shrinks back a little and looks at her feet. "I'm sorry to make you worry, [pc.name]. I don't understand it myself, either." Well... she's not staying here, right? "No. I go home when I'm done in the evenings." [dayNight |She just ought to be sure not to start for home too late. Walking up into the hills can be treacherous at night. "Yeah..." |Yet she's here now... A tinge of desperation creeps into the little harpy's voice. "I-I couldn't just leave the cloister unswept, it'd have eaten at me all night. I'd have gone home straight after, I swear!" It'd have been dangerous for her to head alone into the hills after dark; she should know that. If she's going to be staying late, she should at least ask Sanders to have Garth let out a room for her. "I, uh..." ] Cleaning aside, what else does Shar do here in the chapel? "Well, Brother Sanders is teaching me to cook properly, not just boiling things in a pot or roasting over an open fire like my sisters do. Then I cook for him sometimes, because he's so busy..." Shar squirms a little and starts tapping her fingers together. "I also like listening to him say his prayers, he's got a good voice for it. Then when I've got nothing to do, he lets me sit in the pews right in front of the great goddess Sorra and daydream... "It's not bad, really. My sisters can't find me here, and I get to have hot meals in exchange for the simple work I do, so I don't have to go foraging for food... I like visiting this place. I'd like to be able to read, and Sanders is working on that, too..." You sigh inwardly, and wonder if tongues are going to start wagging now that the good priest has a young, nubile harpy visiting him every other day and being all domestic. [pc.bg acolyte |You know enough from your studies as an acolyte that while neither |While you don't know if ] Sanders' vocation nor the order he belonged to required him to take a vow of celibacy, it's still going to be awkward. Oh well. Either way, you'd like to use the cloister now, so if she wouldn't mind... "O-oh. Right." Gathering up broom, dustpan and rag, Shar scurries off, her wings tucked close to her body as she disappears from sight. Presently, Sanders returns, dusting his hands off. "Everything's ready, [pc.name]. Mealtimes will be at dawn and dusk respectively. You may, of course, choose not to partake if you feel that a touch of ascetic fasting may help focus your mind on the divine." That's very kind of him. But about Shar... "Yes?" Does he believe what she said about being drawn here? "She's saying what she believes to be the truth, I can tell as much. The girl wears her heart on her sleeve. Don't be too hard on her, okay?" This is going to be complicated. Sanders smiles and claps you on the shoulder. "Have a little faith, [pc.mf|brother|sister]. Often is it that you've to make a decision without having all the facts, and I've decided to trust your little harpy friend. Now then, I've lit the incense and set the mats in place. Why don't you get to it? It's going to take you a little while to get in the proper frame of mind, after all." That's an understatement if you ever saw one...
rows.translation: 你简直不敢相信自己正在听到这些，但事实就是如此，不是吗？这一切确实能让你进入一种最适合进行三天安静、宁静冥想的状态。 一阵轻笑。 我看你可能需要和Shar解决一些问题，所以我会先把静修室准备好，等你处理完那些事情再开始使用。等你准备好了，告诉我一声吧。 [pc.name]…别对她太苛刻，好吗？我并不完全清楚为什么那件遗物会吸引她来到这座小教堂，但既然鹰身女妖是索拉最钟爱的种族，那我也可以试着推测一些原因。为什么是莎尔，而不是她的其他姐妹们，至今还留在那里，这可能与她的变异有关。看她的样子，你不得不承认，她简直就是那位女神的翻版啊。 那样贸然闯入鹰棘镇，确实是一件既危险又愚蠢的事情，但想来，最终一切还是顺利解决了。 莎尔微微缩了缩身子，低头看着自己的足部。 很抱歉让你们担心了， [pc.name]我自己也不明白。 嗯……她不是吧。 留在原地 就是这里，对吧？ 不，我晚上工作完就会回家。 [dayNight |她绝对不能太晚才出发回家。晚上走在山路上是很危险的。 是啊…… |然而，她现在却在这里…… 那小女妖的声音中透出一丝绝望。 我、我总不能让修道院里一片狼藉吧，那样我会整晚都睡不着的。我发誓，做完事后我就会直接回家！ 天黑后她独自前往山区未免太危险了，她应该明白这一点。如果她打算待到很晚，至少应该让桑德斯安排加思为她准备一间房间。 我，呃…… ] 先不说打扫的事情，莎拉在教堂里还做些什么呢？ 嗯，桑德斯哥哥正在教我如何正确地做饭，而不是像我的姐妹们那样，只是把东西放进锅里煮或者放在明火上烤。有时候我也会给他做饭，因为他实在太忙了…… 莎尔微微扭动了一下身体，然后开始用手部指敲击在一起。 我也喜欢听他祷告，他的嗓音真的很适合做这件事。而当我没事可做的时候，他就会让我坐在伟大的索拉女神面前的长椅上，让我发发呆…… 其实这里还不错。我的姐妹们找不到我，而且我只需要做些简单的工作就能吃到热腾腾的饭菜，因此根本不需要自己去觅食……我很喜欢这个地方。如果我能在这里读书该多好啊，桑德斯也在努力为这个目标而努力…… 你在心中暗自叹息，不禁想知道：现在那位好心的牧师每天都有年轻貌美的女子来拜访他，两人关系如此亲密，那些流言蜚语会不会立刻开始传开了呢？ [pc.bg acolyte |作为一名学徒，通过你的学习，你应该已经了解到：虽然两者都不是…… |虽然你不知道是否…… ] 桑德斯的职业性质以及他所属的团体并没有要求他必须发誓守独身，但这样做还是会让人觉得有些尴尬。 唉，算了。不管怎样，你现在想要使用那间修道院房间，所以如果她不介意的话…… 哦，对，是的。 莎尔拿起扫帚、簸箕和抹布，迅速跑开了，她的翅膀紧紧贴在身体两侧，很快就消失在了视线之外。不久之后，桑德斯回来了，他拍掉了手部上的灰尘。 一切都准备好了， [pc.name]用餐时间分别是在黎明和黄昏。当然，如果你认为稍微禁食一段时间有助于让你更加专注地思考神圣的事物，你也可以选择不参加用餐。 他真是太好了。不过关于莎尔…… 是吗？ 他相信她所说的自己是被吸引到这里来的这种说法吗？ 我能看出来，她说的是她认为的真相。这个女孩把心里的话都写在脸上了，别对她太苛刻，好吗？ 这事情会变得很复杂。 桑德斯微笑着，拍了拍你的肩膀。 请稍加信任吧， [pc.mf|兄弟|姐姐]很多时候，人们不得不在并不掌握所有事实的情况下做出决定，而我决定相信你那位小女妖朋友的话。好了，我已经点燃了香烛，也准备好了所需的物品。那你就开始吧……毕竟，你需要一些时间来调整好自己的心态。 如果你见过这样的说法，那简直算是轻描淡写了……

rows.original: It takes a little while for Sanders to return with the materials you'll be needed over the next three days, all wrapped up neatly in white cloth and set in a little basket. The priest carefully pushes open the door to the cloister, to find [rand |Shar kneeling on one of the prayer mats, hands on her knees, plush butt propped on her heels, and wings folded snugly about herself. She looks up in surprise as the two of you enter, then embarrassment spreads across the little harpy's face as she sees who it is. "Oh! Um, hi..." There's nothing to be skittish about. You're here to do the very same thing she was doing, only with a little more oomph. "Oh..." |Shar on her hands and knees, an apron tied about her front as she swabs the floor with a heavy rag. A small squeak escapes the little harpy's lips as she realizes she's got her plump ass high in the air and pointed directly towards you, and she scurries into a more modest position as her face colors. "H-hey! Fancy you coming in at a time like this. I was almost done with the floor." |Shar sitting cross-legged on one of the prayer mats, eyes unfocused and jaw slack as she stares off into empty space. It's a little disquieting to see her like this, but she rights herself within moments of you entering the room, snapping back to attention with a little embarrassed squeak. "Oh! Hi! [pc.name], Mister Sanders. I was lost in thought for a bit there... there's something about this room that makes it good for thinking really hard, isn't there?" ] Sanders clears his throat and saves the situation. "Well, Shar, [pc.name] would like to take a few days to meditate and reflect on [pc.hisHer] time so far. Would you be so kind as to help [pc.himHer] prepare the room?" "Of course!" Shar flutters into action, taking the basket from Sanders and setting out the aromatic oils and herbs. She's quite adept at this by now, which isn't a big surprise with how eager she is to learn and how adept Sanders is at instruction. Sanders nods, and starts towards the door. "I'll leave you to it, then." "O-okay!" The heavy oaken door clicks shut, leaving Shar to handle the preparations on her own. Hmm... you have to admit that she looks rather fetching like this. You're going to be depriving yourself for a few days, harpies are inherently pretty sexual creatures and while Sorra doesn't countenance orgies under the full moon, she isn't a prude, either. If she were, she wouldn't have made harpies the way they were, right? Long story short, would you like to have some fun with Shar here in the cloister before you settle in?

rows.original: You shake your head and focus your mind on the matter at hand. As tempting and provocative as Shar might be in that little apron she's wearing over her shift, that's not what you came to the chapel for. Prying your gaze away from the little harpy, you wait for her to be done with the preparations. "The place's ready," Shar says at last, lighting the censer and sighing softly as the warm aroma of oil and winterstem suffuses the room. "Please, make yourself comfortable. We'll be having meals at dawn and dusk, so do look out the window every so often and make note of the time. "Well, I'll be seeing you." With that, Shar gives you a little bow and leaves the room, closing the door behind her with a quiet click. She really acts a lot more serious when in the chapel... but that's to be expected, isn't it?
