rows.original: [flags.VAUSH_ENCOUNTERED |A jolt runs up your spine as the sound of heavy, rushing feet rings out. You stumble into a panicked run but quickly find that it's not enough. The footsteps keep getting louder and louder until you feel like they're right on your heels. Realizing that they're going to catch up with you sooner rather than later, [party.hasCompanions|you tell your companion[party.manyCompanions|s] to get ready and ]you draw your [pc.weapon] and turn around to face them. It's a pair of orcs — very angry looking orcs. They stop and ready their own weapons as soon as you do, almost snarling in ferocity. The ferocity fades from one of them as they turn around and sigh. "Hurry up you old fucker!" one of the orc yells as you see a large figure approach from behind. It's [flags.VAUSH_MET|Vaush|the shaman], taking what you'd describe as a casual jog up to you. The orc with their back turned stamps her feet while the other one keeps an eye on you. About half a minute later, he finally catches up. "Excuse me if I don't exactly have a sprinter's build here." He fans his arms out to show off the sheer bulk of his body. "Whatever. You better be able to hit hard with arms like that." He just nods his head and gets ready to fight alongside the other two. |The thundering sound of marching feet ring out in the distance. Whoever or whatever they are, they sound large. You[party.hasCompanions| and your companion[party.manyCompanions|s]] duck behind a nearby rock and wait for them to go by, rather than rushing in blind. A few minutes pass, all the while the marching gets closer and closer before stopping dangerously close. You ready your [pc.weapon][party.hasCompanions| and tell your companion[party.manyCompanions|s] to do the same], getting ready for them to charge you. Instead a small vial smashes against the ground next to you, spilling out a thick miasma that drives you out of cover. Out in the open, you come face-to-face with your aggressors. It's a party of orcs, lead by a very unusual example. While the others in the pack are fairly typical of [pc.ra orc|your fellow kind|[flags.ARONA_ENCOUNTERED|what you've heard of orcs|what you've seen of orc parties so far]], all snarling rage and bloodthirst, he seems almost bored, staring at you with a glazed-over expression. His garb is also very different. Instead of the rather skimpy armor that the others wear, he's fully robed, with only a V-neck in his top showing off his very impressive physique. "I really wish you adventurers wouldn't wander where you aren't welcomed. This hunting business has gotten so tiring." One of the other orcs knocks him on the back of the head, needing to get on her toes to reach the peak of the dark green mountain. "Get your shit together ya big lump! No whining." He simply grumbles in response, removing his hood and letting his long hair and immaculate beard flow out. "Yeah yeah, let's just get it over with." The two other orcs walk out in front of him as they take up a combat stance. ]
rows.translation: [flags.VAUSH_ENCOUNTERED |当那沉重而急促的脚步声响起时，一股寒意瞬间窜上你的脊背。你慌忙开始奔跑，但很快发现这样的速度根本不够。脚步声越来越近，仿佛已经紧追在你的身后。你清楚地意识到，他们迟早会追上你 [party.hasCompanions|你告诉你的同伴吧。[party.manyCompanions|s] 做好准备，然后…… ]你来抽吧。 [pc.weapon] 然后转身面对他们。 那是一对兽人——看起来非常愤怒的兽人。你一转身，他们立刻停了下来，拔出了武器，几乎要凶狠地咆哮起来。然而其中一个人在转身时叹了口气，那份愤怒似乎消退了一些。 “快点，老家伙！”其中一个兽人喊道。这时，你看到一个高大的身影从背后走了过来。那是 [flags.VAUSH_MET|沃什|萨满]那个兽人背对着你，一边跺着足部，另一边则一直在注视着你。大约半分钟后，他终于追上了你。“实在不好意思，我的体格可算不上是短跑运动员型的。”他摊开双臂，展示着自己魁梧的身材。 “没关系。不过，有那样的手臂，你至少得能打出有力的一拳才行。” 他只是点了点头，然后准备和其他两个人一起战斗。 |远处传来整齐的足部步声，那震耳欲聋的声响表明，那些行进的人或事物数量一定很多。不管他们是谁……总之，他们的规模不小。[party.hasCompanions| 以及你的同伴[party.manyCompanions|s]] 躲到附近的岩石后面，等他们经过再行动，而不是盲目地冲进去。 几分钟过去了，队伍的声音越来越近，最终在离你非常近的地方停了下来。你做好准备了吗？ [pc.weapon][party.hasCompanions| 并告诉你的同伴[party.manyCompanions|s] 做同样的事情]它们正准备向你发起攻击。然而，就在这时，一个小药瓶突然砸在你足部边，里面的浓稠液体洒了出来，使你不得不离开掩体。 现在，你暴露在开阔地带，与那些攻击者面对面地对峙。他们是一群兽人，而其中的首领却与众不同。虽然这群兽人中的其他成员都相当典型 [pc.ra orc|与你同类的生物|[flags.ARONA_ENCOUNTERED|你所听到的关于兽人的那些说法……|到目前为止，你们所看到的那些兽人团队……]]他浑身散发着愤怒与嗜血的气息，却似乎显得有些无聊，用一种呆滞的眼神盯着你。他的穿着也与其他人截然不同——他没有像其他人那样穿着暴露的盔甲，而是全身都裹着长袍，只有上衣的V领口露出了他的 非常 令人赞叹的体魄。 “我真的希望各位冒险者不要去那些不欢迎你们的地方闲逛。这种打猎的工作真是让人疲惫不堪。” 另一名兽人敲了敲他的后脑勺，因为她们必须踮起足部才能到达那座深绿色山峰的顶端。 振作起来，大块头！别抱怨了。” 他只是闷闷不乐地回应了一句，然后摘下兜帽，让长长的头发和整洁的胡须披散下来。“好吧好吧，快点结束这件事吧。” 另外两个兽人走在他的前面，摆出了战斗姿势。 ]

rows.original:
You hear a faint rustling in the distance. Deciding to play it safe, you get low and skulk toward the noise. As you get closer the sounds start to clear. The first noise you're able to identify is a loud belch, followed by a cough. When the source of the noise comes into view, it becomes readily apparent who it is.

    It's the older orc shaman from earlier, resting against a tree with a hearty drink in his hand. Before you can decide what to do next, the massive man looks over at you with a smile on his face. "Hey there, youngins. Looks like you caught me at a bad time here. Can't really say I'm in much of a state to get into a tussle right now." He takes another big swig of his drink and reclines back.
    
    [party.has arona
        |"Well well," Arona chimes in from behind. "I can't say I'm surprised to see you like this, old man. Drunk, sad, and useless seem to be your calling cards these days."
    
        The shaman simply readjusts himself and looks over at her. "I see [arona.isChief|being chief|getting exiled] hasn't dulled your acid tongue. And for your information, I don't have nearly enough booze to get drunk out here; so there." He sticks his tongue out at her, causing Arona to simply roll her eyes.
        
        "If you ever wondered what washed-up looks like, here it is [pc.name]. Vaush here used to be one of the best warriors in the tribe, now he's just some fat old drunk." Without another word, Arona walks off, leaving you with the unfazed Shaman.
        
        "Always fun meeting with royalty[arona.isChief||, or former in this case]. Full of shit as usual. I mean look at this." He lifts up his robe just enough to show you his ripped, rock hard abs. "Does this look fat to you?"
        
        "Faaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat!" Arona yells from the distance.
        
        Vaush rolls his eyes, "Kids these days! I betcha she's still upset about that time I pinned her in the last wrestling contest. She looked like she was gonna gut me like a fish after that; probably could have too. I ain't too proud to admit I'm rusty, maybe even so rusty that there's not much left under it." He stares off into space. "... But that's just an old man rambling, and I doubt you're here for that."
    
        |You look at him with caution and suspicion. "Why should I trust you?"
    
        He stops and thinks for a second before shrugging his shoulders. "I don't know, kid. If you wanna think a drunk old man sitting against a tree like a bum means you ill, then fine." He takes an indignant sip from his stein. "Not every orc is some braindead bruiser you know. Some of us appreciate the finer things in life, like... um." He pours some more booze into his stein. "Fine drinks!"
        
        "So you're a drunk?"
        
        "I'm a man of many talents. My tolerance for alcohol just so happens to be one of them. Name's Vaush, by the way. [flags.VAUSH_MET|Of course, I told you that already, didn't I?"]
    
        He picks up a second stein from next to him and holds it out to you. "Come on, put your feet up; relax."
    ]
    
    Do you sit down with the old orc?
rows.translation:
远处传来一阵微弱的沙沙声。为了保险起见，你蹲下身子，悄悄朝着声音传来的方向移动。随着你越来越接近，那些声音也逐渐变得清晰起来。首先你能分辨出的是一声响亮的打嗝声，紧接着就是一声咳嗽。 当噪音的来源出现在视线中时，立刻就能看出是谁在发出声音。

原来是之前遇到的那位年长的兽人萨满，他靠在树上，手中拿着一杯酒。还没等你想好接下来该怎么做，这个身材高大的男人就面带微笑朝你看了过来。 嘿，小伙子们。看来你们抓到我一个不太好的时候了。说实话，我现在实在没精力跟你们打架。”他又大口喝了一口饮料，然后靠在椅背上。
    
    [party.has arona
        |唉，唉，”阿罗娜从后面插话道，“看到你这个样子，我倒也不觉得意外，老头。这些天来，喝醉、悲伤、无能为力，似乎已经成为你的代名词了。”

萨满只是重新调整了一下姿势，然后看着她说道：“原来如此。 [arona.isChief|担任首领|被流放] 这可没有让你的嘴变得不那么刻薄哦。顺便告诉你，我这里可没有足够的酒让你喝到醉的；所以，没门儿。”他对着她吐了吐舌头，惹得阿罗娜只能翻了个白眼。

“如果你曾经好奇‘落魄的人’是什么样子的，现在你就看到了。 [pc.name]瓦乌什曾经是这个部落中最出色的战士之一，现在却变成了一个肥胖的老酒鬼。”阿罗娜说完便转身离去，只留下那个毫不在意的萨满。

“与皇室成员打交道总是这么有趣啊。[arona.isChief||或者，在这种情况下，应该是“曾经”。]又是一派胡言，真是的。看看这个。”他微微掀起长袍，露出结实有力的腹肌，“你觉得这看起来像胖吗？”

“胖啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！”阿罗娜在远处大喊道。
        
        沃什翻了个白眼：“现在的孩子们啊！我敢打赌，她肯定还在为上次摔跤比赛中被我压制的那次事耿耿于怀。当时她看起来简直要把我撕成碎片；其实她真有可能做到吧。我也不好意思承认，我的技术已经生疏了很多，恐怕已经差得不能再差了。他望着远方，陷入沉思。“……但那不过是一个老人胡言乱语罢了，我想你也不会为了听这些而来吧。
    
        |你小心翼翼地、充满怀疑地注视着他：“我为什么要信任你呢？”

他停了下来，思考了一会儿，然后耸了耸肩：“我不知道，孩子。如果你觉得一个像流浪汉一样靠在树旁喝醉的老头会给你带来麻烦，那随你便吧。他愤愤地喝了一口啤酒，说道：“你知道，并不是所有的兽人都是那些只会蛮力相搏的蠢货。我们当中也有人懂得欣赏生活中那些美好的东西，比如……嗯。”他又往自己的啤酒杯里倒了一些酒，“美酒啊！
        
        所以你是个酒鬼？”

“我是个多才多艺的人，而对酒精的耐受力只不过是我的其中一项才能罢了。顺便说一下，我叫沃什。 [flags.VAUSH_MET|我当然已经告诉过你了，不是吗？]
    
        他从旁边拿了一杯啤酒递给你：“来，坐下来休息一下，放松一下吧。
    ]
    
    你会和那个老兽人坐下来谈谈吗？

"Let's get the basics out of the way first. Who are you?"

        He reclines back with a blank look and starts droning dully. "Vaush Tempesh; shaman, drunk, old man, lazy fuck, Hero of Horn High. Just a few things people call me."
        
        "That last one sounds just a bit different from the others, doesn't it?"
        
        "Does it? I suppose to you it might, but to me it means about as much as the rest of them. Some people might think that sounds downright stupid, but I'm just not the kind of guy who gets a big head just because I cut up a few minotaurs."
        
        He takes a big drink, seeming bitter about something. "Nevermind that. I always get grouchy when I talk about that stuff. Anyway. I'm a shaman of the Kervus tribe. I make potions, medicines for both practical and recreational use, help Hretha with religious rights, when I can stand her long enough, and train the few men who have higher aspirations than being a rank and file meathead. I also cultivate cheeses, whenever I can keep a cow around for more than a week without it getting carved up."
        
        [flags.HRETHA_MET
            |"Why don't you like her?"
        
            "I just don't get along with the royals[flags.ARONA_RECRUITED|, I'm sure you noticed that already]. Long stories, not really up to trying to explain all of it to an outsider, so let's just leave that there.
            |"Hretha?"
        
            "Tribe's oracle, slash head shaman, though she tends to prefer the former. Being blind makes a lot of the herbal stuff a bit trickier, so that's where me and my boys come in.
        ]
        
        I'm still the one who almost always gets bugged whenever someone gets sick, or has an infected wound, or just wants to forget the day with some of my more 'recreational' concoctions."
        
        "Sounds like you do a lot there."
        
        "I do feel like an overworked parent sometimes. I'd prefer you didn't call me daddy though." 
        
        [pc.isBimbo|Your eyes drift down his burly body, to his sizable bulge which his seated position seems to push up and emphasize. For some reason the word 'daddy' is all that comes to mind when you look at the mountain of man-meat. "... Can I still do it though?"
        
        He looks you up and down. "You? I don't think I'd mind that."]
        
        "The others you were with didn't seem to see you like that, though."
        
        "The only thing they respect is how hard you can bash people with a stick. It's why I prefer the company of myself, my wife, and my drinks; maybe an apprentice or two, now and then.
        
        "You're married?"
        
        "Is it that weird to think someone could put up with me for that long?" You're about to respond when he gives you a hearty slap on the back and laughs loudly. "Only joking, kiddo. Yeah, I've got a missus. Been together almost as long as I can remember. [
            pc.mf
            |Don't feel guilty about fooling around with me though. Our unions are pretty open.
            |Don't think that means I'm a one woman guy though. It doesn't quite work like that with us.
        ] She's a great girl; smart, nice, never afraid to speak her mind, tits like a frost giant, what more could a man ask for?[flags.VAUSH_FUCKED| Not to say you're any slouch either.]"
        
        His stein runs empty and he reaches over to grab his wineskin to refill it. "I know I sound like a crotchety old fart that doesn't like anybody. Really it's just a few groups that really crawl under my skin, mostly the ones who don't understand anything that's not on the working end of an axe. Call me what you want, but I just don't think that sweeping across the countryside, butchering or enslaving anyone in your way is a good idea long term, especially with all the weird shit that's been happening recently. But I'm just one guy, my opinion doesn't really matter all that much."
        
        [flags.ARONA_MET
        |"I suppose Arona is part of one of those groups?"
        
        "Royal types are definitely up there, though Arona is probably the most tolerable. I don't think Argoth ever got over me leaving the warrior shit behind. And Hretha... Let's just say it's complicated and leave it at that, okay?"

        "That was a compliment, you meathead," Vaush quips back.]

        He takes a deep drink, gulping down half his stein in one go. "Ugh. I could go on all day here. Better hope you don't have even half as many stories as I do by the time you're my age. Then again, you seem like the adventuring type, so maybe you'll wind up with even more. Just don't forget to write them down so you're not just blabbering off the cuff when some youngin starts wanting to hear them. Anything else you wanted to say?"

        [flags.ARONA_MET
        |我想阿罗娜应该属于那些群体中的一类吧？”

“皇家派的人肯定也在其中，不过阿罗娜可能是最容易相处的那个。我觉得阿戈斯从来都无法接受我放弃了战士的身份。至于赫蕾莎……这么说吧，情况有点复杂，我们就不再深入讨论这个话题了，好吗？
        
        [party.has arona|嘿，”阿罗娜哼道，“我又没坐得那么远，根本听不见你说话，老头。”

“那可是夸你呢，你这个笨蛋。”沃什回嘴道。]
        ]
        
        他大口喝了一杯，一口气喝下了半杯啤酒。“呃，我在这里能一直喝上一整天呢。希望等你到我这个年纪时，你的故事数量还远远达不到我的一半。不过，你看起来就是那种喜欢冒险的人，说不定你会编出更多故事来。只不过别忘了把它们记录下来，不然等有年轻人想听的时候，你就只能凭记忆胡编乱说了。还有其他想说的吗？

"
        "Let's get the basics out of the way first. Who are you?"

        He reclines back with a blank look and starts droning dully. "Vaush Tempesh; shaman, drunk, old man, lazy fuck, Hero of Horn High. Just a few things people call me."
        
        "That last one sounds just a bit different from the others, doesn't it?"
        
        "Does it? I suppose to you it might, but to me it means about as much as the rest of them. Some people might think that sounds downright stupid, but I'm just not the kind of guy who gets a big head just because I cut up a few minotaurs."
        
        He takes a big drink, seeming bitter about something. "Nevermind that. I always get grouchy when I talk about that stuff. Anyway. I'm a shaman of the Kervus tribe. I make potions, medicines for both practical and recreational use, help Hretha with religious rights, when I can stand her long enough, and train the few men who have higher aspirations than being a rank and file meathead. I also cultivate cheeses, whenever I can keep a cow around for more than a week without it getting carved up."
        
        [flags.HRETHA_MET
            |"Why don't you like her?"
        
            "I just don't get along with the royals[flags.ARONA_RECRUITED|, I'm sure you noticed that already]. Long stories, not really up to trying to explain all of it to an outsider, so let's just leave that there.
            |"Hretha?"
        
            "Tribe's oracle, slash head shaman, though she tends to prefer the former. Being blind makes a lot of the herbal stuff a bit trickier, so that's where me and my boys come in.
        ]
        
        I'm still the one who almost always gets bugged whenever someone gets sick, or has an infected wound, or just wants to forget the day with some of my more 'recreational' concoctions."
        
        "Sounds like you do a lot there."
        
        "I do feel like an overworked parent sometimes. I'd prefer you didn't call me daddy though." 
        
        [pc.isBimbo|Your eyes drift down his burly body, to his sizable bulge which his seated position seems to push up and emphasize. For some reason the word 'daddy' is all that comes to mind when you look at the mountain of man-meat. "... Can I still do it though?"
        
        He looks you up and down. "You? I don't think I'd mind that."]
        
        "The others you were with didn't seem to see you like that, though."
        
        "The only thing they respect is how hard you can bash people with a stick. It's why I prefer the company of myself, my wife, and my drinks; maybe an apprentice or two, now and then.
        
        "You're married?"
        
        "Is it that weird to think someone could put up with me for that long?" You're about to respond when he gives you a hearty slap on the back and laughs loudly. "Only joking, kiddo. Yeah, I've got a missus. Been together almost as long as I can remember. [
            pc.mf
            |Don't feel guilty about fooling around with me though. Our unions are pretty open.
            |Don't think that means I'm a one woman guy though. It doesn't quite work like that with us.
        ] She's a great girl; smart, nice, never afraid to speak her mind, tits like a frost giant, what more could a man ask for?[flags.VAUSH_FUCKED| Not to say you're any slouch either.]"
        
        His stein runs empty and he reaches over to grab his wineskin to refill it. "I know I sound like a crotchety old fart that doesn't like anybody. Really it's just a few groups that really crawl under my skin, mostly the ones who don't understand anything that's not on the working end of an axe. Call me what you want, but I just don't think that sweeping across the countryside, butchering or enslaving anyone in your way is a good idea long term, especially with all the weird shit that's been happening recently. But I'm just one guy, my opinion doesn't really matter all that much."
        
        [flags.ARONA_MET
        |"I suppose Arona is part of one of those groups?"
        
        "Royal types are definitely up there, though Arona is probably the most tolerable. I don't think Argoth ever got over me leaving the warrior shit behind. And Hretha... Let's just say it's complicated and leave it at that, okay?"
        
        [party.has arona|"Hey," Arona grunts, "I ain't sitting so far away I can't hear, old man."
        
        "That was a compliment, you meathead," Vaush quips back.]
        ]
        
        He takes a deep drink, gulping down half his stein in one go. "Ugh. I could go on all day here. Better hope you don't have even half as many stories as I do by the time you're my age. Then again, you seem like the adventuring type, so maybe you'll wind up with even more. Just don't forget to write them down so you're not just blabbering off the cuff when some youngin starts wanting to hear them. Anything else you wanted to say?""

rows.original:
"So what's your tribe actually like?"

        "Are you asking if they're any different to live with then they are to run into out here?"
        
        "Basically, yeah."
        
        "Kind of. Most of them have the same basic attitude no matter where you meet them, so never expect not to have some drunken asshole come at you with a battleaxe and no pants on. Otherwise just imagine what a group of over-muscled, under-thinking nutjobs would do on a regular basis. It's really not that interesting."
        
        "Why are you even still there if that's how you feel?"
        
        "Eh, I make it sound worse than it is because I'm just kind of a dick, I suppose. I can get into it and pal around for a while, but there's a reason I go back to the drink as often as I do. The festivals are great too, and I'm not just saying that because I always win the wrestling contest. They're the only times when it feels like people are actually having fun, and the collective rod up everyone's ass loosens up. Also I won at the wrestling contest a lot."
        
        He chuckles out loud.
        
        "So is it just a free for all or are you more structured."
        
        "The general rule is; Unless Argoth, one of his sisters, or someone they say is important enough to listen to says you should do something, you don't have to do anything. Obviously there's some basic rules that you just follow. Don't kill or steal from other tribesmen, rape is bad in most cases, and only feed Gerik treats if he's a really good boy, because he puts on weight pretty quick."
        
        "I'm assuming one of them told all of you to go out and do all of this?"
        
        "Nah. Most of them are just bored, and Arona's been really up and out about us 'being real orcs', whatever that means. I got caught up in this by an old war buddy who's one of Arona's raiding party leaders now. Guy doesn't know the meaning of the word no, so it's not like I was getting out of it. Argoth doesn't even want us doing this, he'd rather we just sit and wait for whatever the hells he's up to. Of course you can't tell that to a group of Orcs and expect them to actually listen to it, now can you?"
        
        He puts his hand to his face and yawns. "So much to do these days. Anything else you wanted before I head back out?"
rows.translation:
那么，你们的部落到底是什么样的呢？”

“你是想问，和在这里遇到他们相比，和他们一起生活会有什么不同吗？”

“基本上，还是有点不同的。”

“算是吧。无论你在哪里遇到他们，他们大多都保持着同样的态度，所以千万别指望不会遇到某个喝得醉醺醺的混蛋，拿着战斧、没穿裤子就冲向你。否则，你就想象一下，这么一群肌肉发达但脑子不太灵光的疯子，平时会做出些什么事情吧……其实真的没什么意思的。
        
        如果你真是这么想的，为什么还待在那里呢？”

“呃，我把事情说得比实际情况更糟糕，大概是因为我本身就是一个有点混蛋的人吧。我可以暂时参与进去，和大家一起玩闹一阵，但我也确实有原因才会频繁地回到喝酒的状态中去。 这些节日活动也很棒，我这么说并不是因为我在摔跤比赛中总是能赢。只有在这些时候，人们才会真正感到开心，那种压抑在每个人心中的紧张气氛也会随之缓解。 而且我在摔跤比赛中也赢过很多次。
        
        他放声大笑起来。

“那么，这种行为就是完全自由随意的，还是有一定的规则可循呢？”

“一般的规则是：除非是阿戈斯、他的某个姐妹，或者那些被认为足够重要、值得听取意见的人告诉你应该做某件事，否则你根本不需要做任何事。当然，也有一些基本的规则需要遵守。不要杀害或偷窃其他部落的人，在大多数情况下，强奸也是不被允许的；只有当格里克表现得非常乖巧时，才给他喂食特制的零食，因为他的体重增长得相当快。
        
        我猜是其中有人指使你们所有人出去干这些事的吧？”

“不，大多数人都只是觉得无聊而已。而阿罗娜一直在到处宣扬我们‘是真正的兽人’，不管这到底是什么意思。我是因为一个老战友才卷入这件事的，他现在也是阿罗娜的团队领导之一。 那家伙根本不明白“不”这个词的含义，所以其实我并不是真的想退出这件事。阿戈斯甚至根本不希望我们这么做，他宁愿我们就坐等着看他到底在搞什么名堂。当然，你不可能对一群兽人这么说，还指望他们会真的听你的，对吧？"
        
        他把手放在脸上，打了个哈欠。“这些天有太多事情要做了。在我离开之前，还有什么事你需要我帮忙处理的吗？

rows.original:
"You never actually told me about any of your past."

        "I didn't. Do I have to?"
        
        "It'd be nice."
        
        "I guess it would." He says, notably irritated, but willing. "Alright, let's just go from the top here. You can probably guess that I used to be a lot more of a warrior. More than that, I used to be one of the best in the tribe. Horn High was a small minotaur village that we'd been raiding for months, or at least we were trying to. Had these four huge fuckers guarding it that just ripped our boys apart, not to mention the rest of them weren't anything to scoff at either. We were about to give up, until they decided to hit us back."
        
        His look turns grim. "Me and the other raiding parties were out of camp at the time. They'd been on the defensive the whole time, so we never expected them to attack us directly. But that night they came and nearly burned the whole damn thing to the ground. Bastards didn't even spare the kids. We decided that was it. Before that we weren't able to devote everyone to taking them out because our chief didn't think they were worth that much effort, but it was clear that they were the biggest threat we had at that point."
        
        "[pc.bg soldier barbarian
            |Should have never turned your back on an enemy."
        
            "We got that point, thank you.
            |So all-out war, then?"
        
            "As much as it can be when there's only about a hundred people between us.
        ] We gathered everyone we had and charged right for them. The battle went well into the night, and we had the numbers advantage by the end. But we still had the four big fucks to deal with. Just one of them at a time would have been one thing, but they held together, bashing through our guys like a furry, horned cannonball. Eventually me and a few of the other heavy hitters cornered them away from the rest. We got two of them down, but by that point it was just me left standing straight."
        
        "[pc.bg soldier barbarian|Impressive.|What happened next?]"
        
        "It was me, no backup in sight, versus two of the biggest fuckers you've ever seen. If I let them go down and join the rest of their men then they'd butcher the rest of us, so I charged in. Everything after that is just a blur; blood flying, metal clashing, pain, grunting, sweat flying. No I'm not describing sex, at least I hope I'm not. Anyway it all ended with me standing on top of their piled up bodies and loudly proclaiming my victory, before passing out in a pool that was at least a third my own blood."
        
        "You were hurt that bad?"
        
        "Yep, barely survived. Spent gods know how long out cold. Lucky for me Orcish medicine is surprisingly competent, so they didn't have to cut my limbs off to keep the gangrene from killing me. Still, I wasn't in any shape to go back onto the front lines. I won us the fight by putting those two in the ground, but I pushed myself so hard that my bones were held together with twine."
        
        "[pc.bgMulti barbarian soldier
            |Sounds like a good battle!"
        
            "You sound just like Arbruth, you know? No, I really wouldn't say desperately beating my head against a wall and only winning because I was a slightly thicker paste at the end is a good fight.
            |That was way too risky."
        
            "I know. Hell, I knew that back then, but I didn't see any other way to do it.
            |That's rough."
        
            "Putting it lightly, yeah.
        ] I spent the next month or so just limping around camp. After a while, Doran, the head shaman at the time, told me to stop feeling sorry for myself, and he dragged me into his tent. No, not for the reason you're thinking. Anyway, after we fucked he put me to work as his apprentice. It's hard to break a bone mixing leaves together, so I managed to keep that up pretty well. As you can probably guess, I ended up sticking with it."
        
        "Why?"
        
        "At that point I'd spent the better part of my life only really worrying about whose head I was gonna bash in next and how I was going to do it. Going from that to being barely able to lift my arms was... interesting to say the least. It gave me time to sit down and really look at things. I looked around at what everyone was actually doing; fighting, drinking, fucking. Don't get me wrong, that's fine, but I'd been doing that for going on thirty years and it finally dawned on me just how tiring it really was. Meanwhile Doran was showing me all this alchemy and magic shit that I'd never even thought about before."
        
        "[var0
            |Neeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeerd!"
        
            "Rude, but not wrong.
            |You really got into it, then?"
        
            "Sort of.
        ] When it started I mostly just saw it as a way to kill time until I recovered. But the more I did it, the more I got into it. Doran used to just be a weird old man to me and most of the other warriors, but when I sat down and talked to him I found out that he was one of the most interesting people there. Also that his dick was fucking massive. It was then I understood why I always felt like the horses were giving him dirty looks. Being around him changed my outlook on almost anything. You should have seen the look on my wife's face when I actually wanted to sit down and talk!"
        
        He bursts out laughing as he recalls more stories of his tribesmen dumbfounded at his new perspective. "Of course, when I started thinking about sticking with that, it didn't go over so well. Needless to say they were looking forward to me coming back onto the front lines after Horn High, so hearing that I might not got some of them up in a tizzy. Got into some fights, lost some friends, but in the end it just made me want to stick with it more. Eventually Doran died, and even though Hretha was technically named head shaman in his stead, I'm the one who handles most of his old duties. And so here we are, several mountains of bad blood and bullshit later and I slowly turned into the lovely old gentleman you see before you. I could go further, but then you'd just hear me grumbling about everyone for an hour. Well, another hour."
        
        "Did you have anything else in mind?"
rows.translation:
你从来都没有真正向我讲过你的过去。”

“确实没有。我有必要告诉你吗？”

“如果可以的话，会比较好吧。”

“我想也是。”他说道，语气中明显带着些烦躁，但终究还是同意了。“好吧，那就从头开始讲吧。 你大概可以猜到，我以前其实更像是一名战士。不仅如此，我还是部落里最出色的战士之一。霍恩海村是一个小小的米诺陶尔村庄，我们已经对这个村庄进行了数月的袭击，至少我们是这么尝试的。 有那四个巨大的家伙在守卫着它，它们把我们的同伴们撕得粉碎，更何况其他的那些家伙也绝非好对付的对象。我们几乎要放弃了，直到它们决定反击我们。

他的表情变得阴沉起来。 当时我和其他几支突袭队伍都不在营地里。他们一直处于防御状态，所以我们根本没料到他们会直接攻击我们。但那个晚上，他们真的来了，差点把整个营地烧成灰烬。 那些混蛋连孩子都不放过。我们当时就下定决心，必须采取行动。在此之前，我们之所以无法调集所有人去营救他们，是因为我们的首领认为这些孩子并不值得我们付出那么大的努力，但显然，在那个时候，他们才是我们面临的最大威胁。"
        
        "[pc.bg soldier barbarian
            |永远不应该背弃敌人。”

“我们明白这个道理了，谢谢。
            |那么，就是全面开战了？”
“当我们双方的人数只有大约一百人的时候，也就只能采取全面开战的手段了。
        ] 我们召集了所有能召集到的人，直接向他们发起了攻击。这场战斗一直持续到深夜，到最后我们在人数上占据了优势。但是，我们仍然不得不对付那四个家伙。如果一次只对付其中一个的话，或许还能应付得来，但他们团结在一起，像一颗长着角、覆盖着毛发的炮弹一样，猛烈地攻击我们的战士。最终，我和另外几个战斗力较强的队友把他们逼到了远离其他人的地方。我们击倒了其中两个，但到了那个时候，只剩下我一个人还站着了。[pc.bg soldier barbarian|真是令人印象深刻。|接下来发生了什么？]就是我，没有任何支援，面对的却是你见过的两个最凶残的家伙。如果让他们得逞，杀了他们手下的那些人，他们就会把我们其他人也全部杀光，所以我就冲了上去。之后的所有事情都变得模糊不清了——鲜血飞溅，金属碰撞，痛苦、呻吟声，还有汗水四处飞溅。 不，我并不是在描述性行为，至少我希望不是这样。总之，最后我站在他们堆叠在一起的尸体上，高声宣告自己的胜利，然后就倒在了一滩至少有我三分之一血液的液体中昏了过去。你受伤得那么严重吗？”

“是啊，差点没能活下来。不知道在昏迷中过了多久。幸运的是，兽人医学技术出奇地先进，他们没有不得不截断我的四肢来防止坏疽夺走我的生命。 不过，我当时的身体状况根本不适合重新回到前线。正是我把那两个人消灭掉，才让我们赢得了这场战斗，但我把自己逼得太狠了，以至于我的骨头几乎都是靠细绳才勉强连接在一起的。[pc.bgMulti barbarian soldier
            |听起来会是一场精彩的战斗啊！”

“你说话的方式简直和阿布鲁斯一模一样，你知道吗？不，我真不认为那种拼命挣扎、最后只是因为自己稍微多坚持了一会儿才获胜的比赛，才能被称为一场好的战斗。
            |那风险实在太大了。”

“我知道。该死，当时我就意识到了这一点，但我实在想不出其他的办法。
            |那可真不妙。”

“说得轻点吧，确实是这样。
        ] 接下来的一个月左右，我都在营地里无所事事、虚度光阴。过了一段时间，当时的首席萨满多兰让我别再自怨自艾，然后把我拉进了他的帐篷。不过，原因并不是你想象的那样……总之，在发生了那件事之后，他让我成为了他的学徒，开始让我帮忙干活。 把树叶混在一起根本不可能弄断骨头，所以我还是坚持了下来。你大概也能猜到，最后我确实选择了继续这样做。”

“为什么？”

“因为在那个时候，我人生的大部分时间都在思考接下来该砸谁的脑袋，以及该用什么样的方法来做到这一点。 从那种状态发展到几乎连手臂都抬不起来……用“有趣”来形容都算是轻描淡写了。这让我有时间坐下来，认真思考一些事情。我观察了周围的人都在做什么：打架、喝酒、做爱…… 别误会，这样做也没什么不好，但我已经坚持了差不多三十年，直到现在才终于意识到这其实是一件多么累人的事。而与此同时，多兰却在向我展示各种炼金术和魔法之类的东西，这些我之前根本从未考虑过。"
        
        "[var0
            |笨蛋！
            |那你真是全身心地投入进去了，是吗？”

“算是吧。
        ] 刚开始的时候，我只是把它当作一种打发时间、等待恢复状态的方式。但随着我越来越多地参与其中，我逐渐对它产生了浓厚的兴趣。在之前，多兰对我来说，以及其他大多数战士来说，都只是一个古怪的老头罢了；但当我真正坐下来与他交谈之后，我发现他其实是那里最有趣的人之一。 而且他的阴茎大得离谱。就在那时，我终于明白了为什么那些马总是用那种眼神看着他。和他在一起之后，我对几乎所有事情的看法都改变了。你真该看看我妻子当时的表情，当时我其实是想坐下来好好谈谈的！"
        
        当他回想起那些族人们对自己新观点感到震惊的故事时，他忍不住大笑起来。“当然，当我刚开始决定坚持这个想法时，反应并不太好。不用说，他们本来都期待着我在‘Horn High’战役之后能回到前线，所以听到我可能不会回去时，他们确实有些慌了。 参与过一些争斗，也失去了一些朋友，但最终这些经历反而让我更加坚定了继续坚持下去的决心。最终多兰去世了，虽然从名义上来说，赫蕾莎被任命为他的继任者，负责主持部落的仪式，但实际上，他以前的许多职责都是由我来承担的。 就这样，经过了无数次争吵和无聊的争斗，我终于慢慢变成了你们现在看到的这位和蔼可亲的老人。我本可以继续讲下去，但那样的话，你们大概会听我抱怨上一个小时吧…… 好吧，再等一个小时吧。
        
        你还有其他什么想法吗？
rows.raw:
'
        "You never actually told me about any of your past."

        "I didn't. Do I have to?"
        
        "It'd be nice."
        
        "I guess it would." He says, notably irritated, but willing. "Alright, let's just go from the top here. You can probably guess that I used to be a lot more of a warrior. More than that, I used to be one of the best in the tribe. Horn High was a small minotaur village that we'd been raiding for months, or at least we were trying to. Had these four huge fuckers guarding it that just ripped our boys apart, not to mention the rest of them weren't anything to scoff at either. We were about to give up, until they decided to hit us back."
        
        His look turns grim. "Me and the other raiding parties were out of camp at the time. They'd been on the defensive the whole time, so we never expected them to attack us directly. But that night they came and nearly burned the whole damn thing to the ground. Bastards didn't even spare the kids. We decided that was it. Before that we weren't able to devote everyone to taking them out because our chief didn't think they were worth that much effort, but it was clear that they were the biggest threat we had at that point."
        
        "[pc.bg soldier barbarian
            |Should have never turned your back on an enemy."
        
            "We got that point, thank you.
            |So all-out war, then?"
        
            "As much as it can be when there's only about a hundred people between us.
        ] We gathered everyone we had and charged right for them. The battle went well into the night, and we had the numbers advantage by the end. But we still had the four big fucks to deal with. Just one of them at a time would have been one thing, but they held together, bashing through our guys like a furry, horned cannonball. Eventually me and a few of the other heavy hitters cornered them away from the rest. We got two of them down, but by that point it was just me left standing straight."
        
        "[pc.bg soldier barbarian|Impressive.|What happened next?]"
        
        "It was me, no backup in sight, versus two of the biggest fuckers you've ever seen. If I let them go down and join the rest of their men then they'd butcher the rest of us, so I charged in. Everything after that is just a blur; blood flying, metal clashing, pain, grunting, sweat flying. No I'm not describing sex, at least I hope I'm not. Anyway it all ended with me standing on top of their piled up bodies and loudly proclaiming my victory, before passing out in a pool that was at least a third my own blood."
        
        "You were hurt that bad?"
        
        "Yep, barely survived. Spent gods know how long out cold. Lucky for me Orcish medicine is surprisingly competent, so they didn't have to cut my limbs off to keep the gangrene from killing me. Still, I wasn't in any shape to go back onto the front lines. I won us the fight by putting those two in the ground, but I pushed myself so hard that my bones were held together with twine."
        
        "[pc.bgMulti barbarian soldier
            |Sounds like a good battle!"
        
            "You sound just like Arbruth, you know? No, I really wouldn't say desperately beating my head against a wall and only winning because I was a slightly thicker paste at the end is a good fight.
            |That was way too risky."
        
            "I know. Hell, I knew that back then, but I didn't see any other way to do it.
            |That's rough."
        
            "Putting it lightly, yeah.
        ] I spent the next month or so just limping around camp. After a while, Doran, the head shaman at the time, told me to stop feeling sorry for myself, and he dragged me into his tent. No, not for the reason you're thinking. Anyway, after we fucked he put me to work as his apprentice. It's hard to break a bone mixing leaves together, so I managed to keep that up pretty well. As you can probably guess, I ended up sticking with it."
        
        "Why?"
        
        "At that point I'd spent the better part of my life only really worrying about whose head I was gonna bash in next and how I was going to do it. Going from that to being barely able to lift my arms was... interesting to say the least. It gave me time to sit down and really look at things. I looked around at what everyone was actually doing; fighting, drinking, fucking. Don't get me wrong, that's fine, but I'd been doing that for going on thirty years and it finally dawned on me just how tiring it really was. Meanwhile Doran was showing me all this alchemy and magic shit that I'd never even thought about before."
        
        "[var0
            |Neeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeerd!"
        
            "Rude, but not wrong.
            |You really got into it, then?"
        
            "Sort of.
        ] When it started I mostly just saw it as a way to kill time until I recovered. But the more I did it, the more I got into it. Doran used to just be a weird old man to me and most of the other warriors, but when I sat down and talked to him I found out that he was one of the most interesting people there. Also that his dick was fucking massive. It was then I understood why I always felt like the horses were giving him dirty looks. Being around him changed my outlook on almost anything. You should have seen the look on my wife's face when I actually wanted to sit down and talk!"
        
        He bursts out laughing as he recalls more stories of his tribesmen dumbfounded at his new perspective. "Of course, when I started thinking about sticking with that, it didn't go over so well. Needless to say they were looking forward to me coming back onto the front lines after Horn High, so hearing that I might not got some of them up in a tizzy. Got into some fights, lost some friends, but in the end it just made me want to stick with it more. Eventually Doran died, and even though Hretha was technically named head shaman in his stead, I'm the one who handles most of his old duties. And so here we are, several mountains of bad blood and bullshit later and I slowly turned into the lovely old gentleman you see before you. I could go further, but then you'd just hear me grumbling about everyone for an hour. Well, another hour."
        
        "Did you have anything else in mind?"'

        You hold back from mentioning exactly what happened up there and simply continue the conversation. "And, uh, w-what did you do with them?"
        
        "Mixed them up into a potion, of course! They reacted really strongly no matter what I put them in, so I got curious. Naturally I don't have too many takers for drinking down strange brews that I whip up out of stuff I find on the ground, so I drank it myself! And, uh..."
        
        He takes off his lower covering just enough for his gigantic sack to swing out. "Let's just say these used to be about half as big."
        
        "That's... quite the effect."
        
        "Yep. Say, I could grab you one if it sounds like something you'd be interested in. I've got a few hanging around and I'm pretty happy where I'm at now, so I won't be using them any time soon; and I'm afraid if I spread the word on them one of those dopes would chug them and flood the village!"
        
        It's an interesting proposal.[pc.hasRealCock|| Of course you don't have the same equipment he has, but who knows.] "I'll think about it."
        
        "Right. Anything else?"

        你没有详细说明上面发生了什么，只是继续了对话。“那么，呃，你把它们用来做了什么？”

“当然是把它们混合成了一种药水！无论我把它们加到什么里面，它们都会产生非常强烈的反应，所以我很好奇。当然了，愿意喝我用地上找到的东西调制出来的奇怪药水的人并不多，所以我就自己喝了！然后，呃……
        
        他稍微掀开下方的遮盖物，让那个巨大的袋子露了出来。“这么说吧，这些东西以前只有现在大小的一半。”

“哇……效果确实相当显著啊。”

“没错。如果你感兴趣的话，我可以给你拿一个。我还有几个闲置着，而且我现在的生活也挺满意的，所以短期内应该不会用到它们了；不过要是我把这个消息传开了，那些家伙肯定会争相抢走它们，然后整个村子都会被这些东西淹没的！

“好的，还有其他事情吗？
